BANDRA BORN is a MUST visit. 11/10 experience.

The food was brilliant, the service was brilliant and the ambience and music was brilliant too.

On a personal level, today’s experience was beyond insane. The venus cake comes with two ice creams, ensure you mix both ice creams and eat the cake, mindblowingly good!

The partners were also so pleasant and great people!

All round food lovers haven.

The food is new and comforting at the same time, like a vintage car with a brand new engine. The drinks are thought out and the cocktails might actually deserve their four-digit price tags. Have a chat with the bartender and he’ll explain where the liquor comes from, how long the flavor has to sit in a dungeon before being released, and maybe give you a taster if you’re nice enough.

Imagery aside:

- the food tastes great;
- the portions are surprisingly large for similar restaurants in Mumbai (which does make up for the price somewhat);
- the drinks are memorable (unless you have too many); and
- the ambience is fine - it’s on a busy Bandra street though so I think they’ve done well with what they had. You can still see Salt Water Café’s bones sticking through the walls (the place that was here before Bandra Born was…born)

All in all - I would and have and will recommend this place to my friends and family.

Some photos attached and specific recommendations below:

1. Granny’s prawn dish - raw mango bits, soft buns, CURRY 11/10
2. Malai podi toast - 9/10 (but refreshing)
3. We started with Mannara Pinot Grigio wine and Red Label whiskey with spiced nuts. Then we had Pea ET Cetera, Grilled Asparagus and Smoked Carrots. These starters was more than sufficient for us but, we still ordered Paneer & Pineapple Curry. Each and every dish was very delicious. On our server's recommendation we had The Kerala Vanilla Cake. It was really very yummy.
The décor was very decent. The service was impeccable thanks to our server Dinesh who helped us to select right veg dishes suiting to our taste. The ambiance was great.
it was a right choice to spend Saturday evening., name_person=Balkrishna Shroff}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a week ago, review=Valet parking available. The tenderloin was truly tender and delicious, even after it cooled, and the squid was cooked perfectly with great texture and balanced flavors. I’d love to come back again., name_person=Sakura S}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=6 days ago, review=Horrendous food with rude service served in 2 star ambience

The lady at reception was rude. With rolling eyes and doing nothing about customer's comfort is so unprofessional. What made her so insecure and judgmental? God knows!

I do admire the owner's vision, though, with small details incorporated into the restaurant—like decorating the ceiling with shredded menus for sustainability and recycling, and providing all the amenities in the ladies' washroom.

But I didn't know, the worst part was yet to come: I ordered chicken skewers, which arrived on small platters, excessively drenched in barbecue sauce. The egg fried rice sucked. In all honesty, I found the garlic bread nice. The servers were pleasant—they explained the dishes and recommended squeezing lime on top. Thank you for that.

But again, the seating is compact, and in all ways—in all my senses—I won't recommend this place for dining or even a quick munch., name_person=Flora Parker}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Visited Bandra born last week and absolutely loved it. It’s a charming, cozy spot — we sat upstairs, in a snug attic-like space perfect for small groups of two to four, while the larger downstairs area could accommodate bigger gatherings. The ambience was beautiful, with music at just the right volume for easy conversation.

We ordered quite a spread: tuna balls, prawn butter garlic toast, mutton burger, chicken puff in gravy, and two desserts — a cream cheese with pistachio crumble, and a chocolate soufflé with passion fruit glaze. The prawn butter garlic toast was the star — hands down the best I’ve ever had. The mutton burger was simple and unfussy, just two perfectly cooked patties with caramelized onions in a thin bun, served with excellent fries. The tuna balls were beautifully fried, and while much of the food was deep-fried, it was done so well that every bite was delicious. I personally preferred the cream cheese and pistachio crumble dessert, though both were great.

Between the food, ambience, and company, it was a fantastic evening. I’d happily go back — Bandra born is a gem., name_person=Anuradha Ghosh}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Superb experience in terms of food, service, ambience and vibe..}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Will keep going back to check out and finish off the rest of the menu 😀}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Delba and her staff were very kind to accommodate us after a short wait.}"]
address: BANDRA BORN, Rose Minar, 87, Chapel Rd, Annexe, Reclamation, Bandra West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400050, India

Desserts are great as well., name_person=Sudarshan Pawar}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good service, great ambience, quality, price and staff is worth it !}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Non Veg food is yummy eager hostess and servers to help you choose a good meal.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=A good selection of wines and whiskey on offer, but don't miss the cocktails}"]

[{'name_person': 'Kumar Pai', 'time_line': '4 months ago', 'review': 'Last weekend, we celebrated my wife’s birthday at Drunkyard Lounge, and I must say it turned out to be a memorable evening.
From the moment we walked in, the ambiance, cleanliness, food, and music struck the perfect balance, setting the tone for a great night.

Ambiance & Service

The vibe of the place is chic yet welcoming. Dim lighting, tasteful décor, and a well-curated playlist that adds energy without being overwhelming.
The staff deserves a special mention for their attentiveness and hospitality. In particular, Mr. S.M. Kadri, the Operations Manager, stood out with his courteous nature and genuine care, ensuring we had everything we needed.

One aspect that truly impressed me was the restaurant’s inclusive approach to hiring women across various roles, not just at the reception but also behind the bar and on the floor as servers. This reflects progressive values and a healthy work culture, which is rare and commendable.

Food & Drinks

We tried a few dishes, and here’s how they fared:

Asparagus Tempura Roll Sushi

The absolute highlight of the evening. The roll was crunchy, fresh, and bursting with flavor. Each bite delivered a delightful mix of textures and taste. A must-try for sushi lovers.

Crystal Chicken Dumplings

This one fell a little flat for me. While the dumpling skin was delicate and well-made, the filling lacked basic seasoning and tasted rather bland. The chili oil on the side added some much-needed kick, but overall, it’s a dish you could easily skip.

Char-Grilled Firecracker Chicken Bao

A winner! The bao was pillowy soft, and the chicken filling had the right amount of spice and smokiness. Definitely worth ordering if you enjoy bold flavors.

Final Thoughts

Drunkyard Lounge ticks a lot of boxes. Good food, a lively yet comfortable atmosphere, great service, and thoughtful inclusivity in its staffing. While not every dish was a hit, the highlights more than made up for it.

If you’re in or around Dombivli and looking for a place to unwind with friends or family, Drunkyard Lounge is worth a visit. reviews:

The place is well-maintained and creates a pleasant atmosphere for family gatherings and meetings.

The service was good. The team was very helpful and tried to make everything perfect.

Both vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes were excellently made .

Overall, it is a highly recommended place for good food and a great environment., name_person=Girish Bhirud}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=A Stunning Hidden Gem in Kalyan West

Tucked away quietly in Kalyan West, this restaurant is truly a hidden treasure. From the outside, it looks ordinary, but the moment you walk in, the beautifully crafted interiors simply leave you amazed. The ambience is elegant, warm, and far more luxurious than anything you’d imagine from the exterior.

A close friend recently celebrated his son’s birthday here, and the entire event was handled flawlessly. The staff is extremely polite, cooperative, and genuinely attentive. Their hospitality adds a special touch that makes every moment feel well taken care of.

The food is exceptional — flavourful, fresh, and served with great presentation. If there's one thing you must try, it’s their dimsums. Both veg and non-veg are perfectly prepared and easily among the best in the area.

They offer a dedicated dine-in section, a spacious party hall, and even a separate conference space — making it ideal for families, celebrations, and corporate events. The overall vibe is so refined and classy that it genuinely feels like a piece of South Mumbai brought to Kalyan.

I rarely write such long reviews, but Namaste Kalyan impressed me so much that I felt compelled to share this experience. A must-visit for anyone looking for great food, great ambience, and great service — all under one roof., name_person=Lalit Patil}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=10-30 min}, time_line=5 months ago, review=This was our first experience at this resturant and it was really disappointing. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Prudencia Gavankar\",\"time_line\":\"a month ago\",\"review\":\"Terrible experience at Zeal Skybar!\\nOrdered veg fried rice and specifically asked to add mushrooms, but they denied despite being willing to pay extra.\\nNot just that, the dining service was painfully slow on a weekday with barely any crowd. Weekends are understandable, but weekdays? Unacceptable. Avoid this place if you value your time and taste buds. 1/5 stars\",\"guided_block\":{\"GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT\":1,\"GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT\":1,\"GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT\":1}}", "{\"name_person\":\"K. \u201cContentName\u201d F.\",\"time_line\":\"10 months ago\",\"review\":\"Our family visited Skybar for a Sunday dinner. Its spacious which made it comfortable for our family to settle in without feeling cramped. The restroom was clean and surprisingly spacious, a small but important detail when dining out with family.\\n\\nThe elevator ride up was marred by unsightly paan stains\u2014a real eyesore. Additionally, the stairs leading to the restaurant are poorly lit.\\n\\nThe view from the Skybar is unfortunately hindered by this huge sticker-like design on the glass windows, so don\u2019t expect breathtaking cityscapes at night. That said, the overall vibe inside is pleasant enough.\\n\\nThe band was excellent that evening. The acoustics of the venue left something to be desired. Pro tip: Avoid sitting to the sides of the stage, as the audio quality there is subpar. Opt for seats directly in front or further away for a better experience.\\n\\nWe decided to go for a range of various dishes. The food at Zeal Skybar ranged from delightful to disappointing. Some dishes truly shone, earning top marks: Mushroom and Cheese Cigar Rolls (5/5), Cheddar Stuffed Chicken (5/5) and the Mushroom Chilli (5/5)\\n\\nUnfortunately, the same cannot be said for the French fries (2/5), which were limp, lacked crispiness, and tasted like low-quality potatoes\u2014a major letdown for such a basic dish. Also the alcohol content in the cocktails (Long Island Iced Tea, Special Mojito) was questionable. I recently stayed at Farm House in Tamtalao, Vasai, and unfortunately, the experience was far from what it used to be. This property was once a wonderful place to stay with great food and a warm atmosphere, but the quality has dropped significantly over time.

The restaurant, once famous for favourites like their chicken nachos with authentic dips served in traditional chi glasses, no longer lives up to its name. The food was average, lacking the taste and charm it once had. But the biggest issue isn’t just the food — it’s the stay itself.

The room we were allotted had a stale, unpleasant smell, almost like it hadn’t been cleaned for a while. We had to call housekeeping just to get room freshener sprayed. The bathroom door was difficult to open, and the flush area was stained with yellow marks, along with visible mould — clear signs of poor hygiene and maintenance. Even the room didn’t feel properly cleaned or prepared for guests.

We were so uncomfortable that we checked out the same night.

This place once had so much potential, history, and popularity — I truly hope management takes maintenance and cleanliness more seriously, because right now, Farm House is nowhere near the standard it once proudly held., name_person=Jude Costa}", "{guided_block={HOTELS_PILOT_TRAVEL_GROUP_TYPE=Family, HOTELS_PILOT_TRIP_TYPE=Vacation, HOTELS_ASPECT_SERVICES=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_LOCATION=1, HOTELS_ASPECT_ROOMS=3}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Even after clearly informing the property twice — once before booking and once after booking — that the number of guests might increase, and also confirming that I was ready to pay for extra mattresses, the experience was extremely disappointing.

Even after my guest took only three mattresses, the manager kept yelling at them, which is completely unacceptable. He continued to ask for money even though the checkout hadn’t happened yet.

We visited this restaurant last night and specifically ordered only vegetarian food. We reminded the waiter four times to ensure everything was strictly vegetarian — yet, to our shock, we found chicken pieces in our dish!

As vegetarians, this was extremely upsetting and completely unacceptable. To make matters worse, they also overcharged us by ₹400–₹500. When we called to report this, the manager on duty (Shubham) gave an absurd excuse, claiming we ourselves brought the chicken piece and added it to the dish! After that, he stopped responding to our calls.

Getting any sort of compensation was never the concern the issue is hygiene, honesty and respect for customers dietary beliefs.

This kind of negligence and behavior is beyond unprofessional — it’s deeply offensive to vegetarians and raises serious concerns about their kitchen hygiene and honesty.

We are deeply disappointed and will be taking further legal action against the restaurant for serving non-vegetarian food despite clear instructions and for their false accusations.

Vegetarians, please avoid this place at all costs!, name_person=darshan shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Despite telling them multiple times that we only wanted pure vegetarian food, and even requesting them to please be careful and not serve us non-veg even by mistake, we still found a piece of chicken in our biryani. It was literally 3 a.m., and we had to argue with them for almost 45 minutes. Their attitude was so casuaal they just said, “kya kar sakte hai, ho gaya humse, dusri lelo, not a big issue.” Extremely disappointing and irresponsible!, name_person=Neha Yadav}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Never visit - served non-veg in a veg order, manager lied & overcharged in bill.

We are lifelong vegetarians and clearly told the waiter multiple times (4–8 reminders) that our biryani must be vegetarian - including guests who do not eat onion/garlic.  We were 17 of us. The restaurant arranged a sort of private table for us, which made it feel special and comfortable for our large gathering. The ambiance has a nice rustic charm, and it felt like the perfect place to sit back, enjoy conversations, and share a hearty meal.

We began with soups – some of us chose the Cream of Tomato, while a few went for the Vegetable Manchow. The Cream of Tomato was spot on with its rich yet balanced sweetness, smooth consistency, a drizzle of cream, and crunchy breadcrumbs to top it off. It was satisfying and flavorful. However, the Manchow soup was a bit of a letdown – while it had plenty of veggies, it was extra spicy and lacked that signature tang and flavor one usually expects. Adding fried noodles made it slightly better, but overall it fell short compared to the tomato soup.

For starters, we tried a variety – cheese balls, honey chilli potatoes, stuffed mushroom tandoori, and peanut chaat. The cheese balls were the highlight, perhaps the best I’ve had, mainly because they were pure cheese without any fillers like corn. Each bite burst with soft, molten cheese wrapped in a crunchy outer layer – a real treat for cheese lovers. The honey chilli potatoes tasted good but were overwhelmingly spicy despite us asking for medium spice. The stuffed mushrooms were generously portioned and very well received – smoky from the tandoor, with a flavorful paneer and veggie filling. On the other hand, the peanut chaat didn’t quite work for us; it had a vinegar-like coating that felt unusual, making the dish more average than enjoyable.

Moving on to the main course, we ordered Malai Kofta, Paneer Butter Masala, and Veg Handi, along with a mix of rotis, naans, and makai roti. The Malai Kofta was outstanding – rich cashew gravy, creamy but not overly sweet, with soft, perfectly cooked koftas that paired wonderfully with the hot rotis. Both the Paneer Butter Masala and Veg Handi were excellent too. The paneer pieces were soft, with ample portions in the creamy orange gravy, and the dish was made exactly as per our request without coriander. The Veg Handi lived up to its name with a mix of beans, carrots, peas, and cauliflower, all cooked well and full of flavor. The breads were soft, served hot, and generously buttered – the perfect partner to the gravies.

We ended our lunch with a sizzling brownie topped with vanilla ice cream. Though a few desserts we wanted weren’t available, this one made up for it. The brownie was warm, soft, and rich in chocolate flavor, pairing beautifully with the cold vanilla ice cream. Overall, while a few dishes could improve, the experience at Pali Village was very good. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Sunday The Comfort Kitchen - A Cozy Haven for Comfort Food
Sunday The Comfort Kitchen is a delightful spot for anyone craving hearty, comforting meals. The menu offers a great mix of classic comfort dishes, Service is friendly and attentive, enhancing the overall experience. Whether for brunch or dinner, this place is perfect for a relaxed meal with loved ones., name_person=Dakshta Desai}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=There are very few places in Borivali that consistently serve genuinely good food and Sunday Comfort Kitchen is definitely one of them. I’ve visited this place around 4 to 5 times now and it has never disappointed.

My absolute favorite here is the chilli fries with their secret dips. Hands down, a must try. I’ve also tried the Kung Pao potatoes, veg chopper rice, and Moroccan cottage cheese in the past. All of them have always been on point.

This time, we went for the potato wedges and ratatouille. Since it was my first time trying a veg ratatouille, I’m not entirely sure if it was the most authentic representation but it did taste good.

Overall, the food here has consistently been good and that’s exactly what keeps bringing me back., name_person=priyal soni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Visited Sunday – The Comfort Kitchen recently, and it’s definitely a cozy little spot for a quiet meal. The menu has a great variety of cuisines, which is perfect if you’re in the mood to try something different. The portion sizes were decent and most dishes tasted good.

That said, a couple of items were served cold, which took away from the overall experience a bit. Hopefully, that’s something they can improve on.

If you’re looking for a peaceful place with a wide range of food options, it’s still worth a visit!, name_person=Shivani Kadam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a week ago, review=The food was excellent for both veg and non-veg options, and the mocktails were equally impressive. I was genuinely amazed by how quickly they delivered each order without any compromise on the quality of food and drinks.

They even customized the sizzler for us, which made the experience feel truly special. A restaurant that can elevate a special occasions definitely deserves 5 stars.

P.S. :- The mocktail portion was slightly small, but they were refreshing and enjoyable., name_person=Rahul Udvadia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=10 months ago, review=Visited Sunday - The Comfort Kitchen, Borivali for a dinner date with my husband.
And..oh my God - the two of us experienced the 'Ratatouille-effect' as soon as we took our first bite!! Our taste buds tingled and danced with absolute joy. The food was hands-down, undoubtedly savoury and scrumptious.
So we ordered - Prawns Papped & Chicken Cigars for starters, followed by Non-Veg Dragon's Delight Sizzler as our main. A big big 👍🏻 for the way the chef handled each of the proteins in all our dishes. Both chicken and prawns were cooked to perfection! The dishes were not only a feast for the eyes but they were very well-seasoned, lip-smacking & as the name of this restaurant goes -- 'TOTALLY COMFORTING'.
I would highly recommend this place to all.

For starters, the Green Zen Sliders are a must-try — soft mini burgers with the yummiest dip. The Paneer Popcorn was crispy and tasty!

And the highlight? Their Lift Me Up dessert — absolute heaven and the perfect sweet ending.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Chicken_Sizzler, Sizzling_Brownie_with_Ice_Cream, Chicken_Banjara_Kebab, Chef's_Special_Chicken_Biryani, Manchow_Soup, Fried_Rice, Roti], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=It has been more than twenty years since I first visited Silver Coin Family Restaurant and Bar with my family, and it continues to remain a special place for us in Borivali. It is one of those restaurants in Borivali that continues to feel like home because of its food and hospitality.

This time, we began our meal with a bowl of Chicken Manchow Soup. It was served hot, and I enjoyed how it had a bold, flavorful taste without being overpowering. For starters, we ordered Veg Seekh Kebab, Mutton Seekh Kebab, and Chicken Pahadi Tikka. The Veg Seekh Kebab was nice, cooked well, and had the perfect earthy flavour. The Mutton Seekh Kebab was outstanding. It had a silky texture, was well-seasoned, and paired beautifully with the chutney. It was not chewy at all, and I really liked how smooth it felt with every bite. The Chicken Pahadi Tikka was equally good. The chicken was tender, juicy, and cooked with a light smokiness that made it enjoyable.

For the mains, I ordered Jeera Rice with Dal Tadka. The dal had a nice garlic tempering with the right amount of cumin, and together with the rice it felt wholesome and comforting. The Chicken Tikka Masala came with soft pieces of chicken in a thick gravy that had a good balance of spices. It went really well with the Tandoori Roti, which was crisp on the edges and soft in the middle. The Chicken Triple Schezwan Fried Rice was the last dish. It was mildly spiced, had a smoky taste from the wok, and the flavours were balanced in a way that made it enjoyable till the last bite.

As we were about to finish, we couldn’t resist ordering the Chicken Masala Lollipop, which has always been a family favorite. It was crispy, spicy, and coated beautifully with sauce. It was the highlight of the evening. The chicken inside was fresh and well-cooked, and every bite reminded me why I have loved this dish here for years.

The food at Silver Coin Family Restaurant and Bar is consistently good, and the staff make the experience even better. They are polite, attentive, and always welcoming. This restaurant is more of a family place, and the presence of a bar only adds to the variety without taking away from its warm atmosphere.

Its menu talks about Continental, Italian, Mexican and World cuisines. Its glittery indoors and scrumptious menu of beer and delicious cuisines are both soothing to eyes and tastebuds.
Flat breads- Chicken Tikka Flat bread and Confit Tomatoes Margarita were irresistibly delicious.
Sliders- 3 portions served with fresh French fries and yummilicious dips, your mouth will never stop munching. Bbq chicken sliders are the best.
Appetisers- the appetizers were too hard to resist on too. Cheesy Nachos, Salted Fries, Chicken Barbeque wings, Cajun Baby Potato, etc to list down amongst many others. pick from Salads or even from healthy sandwiches or toasties. Like we had Ceaser Salad and Hass Avocado Toast
Mains (Italian, Mexican & Continental) - Wild Mushroom is the best to have from Risotto. Basil Pesto was another best that can turn on your taste buds there. We ordered the Crab Ghee Roast and the Crab Thali, and both dishes were absolutely phenomenal.

Before cooking, they actually showed us the live crab—it was humongous! Once served, the Crab Ghee Roast turned out to be a flavor bomb. The gravy was rich and incredibly tasty, the crab meat was succulent, and the portion was generous. For me, it was a solid 5/5 dish.

Now let’s talk about the Crab Thali—it had everything you could possibly imagine. Every single element on the plate was cooked to perfection. Again, the crab was massive, and just getting through the meat took us over an hour! But it was so worth it—the flavors were on point.

One of the oldest restaurants.
It offers vegetarian and non vegetarian food.
It has good options for non vegetarian Biryani, Chicken tikka, mutton Sikh kabab, tandoori chicken.
It has a good variety of Chinese dishes.
Food quality is good and all the dishes are tasty.
This restaurant has ample seating arrangements on the ground floor and first floor. The ambience is ok.
Service is fast enough.
Generally it is a bit crowded during weekends, but the waiting period is manageable as it has more sitting arrangements on the first floor.
It has valet parking so parking is not an issue.
This restaurant also serves alcohol.

While the ambiance was lively, I felt that the prices for liquor and food were a tad steep compared to the quantity served. Perhaps they could consider revising their menu to offer more value for money?

The crowd was mostly local, and while everyone was friendly, it didn't quite feel like the most welcoming atmosphere for outsiders. I also noticed that the management seemed to prioritize a certain... let's say, "hospitality" that didn't quite align with my expectations from a decent establishment.

That being said, I do understand that every business has its own unique approach. However, as a visitor, I felt that the vibe wasn't exactly conducive for a comfortable evening out, especially for women.

The DJ sets were okay, but the sudden shift from upbeat tracks to slow songs broke the flow on the dance floor. Better mixing and set selection would elevate the experience.

Its a must go place in Malad, people residing near mustn't miss the chance of having a group or family dining here. The visit will come out to be fruitful and nice one just like my visit was one of the best.
We had-
Appetizers -
Cheese baby corn roll
MAC & cheese balls
Mushroom Multani
Tandoori platter
Mains-
Mexican Sizzler
Birbal khichdi
Paneer butter masala
Alongwith some quirky cocktails & mocktails like- hot toddy, blush on ice, perfect lady etc and these were extremely scrumptious.
To end the meal, we had a perfect and extravagant spread on our tables. Royal kulfi falooda, sizzling browni, gadbad ice cream, fruit salad with ice cream were too drooling and colorful that we couldn't resist eating even with the full stomach.
Our experience of dining here was fabulous. The staff is friendly and moreover they serve delicious vegetarian food. Must visit to chill, party and eat some amazing vegetarian food., name_person=Roshani Batra}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=10 months ago, review=This is a very popular restaurant in Borivali West. It is generally busy on the weekend. It is a long, vertically long, straight walking hotel. It has two types, AC section and Non-AC section and so price is different, means higher in AC section. This restaurant has a huge long menu. Mainly people come for alcoholic drinks during the day time.

We had a beer and couple dishes.

I took some pictures and videos for people who are interested to know or get a glimpse of it . I have attached here. Have a look. And if you are there or nearby, visit and enjoy., name_person=M Sam}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=Daffodils23 mini
Some days ago we visited this restaurant, this restaurant located in shop no 1, Krishnam Society, Adarsh Dugdhalaya, Malad West.

They served North Indian food, Street food, milkshake, drinks and many more. The ambience is very welcoming and charming.
Food is pretty good and for their prices it's 100% worth it.
It was an amazing experience and I recommend everyone to visit this beautiful restaurant., name_person=Chetan Vaskar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Food is good. Service was also good but after spending so much money they charged for small bowl of Mayonnaise which is unacceptable. It should be complementary. At the time of payment it was requested to waive small amount but they refused.

Do not recommend such restaurant and such attitude of staff., name_person=Prashant Pandya}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=Very efficient staff and a wide range of dishes on offer. The largest soups on a menu I’ve seen and equally delicious. We tried the broccoli burnt garlic soup and it did not disappoint. The sizzler was very filling and we had to pack some for home.

Very nice quality of food and staff. All vegetarian place, name_person=Zac A}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Visited this place located in Kandivali West and was amazed with the property there it’s in Kandivali club they have outdoor and indoor too.
They have proper hygiene maintained property. Clean tables n glasses.
What I liked the most was is they served water in a very different style glass bottle with mint in the water good idea . I ordered panner kung pao and veg crispy in starter followed by veg Kadhai in main course oops sorry forget the awesome moctails which was blue lagoon guys all the food and coolers were amazing.
Staff hospitality was a1 they are on their toes to serve you.
For people who are looking for great music and drinks with friends can opt for this place.
Highly recommended for friends , couples and family.
They have indoor Ac restaurants who needs peaceful environment for lunch and dinner.
They have sports bar too 3 different places feeling in 1 place., name_person=Vishal Shirke}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=a month ago, review=A good family vegeterian restaurant, and ofcourse bar, food is average (not bad) bit only issue is place is very noisy, people speaks loudly hence u dont get cozy or cool atmosphere, name_person=E Travel Guide}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=This Place has a huge seating arrangements. Even on Sundays you need not wait much in the Queue.
The staff is good and the service is prompt.
This has been my Instant Food Hunger Place
Whenever im in my area and need a good food this Place does the job.
Sizzlers are the Best
They have wide range of food menu.
The only thing thats a problem is the Price
I find it bit Overpriced/expensive.
But a Must try Place, name_person=nagda meet}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Decent place to eat and food quality and service was awesome}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Food quality, quantity and variety of menu of this restaurant is unbeatable.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=There are lot of options for soups, starters , italian, mexican and chinese.}"]

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a week ago, review=The Villa Exotic is a must-visit! The food was delicious, and the service was prompt and polite. What really sets this place apart, though, is the ambience—it’s just beautiful and sets the perfect mood for the evening. Whether you are going for a date or a family dinner, this spot is a winner., name_person=Vishal Soni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Vegetarian menu is not just an afterthought here; it's a star in itself! Each dish I tried was bursting with fresh flavors and expertly prepared. What really stood out, besides the incredible taste, was the portion size – perfectly adequate without being wasteful. Adding to the overall enjoyment was the very nice ambiance, which created a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. A truly satisfying and delicious vegetarian dining experience. I'll definitely be back!, name_person=Pratik Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=30-60 min}, time_line=3 months ago, review=The Villa Exotic Sips & Cuisine in Borivali West, Chiku Wadi is truly one of the best restaurants in the area. The menu offers a wide variety of cuisines – from authentic Indian flavors to continental dishes – all cooked to perfection and served with great presentation. Their exotic mocktails and drinks are a must-try and pair beautifully with the food.

The service at this restaurant is excellent. The staff is polite, attentive, and ensures that every guest has a wonderful dining experience. The ambiance is stylish yet cozy, making it a perfect place for family dinners, casual outings with friends, or even a romantic date night.

Located conveniently near Chiku Wadi in Borivali West, the restaurant is easy to find and has a welcoming vibe. The Villa Exotic Sips & Cuisine is highly recommended if you are searching for the best restaurant in Borivali West, whether for multi-cuisine dining, exotic beverages, or top-notch service.

📍 Address: The Villa Exotic Sips & Cuisine, Borivali West, Chiku Wadi, name_person=HusbandCanCook}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=We recently visited Villa Exotic to celebrate my dad’s birthday, and I must say it’s one of the best places to go with family for special occasions. From the moment we arrived, the experience was 5 out of 5 across every category.

The service was excellent, and we were pleasantly surprised to get a spacious private room since we were a group of 10. The staff managed everything smoothly, making the celebration feel special and well-organized.

A big tip: if you're planning to go on a Saturday or Sunday, make sure to book at least 30 minutes in advance to avoid waiting, although they do have a nice waiting area arranged as well.

The ambiance is great for family gatherings, with lovely spots to click pictures and create memories. The food was delicious, and the whole vibe of the place made it perfect for the occasion.

Would highly recommend Villa Exotic to other families whether it’s for a birthday, anniversary, or just a nice family dinner out!, name_person=Donal Sanghvi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=a week ago, review=Food is good
But fancy names
Things are same like any other restaurants
Serving presentation is good
Specially soups are very good(non Chinese)
Staff is a concern
The waiters and serving staff are polite
But the ones with a upper level have a bit of air
Specially "Mandar"
He just wanted us to gulp the food down out throat, pay the bill and just leave.
In service industry along with food it matters a lot who is at ur table.
Make sure he isnt around and rest will be just fine., name_person=shahid sheikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=6 months ago, review=The restaurant, location and food tastes good
Services are good
Vegetarian and jain food serving
Prices are not cheaper.
Must try wonton tarts
And pizza and khow sey is good
Huge area lift and wheels chair available., name_person=Jasmina Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=9 months ago, review=We went for Lunch. At 1pm not crowdy. When we left at 2pm, it was full.
The very first impression was RUDE Welcome. ( For motorist). We will park but no responsibility. Better you park your self was the standy msg at gate.
Great food.
Quick service.
Courteous staff.
Found first floor seating very conjusted.
No buttermilk served. Surprising., name_person=JAGJIVAN SAVLA}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Villa Exotic Veg Sip and Cuisine offers a delightful dining experience with its fusion of traditional Indian flavors and modern presentation—the butter paneer is rich and aromatic, the garlic naan perfectly crisp, and vegetarian dishes like veg tikka and dal makhani are equally satisfying. The ambience is warm and inviting, with rustic wooden décor, soft lighting, and a thoughtfully designed layout that provides both comfort and privacy, enhanced by the visual appeal of an open kitchen. Service is top-notch, with attentive, courteous staff who are well-versed in the menu and quick to accommodate special requests, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable meal from start to finish. Overall, it’s a must-visit spot for anyone seeking flavorful vegetarian food, a cozy setting, and excellent hospitality., name_person=Rishabh Shukla}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The staff was a bit rigid but the ambience and atmosphere was cool & classy!}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Manager Kaeam singh Sandip Mahta very good service ,good food good environment.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Very good restaurant 😃 tasted different varieties from starter to desserts.}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a month ago, review=It’s a bar, not a cafe. The reviews had us fooled because it’s tagged as a restaurant/cafe, so we confidently asked if they had milk tea or masala chai, and the staff looked understandably confused. They didn’t have it, of course, but the desserts made up for it.

Here’s my warning though: do not order the honey fried noodles with ice cream if you’re alone. It’s not a dessert; it’s a full-on group project. I somehow finished it myself, and I think that officially qualifies as the largest dessert I’ve ever eaten in one sitting.

When we went around 8 p.m., the place was quite almost empty which I’m guessing isn’t their peak hour. The decor though? Beautifully done. I can imagine it transforms completely once the crowd comes in later at night. Definitely a spot worth visiting if you’re looking for a good evening place in Mira road, name_person=Anugraha Ghale}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=7 months ago, review=The food was decent—not extraordinary, but satisfying. Definitely recommend this restaurant for seafood and goan food lover., name_person=Sachin Vishwakarma}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=a year ago, review=Good option for Non veg food. Huge sitting areas for family, friends with A/c and Non A/c option.

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=My recent visit to Spin City Kitchen & Bar was an experience of frustrating contrasts, leaving me with mixed feelings that are hard to reconcile.

Let's start with the positive. The atmosphere is undoubtedly appealing; it's a stylish, modern space with a nice vibe that makes a good first impression. This was complemented by genuinely good service. Our server was attentive, friendly, and efficient, ensuring our glasses were never empty and checking in on us at just the right times.

However, these positives were significantly overshadowed by the venue's major drawback: its size. The place is simply too small for the crowd it attracts. Tables are crammed uncomfortably close together, making private conversation nearly impossible and creating a constant, cramped feeling. The noise level was high, and navigating to the restroom felt like an obstacle course.

Unfortunately, the most disappointing aspect was the food, which I found to be below average. While presented nicely, my main course was underseasoned and lacked the freshness and flavour I expected for the price. It felt like a dish going through the motions without any passion or precision.

In conclusion, Spin City has a great foundation with its pleasant atmosphere and excellent staff. But until the significant issues of cramped seating and, most critically, the subpar kitchen offerings are addressed, it's difficult to recommend for anything more than a quick, crowded drink., name_person=Vimall P Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Visited Spin City Kitchen & Bar recently and here’s how the overall experience went. Firstly, the vibe of the place was really welcoming — warm lighting, upbeat crowd, and the highlight definitely being the live music session, which they host on weekends. The singer truly added a great energy to the evening!

However, the service left much to be desired. We had to wait for around 45 minutes just to get our starters, and even during that long wait, the mocktails we had ordered didn't arrive. When they did come, the mocktails (Hawai Punch, Virgin Blue Lagoon, and Pink Panther) were quite average — drinkable, but nothing memorable.

Moving on to the food: In starters, we tried the Hara Bhara Kebab, Punjabi Lasooni Chicken, and Murgh Lucknowi Seekh Kebab — all of which were flavorful and enjoyable. But again, the delay in service really dampened the mood.

For mains, I had specifically ordered Veg Pesto Pasta, but they mistakenly got Pink Sauce Pasta instead. Though they did correct it, it took a couple more minutes and by then, it slightly interrupted the dining flow. The Thai Wok Chicken Fried Rice was good and had a decent wok-tossed flavor to it.

Dessert was a mix of highs and lows. The Honey Noodles with Ice Cream was quite disappointing — lacked crunch, and the balance of sweetness was off. But on the other hand, the Sizzling Brownie was absolutely worth it — gooey, rich, and served perfectly hot.

To sum it up, the ambiance and live music were the strongest aspects, but the slow service and a few mix-ups with orders brought the overall experience down. Food had its moments, but could definitely improve. When I went with my family at 9:30 pm, we had to wait for 20 minutes to get a table.

The restaurant has both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating. We chose outdoor seating as air-conditioned seating area was fully occupied. But the tables on the left side did not seem suitable for four people, they were comfortable for only two people.

During my visits, I tried Pav Bhaji, Watermelon Juice, Filter Coffee, Triple Schezwan Fried Rice, Masala Dosa, Veg Mille-Jullie, Roti, Jeera Rice, and Sizzling Brownie. The Filter Coffee was good. The Pav Bhaji was made less spicy for a younger diner and was prepared just right. The Triple Schezwan Fried Rice was very good with a lot of vegetables. The food quality is good, the portions are reasonable, but the prices are slightly high. The service is slow and we had to ask more than once for basic things like spoons or water.

They just had it printed and stuck on a few walls — easy to miss unless you spot it yourself. If the offer is closed, it should be removed from the app to avoid misleading customers.

Another uncomfortable part was that one of the waiters kept staring at us, especially at one of my friends. It made things really awkward and unprofessional.

What we ordered:
- Masala Papad
- Teriyaki Chicken Starter ✅
- Soya Sattu Kebab ❌ (skip)
- Paneer Lababdar ✅
- Tandoori Roti
- Jeera Rice
- Brownie & Vanilla Milkshake ✅
- Pineapple Mint ❌ (skip)
- Watermelon & Honey Dew
- Caramel custard

Food verdict:
Overall, the taste was decent.

In Mocktails -
Phosphorescence: Citric flavours of lime, orange and lemone that adds a great palette cleanser.
Fresh Juices - Watermelon and Lime was truly amazing

Dahi ke Kebab was amazing both in portion size and the quality of ingredients.
Murgh Malai Kaali Mirch Tikka was cooked to perfection. Special mention to their presentation and choice of dips.

Agilo Olio Spaghetti with Chicken was truly the star of the evening. A perfect main course that indulges you in the Italian style of cooking spaghetti with olive oil that suits the Indian palette.

Gulab Jamun with Vanilla Icecream as our dessert to end the meal on a sweeter note was simply awesome., name_person=Rajesh Chhabda}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Caramel_Custard, Masala_Papad, Mukhwas], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Food was extremely mediocre

Infact we were given a table exactly opposite the washroom

Overall if you are left with no choice ONLY THEN OPT FOR THIS PLACE, name_person=Siya Malkani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 years ago, review=I'm in awe of this restaurant. The servers have complete knowledge of the menu. They are attentive and friendly. Service is pretty quick.

Appetizers:
1. Subzi Bhara Aloo Tandoori
Potatos cooked in Tandoor and stuffed with veggies and cheese. It was lip smacking.

2. Makhmali Cheesy Kebab (MUST TRY)
These were stuffed chicken kebabs topped with cheesy. They served it with green chutney and mustard sauce. You would be surprised at how well the kebabs and mustard sauce tastes together. It's a must try.

Beverages (Mocktails):
3. Watermelon & Honey View (MUST TRY)
It was so refreshing. It tasted like watermelon milkshake.

4. Alphonse
It is a thick shake - vibrant and refreshing

Mains:
5. Mac N Cheese Macaroni
It is served with two pieces of bread. It is delicious and very creamy.

If you love Thai curry, you must try this. It is flavorful and you would keep craving for more. The after taste has a hint of spiciness.

Dessert:
7. Gulab Jamun with Vanila Ice Cream

The portion size is pretty good. It's a must visit. Food & Drinks
We tried a variety of dishes, and overall, the food quality was impressive.

Tom Yum Chicken – While it had a good balance of spice and warmth, the lemongrass flavor could have been more prominent. It leaned a bit too much toward tangy and lemony, which slightly overpowered the dish.

Chicken Burnt garlic Kebab – This was a standout dish! The fresh burnt garlic flavor complemented the tender, well-cooked chicken beautifully, making it one of our favorites.

Green Thai Curry – A comforting and flavorful dish with a smooth coconut-based sauce. Traditionally served with jasmine rice, but here it came with buttered rice, which was a nice twist and added richness to the dish.

Prawns Kurkure & Cheesy French Fries – Both were well-made, with the prawns being crispy and well-seasoned, and the fries having a great cheesy indulgence.

We also tried a few of their mocktails, and they were refreshing and well-presented:

Lemongrass Cooler – A fresh and soothing drink with a citrusy punch. The lemongrass flavor was subtle yet noticeable.

Guava Beach – This was a delightful tropical drink with a sweet and slightly tangy guava base. It had a well-balanced taste, neither too sugary nor too sour, making it an easy and enjoyable sip. (The best amongst three)

Mango Boots – A rich and creamy mango-based drink that was both refreshing and indulgent.

Ambiance & Service
The ambiance was undoubtedly one of the highlights, with a relaxing rooftop setup. However, the biggest downside was the repetitive music playlist. We stayed for about two and a half hours, and the same songs played multiple times, which became a bit annoying. When we asked if it could be changed, we were told it wasn’t possible for the staff to do so. Also we wanted to try their Bao but we were told that it wasn't available. That was a minor drawback in an otherwise pleasant experience.

The service was good, with staff being attentive and ensuring we had everything we needed.
Price was Reasonable for the quality of food and setting
Would definitely visit again! During my recent visit to Adda heist I was thoroughly impressed by both the ambiance and the culinary experience. Located in the heart of the city, this restaurant offers a perfect blend of traditional flavors and modern presentation.

The décor is warm and inviting, with soft lighting and rustic wooden furniture that create a cozy atmosphere. The service was exceptional—our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and offered great recommendations.

Now, onto the food! We started with the Tandoori Paneer Skewers, which were perfectly grilled and had a smoky, flavorful marinade. For the main course, I opted for the Butter Chicken with Garlic Naan, while my companion tried the Paneer Tikka Masala. The butter chicken was rich and creamy, with a perfect balance of spices, and the naan was soft yet crisp. The portion sizes were generous, making it great value for money.

For dessert, we couldn’t resist the Gulab Jamun Cheesecake, a delightful fusion that combined the richness of Indian sweets with the smooth texture of cheesecake—an absolute must-try!

The only minor drawback was the slightly long wait time, but considering the quality of the food, it was well worth it. Prices are reasonable for the experience offered, making The Spice Haven a great spot for both casual dining and special occasions.

Overall, I’d highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for authentic Indian flavors with a modern twist. I’ll definitely be coming back!

The restaurant is located right by the shore \u2013 on clear days and during low tide, you can literally drive up close to the entry gate, with the sea just a few steps away.\\n\\nReaching the place, however, can be tricky during high tide. You\u2019ll need to leave your vehicle on the main road and walk through a small trail shaded by big trees. Keep travelling, keep eating, keep Clicking., name_person=chirag kale}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Coolest hangout place in Versova.!

Sunday evening at this place and it was absolutely sorted. Place with very good vibes and delicious food. It was lively and packed on Sunday night too.!

Talking about ambience! Place is themed using amazing old is gold concept.! That wooden entrance really gives a feeling of it being so old.! Few tables with that old steel bag, lantern shped lights, everything was very good and eye catchy. Place is spacious with both indoor and outdoor seating arrangements.! Indoor was with Amazing wall arts, mini bar counter, more peaceful with soft music.! Out seating is amazing and very lively, very comfortable table seating with dimmed lights and a vertical garden in the corners.! Outdoor seating area is very large compared to the indoor one! Overall I found it to be very comfortable and soothing place.

Staff and service! Service was absolutely speedy and we just loved the timely availability of appetizers with our drinks and other things like cleanliness etc.! Staff was very polite and welcoming, Mr. Brendon was taking care of our table and he really did his job perfectly. I must say excellent and well trained staff.!

Dishes & Drinks, place offers amazing deals on booze. They do serve some lip smacking starters and I just falled in love with paneer makhni gravy.! We could try lot of food stuffs accompanied with refreshing drinks, everything was super delicious.

Aloo channa chat: this special salad was simply amazing. Boiled black chickpeas, deep fried squared potato pieces tossed with bell pepper, raw mango and tomatoes.! It really tasted different than a regular salad and definitely a good choice to accompany drinks.!
*** Highly recommended ***

Bombay Vadapav: deep fried meshed potato pattice served with fresh pav, chili mint dip, freshly cut onions, green chillies and garlic powder. It really gives a feeling of street food and was delectable.!

Pav bhaji sandwich: Mumbais famous dishes pav bhaji and sandwich clubbed to form this one.! It was very buttery, sandwich was grilled perfectly.! Bhaji tasted spicy and had a good texture too.! Was served along with fries.

Other appetizers like Garlic mushrooms, which was fresh mushrooms Sliced and tossed with finely chopped garlic was lip smacking. Paneer chilli, fresh paneer tossed in spicy sauces with exotic bell peppers, was upto the mark.
We could also try their chilli cheese toast! This one was baked to perfection with proper amount of cheese and chillies, served with ketchup! Good option to accompany chilled beer.!

Some refreshing and few alcoholic drinks that we could try at this place really delighted us and gave a good high.

Strawberry & pink Guava: real guava crush with strawberry syrup, topped with canned juices, taste was good and combination was little tangy.!

*** Highly Recommended ***

Madh Island lit: very strong taste of rum, try this only if you have built a taste of rum already.! For me this one was like a perfect drink, rum plus soda plus ice plus lemons and it was like wow.! Just enjoyed this very strong drink along with good gravies.!

Paneer Makhni with Naan: this one was the best dish at this place. Paneer was very soft, fresh and gravy was really very buttery as it should be in case of makhni. Obviously it was sweet as it should be. Taste, texture everything was just exceptional. It was served with butter naan.
***Highly Recommended ***

Pasta Alfredo: wow this was prepared with great attention it seemed, everything was in perfect proportion and tasted really good. Use of veggies, cheese and penny pasta in proper proportion makes pasta amazing. And this one was really very good.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=This place is quite popular and is usually packed during both lunch and dinner, so making a reservation is a must. This was my second visit here, and of course we ordered their signature Railway Curry it never disappoints.

This time we also tried:
Mutton Cutlet
Mini Idlis
Veg Cutlet
Beef Roast with Lemon Rice
Egg Appams
Fried prawns

The mini idlis with ghee were absolutely delicious, and the beef roast was our next favourite.
Fried prawns was crispy and had a balanced taste.

I had high expectations from the mutton cutlet, but it didn’t quite live up to the hype. The lemon rice and egg appam were also slightly on the sweeter side, which didn’t go too well with our palate.

Their chutneys are amazing though definitely a highlight!

The staff is extremely warm and courteous, and the ambience is lovely. They even have a pet dog at the restaurant, but do be careful as it may suddenly run up or try to bite if you get too close.

Overall, a charming place with great service and some standout dishes, but a few items could be improved taste-wise., name_person=yasmeen sayad}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Private_dining_room, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_PRIVATE_DINING_ROOM], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Good food, reasonable drinks and fine environment.

Fried potatoes are good as starters, ghee roast chicken was fine (oota Bangalore beats it though). Gold member drink was awesome!! Nella… drink was good as well, but a pink drink was not that good (forgot the name).

Great place for a fine family meal., name_person=Divya Jain}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Excellent honest good South Indian food outside the usual boundaries of dosas and idlis. The appams were perfectly soft with crisp edges, and the parathas were flaky and delicious. The mutton stew was the highlight – tender, comforting, and beautifully cooked in a light coconut base. Overall, a warm and flavour-packed dining experience. Dal Khichadi and Choley Palak Biryani in mains and Sizzling brownie. Food was tasty Malai Paneer Tikka was awesome Soup was also very good.
Choley Palak Biryani is a must try. Overall a good place to have dinner with family., name_person=Shridhar Zalki}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Looking for a restaurant with pure Indian Tadka to it???
Urbantadka is here in the town and must say an allrounder restro !!!!!!

Talking about the ambience KUDDOS👍👍👍 to  UrbanTadka  Felt so refreshing the moment i entered it.
Music being played around , dim lights truely enjoyed the overalll environment.
My order was as follows to start with Refreshments : SUN BREEZE and AFTER GLOW were the two Mocktails i had chosen and talking about them one word just WOW!!!!!!! I suggest you all to try them but they have several other in their menu including LIQUIOR as well.
STARTERS: MURG TIKKA & KALIMIRI MURG TIKKA  to be honest i have tried murg items else where but the taste here was on to the next level. Both this dishes were in red masala my favourite.Chicken was cooked so well with great mixture of spices and masala. Both these dishes can be served for 2 people i am sure you all gonna be full in it.
MAIN COURSE: This time i decided to go for NIMBU CHICKEN BONELESS SPICY gravy with BUTTER NAAN and TANDOORI ROTI other than some pizzas and all but must say truely worth it.
Firstly i thought its gonna be alike Butter chicken but here the taste was really very different with a pinch of lemonish flavour added. Chicken tasted so delicious and being boneless the masala and spice was properly added and mixed with it.
To sum up and explode the stomach could not stop myself from ordering ZINGA BIRYANI not a great fan of it but after having it here must say it has become my go to dish!!!!! Prawns were so tasty and rice was well cooked over steam served with raita Altogether loved it alot.
And when it comes to DESSERT with no doubt i ordered  JALEBI with RABDI. Jalebi was perfect in taste and was served hot which was not that sweet and actually how it should be. No words for the Rabdi truely still drooling over it.
Overall it was a great experience visiting this place where all dishes are prepared with so much of love, staff being so helpful I am sure you all will be filled with the vibes which will make you forget all damn things.
Go give it a try guyz and get your cravings fullfilled now.
You can also place your order now on Zomato and as they have several outlets in mumbai as well. As first-timers to Bengali cuisine, we were a little unsure of what to order, but any hesitation we had was immediately put to rest.

The moment we stepped in, we were welcomed with genuine warmth, setting the tone for the entire evening. What truly stood out was the exceptional service. The waiting staff was not just attentive; they were passionate and knowledgeable. They took their time to patiently explain each dish on the menu, guiding us through the flavors and ingredients with great detail.

Following their advice, we settled for the Thali (both veg and non-veg). This was the perfect choice! It allowed us to sample a wide array of traditional preparations, and we were pleasantly impressed by the incredible variety and, most importantly, the stunning freshness of every single item. Each dish in the thali was a burst of authentic flavor, showcasing the depth and diversity of Bengali cooking.
From the delicate prawn curry to the robust mutton and vegetarian dishes and the perfect balance of sweet and savory, every bite was a discovery.
Oh Calcutta is, without a doubt, a must-visit place for anyone looking to experience true Bengali cuisine in a welcoming and professional setting. We left not just with full stomachs, but with a newfound appreciation for the food. We are already looking forward to going there again, name_person=Sandip Samani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Oh! Calcutta, Andheri – A True Bengali Feast in Mumbai

I dropped by Oh! Calcutta in Andheri for a late lunch, and honestly, it was one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in a while.

The restaurant is easy to find—right on the highway—and the vibe hits you as soon as you walk in. It’s warm, inviting, and has that polished-but-comfortable feel. When I was seated, I noticed these gorgeous white plates with vintage Bengali prints—they looked stunning and added a nice touch to the setting. Sadly, they’re just for show; you can’t actually eat off them. Still, great visual detail that sets the mood.

I was attended to immediately, seated without any delay, and the service from there on was top-notch. The waiter was not only attentive but genuinely helpful—he patiently answered all my questions and even walked me through their specials.

I started with the Calcutta Bhetki Fish Fry—boneless, buttery soft, and packed with flavor. It came with a mustard sauce and a curd-onion mix that completely stole the show. I even asked for a second helping of that mix—it was that good.

Next came the Gondhoraj Shorbot, made with a special lemon sourced from Bengal. The waiter recommended it, and I’m glad I listened. Refreshing, light, and a total palate cleanser. A hidden gem.

Then came the heavy hitters: Calcutta Mutton Biryani and Mutton Kosha. I’d always wanted to try their Kosha, but usually with luchi. This time, I asked if it would pair well with biryani, and the waiter said, “That’s the best combo.” He wasn’t wrong. The mutton kosha was incredible—thick, rich gravy with melt-in-the-mouth mutton. Easily the best I’ve ever had. And the biryani? Subtle, fragrant, and uniquely Bengali, with tender mutton, a boiled egg, and that signature baked potato. It’s not your typical masala-heavy biryani—it’s an acquired taste, but one I’ve come to love thanks to my Bengali friends over the years.

For dessert, I went with the Baked Rosogolla—another hit. The portion was smaller than expected, but it packed a punch. Baked with rabdi, it was warm, comforting, and a perfect end to the meal. Oh, and they even offered a complimentary paan on the way out. Nice touch.

Final verdict? Easily one of the best Bengali restaurants in Mumbai. Everything—from service to flavor—was on point. I’m already looking forward to my next visit., name_person=Prasad K}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Raita_Kashundi_&_Cucumber, Bengali_Veh_Thali, Begun_Bhaja], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Step into the rich flavours of Bengal... at Oh! ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We tried almost everything at Road House Bluez, and honestly, it lived up to the hype! We sat on the second floor, which had a nice chill vibe, but we also hopped down later to check out the karaoke night on the first floor — super fun energy!

The food was absolutely delicious — we loved the keema variants, pizza and the tandoori platter in particular. The cocktails were equally impressive; the classic mojito and signature Bluez special are must-tries. The ambience is on point—super aesthetic, perfect for a laid-back hangout, or even to wind down after a hectic workday. Whether you're enjoying a chilled beer, catching up with friends, or just vibing with the music, this place has it all.

They’ve recently introduced Drifters Brewing Company’s beers, which are a must-try. With unique flavors like Basmati Blonde, German Lager, and Belgian White, paired perfectly with their amazing starters and snacks (aka chakna), you’ll be hooked from the first sip. The taste is on another level!

The real highlight, though, is the karaoke experience. It’s not just singing—it’s about creating those unforgettable moments with your crew. There’s something magical about holding a mic in one hand and a cold drink in the other, belting out your favorite tunes. The staff are friendly, and the service is top-notch, making it feel even more like home.

If you’re in the area, make sure this place is on your list. 10/10 for the overall vibe, drinks, food, and karaoke fun!, name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=Great KJ! I've been to a lot of great karaoke places and this was the first time seeing a bouncer at the front door with an owner or something saying stags not allowed. Let people come have fun and sing! The KJ has no grip on order, timing or mood. Songs jump all over the place with zero logic. Slow, fast, random, confused. The bar is another headache. The bartender acts like handing over a glass of water is a personal insult. One minute he insists you must buy a bottle, the next someone else gets water for free. The servers are the only ones doing their jobs properly. Everything above them feels disorganised, uninterested and weirdly hostile for a place that’s supposed to be fun. This restaurant is truly a hidden gem, offering an unparalleled taste of the coast that transports you straight to the shores of Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg. It's the kind of place you visit when you crave authentic, home-style seafood and fiery curries.
The highlight here is, without a doubt, the seafood. The fish is always incredibly fresh—a mandatory requirement for any great coastal establishment. I highly recommend starting with the Bombil Fry (Bombay Duck) or the Surmai Fry. The coating is perfectly crisp, and the marinade is a flawless blend of chili, turmeric, and spice. For the main course, the Prawn Curry Thali is a masterpiece; rich, coconut-based gravy that pairs perfectly with the soft, fluffy Vade (puri made from rice and lentil flour). If you prefer meat, the Chicken Malvani Thali is equally robust and satisfying.
Beyond the main courses, don't miss out on the incredible Solkadhi. This kokam-based digestive drink is creamy, tangy, and absolutely essential for cooling the palate after the spicy Konkani flavors. It’s one of the best I've had outside of a Konkani home.
The ambiance is simple, clean, and unpretentious, allowing the focus to remain solely on the food, as it should be. The staff is warm, helpful, and eager to offer recommendations, making the entire dining experience feel incredibly homely. If you love coastal flavors, fresh fish, and authentic Malvani spices, Konkan Swad is a must-visit destination in Jogeshwari. The decor is quite lovely with white and blue and is pleasant to the eyes mostly during day time than during night. Most the tables outside are high chair and I choose one. The staff was very warm and friendly.

We ordered our whiskey and picked up chicken with garlic and sun dried tomatoes served in smoked olive chilly oil. The taste was magnificent and we really enjoyed it. We followed it with Ravolli pasta in white sauce. It was delicious. We also ordered potato wedges. The portion was quite good thus order if you are in a group of 4

The price of the drinks are like any other restaurants there were no offers except for gin which we did not choose. Thus drink cautiously else your bill night hit the roof.

The music gets louder after 1030 pm and then speaking can become a bit difficult. But that’s when people get into the groove and start dancing. They made an error in the bill which we spotted and was quickly corrected. Thus keep an eye on the bill before paying

Had an amazing time at Barley Bistro Bar, and I’m so glad I chose this place for my recent visit. As an influencer, I always look for spots that offer great food, a photogenic vibe, and quality service — and Barley Bistro Bar checked every box!

Food & Drinks:
I started with their Paneer Manchurian Chili Dry – crispy, spicy, and full of flavor – and their Margherita Pizza, which had the perfect thin crust with fresh basil and gooey cheese.

For drinks, I tried their Red Wine and Pina Colada. The wine was smooth and served at the right temperature, and the Pina Colada was creamy, tropical, and refreshing – an absolute treat!

For the main course, I ordered the Paneer Afghani, Matka Biryani, Kadhai Paneer, and Butter Naan. Every dish was rich in flavor and perfectly cooked. The Paneer Afghani was creamy and mildly spiced, while the Kadhai Paneer had a bold and aromatic masala. The Matka Biryani was a highlight – served beautifully and packed with taste!

Ambience:
The interiors are modern and cozy with just the right lighting for pictures and reels. Aesthetically pleasing corners, soothing music, and a welcoming vibe make it ideal for both content creators and casual diners.

Service:
The staff was extremely courteous, helpful with recommendations, and made sure everything was served on time. They were also supportive during content creation, which I truly appreciated.

Final Verdict:
Barley Bistro Bar is a must-visit in Mumbai for anyone who loves good food, creative drinks, and a great atmosphere. Highly recommended for foodies and fellow content creators alike.
