Otherwise place, nice decor, the staff does tell us when the food is very authentic and not of our taste, which is a nice thing., name_person=Honest Table India}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservation required, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=7 months ago, review=Kofuku, Andheri West – A Perfect Fusion of Japanese & Korean Flavors

Located in the heart of Andheri West, Kofuku is a stunning blend of aesthetics and authenticity. With its serene ambiance and traditional touches, it offers a beautiful space to unwind — ideal for a romantic evening or a relaxed outing with friends. The interiors reflect a calming Japanese charm, complete with minimalist décor and warm lighting, setting the mood for a culturally rich dining experience.

🍸 Drinks: A Sensory Delight
We began our meal with some exceptional cocktails and mocktails:

Kimchi Kick Cocktail – A perfect balance of flavor and spice with impressive presentation. It stood out not only for its bold taste but also for the creative way it was served. My friend absolutely loved it too.
Buddha Bliss – Unique and refreshing, this cocktail brought together subtle flavors in a truly blissful mix.
Sakura (Mocktail) – Visually stunning and light on the palate, this mocktail was a favorite for its floral notes and elegant presentation.
Pinku no Yokubo – Another standout, both in taste and aesthetics. A must-try if you're looking for something different.
🍣 Starters & Sushi: Art on a Plate
Ebi Tempura Roll Sushi – This was a highlight. The presentation was elegant, and the tempura was perfectly crisp. The flavors were balanced and absolutely delicious.
Rock Shrimp – Cooked to perfection, juicy and flavorful. This dish had a great texture and was well-seasoned.
Tteokbokki Chicken – A Korean classic done right. Spicy, chewy, and flavorful with a presentation that matched its taste.
🍛 Main Course: Flavorful & Filling
Chef’s Special Japanese Curry – Rich, comforting, and beautifully presented. The curry had depth and warmth — everything you'd expect from a chef’s signature dish.
Korean-Style Chicken Mandu – These dumplings were unique in flavor, with a perfect outer texture and a delicious filling inside. A great introduction to Korean appetizers.
Korean Stir Fry Noodles (Chicken) – A flavorful and hearty dish. The noodles were cooked perfectly and packed with savory notes. We really enjoyed this one.
🍰 Desserts: A Sweet Finish
Japanese Cheesecake – Light, fluffy, and delicately sweet. It was a delightful way to end the meal. The presentation was also spot-on.
Molten Chocolate Cake – Rich, gooey, and absolutely indulgent. The chocolate oozed out perfectly, and it was a hit among all of us.
⭐ Service & Overall Experience
The service at Kofuku was exceptional. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and helped guide us through the menu with genuine warmth. Everything — from the food and drinks to the ambiance and hospitality — was top-notch.

Overall Rating: 🌟 10/10

If you're a fan of Japanese and Korean cuisine, Kofuku is a must-visit. With multiple outlets across India, it's easily accessible — but the Andheri West branch stands out for its vibe, flavor, and experience. Whether it's your first time trying Asian cuisine or you're already a fan, Kofuku delivers on all fronts., name_person=amin shaikh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Had the most pleasant experience at Kofuku, Andheri West. We went with the salad not the soup so commenting only on those.
The good

The Double A salad was amazing. The portion was small but it packed a punch
The veg Tempura sushi was as nice and crunchy.
The spicy corn dumplings were nice and juicy
The blue pea rice was buttery and great
The veg in oyster sauce was lovely

The not so good

The Thai me up salad very very sweet
The avacado sushi was very bland
The sriracha chicken dumplings were dry
The veg yellow curry was super sweet
The noodles portion was good but it was too dry

The disaster

Please do not go for the snickers nut crunch as the dessert. It’s sickly sweet and super tiny.

All in the all the food is average. Not sure if it’s value for money, the portion sizes are too small to really enjoy the entire meal and feel satiated but the service is superb and the place lovely.  They even gave us some candies as a way to end the meal., name_person=Lavanya Anand}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Fresh, flavorful & beautifully crafted. He kindly mentored us on how to use chopsticks correctly - which I failed miserably at ;) and also helped us with some excellent recommendations - keeping our taste preferences in mind. This being my b'day celebration - as a sweet gesture, they served us with a special dessert, on the house, which made our dining experience - extra memorable!!
So whether you're a sushi afficionado or trying Japanese food for the first time, FOO won't disappoint. :), name_person=Vinita Kudtarkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations recommended, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Foo was supposed to be an extravagant experience but it turned out meh. However, the Tempura Sushi didn’t meet my expectations—especially when compared to the quality I’ve experienced at Foo, Andheri. It lacked that freshness and finesse I was looking forward to.

Before visiting, I had called to check if I could book the swing table, but they said they don’t take reservations and only accept walk-ins. They assured me the swing table would be available.

To my surprise, when I reached around 12 PM (the time they open), the swing table was already occupied. I still don’t know how it was taken even though I walked in right at their opening time. I wanted to leave then and there, but since it was my birthday, I chose not to spoil my day.

The place looks beautiful. It’s definitely Instagram-worthy. I chose another table and ordered the Grilled Chicken Sizzler. It looked nice when it arrived, but when I requested the staff to serve it, they told me that it’s a self-service café & bar. This really confused me because I have been to many casual dining places and ordered sizzlers, but this was the first time I was expected to serve it myself.

After finishing the sizzler, I requested the bill and saw that they had included a service charge along with GST. I asked the staff to remove the service charge because there was no service provided, apart from handing us the glasses and plates. I also asked if I could speak to the manager. The staff member told me she would get the service charge removed, and I was okay with that.

A few minutes later, the manager came to our table. I told him about the experience I had dining at this café. He listened and then allotted us the swing table towards the end of the meal. I sat there for a bit, and they gave me a complimentary rose cheesecake, which was good. I had a bite, but I wasn’t in the mood to eat anymore, so I asked them to pack it.

When the final bill came, the service charge was still there. I didn’t have the energy to argue again, so I just paid and left.

I am totally disappointed, and I would not like to visit this place again.

The reality here is far more disappointing and genuinely annoying.
SEATING ARRANGEMENT: The Advance Booking Penalty (0/5)
We were a group of five, spending a total of ₹2,831. We specifically reserved seats through Zomato and paid a ₹500 advance to ensure a good experience.
In return, we were given the most uncomfortable, low-slung seats imaginable. The table was awkwardly low compared to the chairs, making it impossible to eat comfortably.
0/5 Rating for giving such a terrible seating arrangement even after an advance booking. You penalize your paying customers for reserving!
FOOD: Looks vs. Reality (Pocket Breaking & Tasteless)
The food looks tempting for a photo, but the moment you taste it, the high cost feels like a pocket-breaking insult. Everything was severely lacking in flavor and quality.
1. Thai Basil Cottage Cheese Bau (₹545 for 3 piece):
Dry, Tasteless Disaster. The paneer stuffing was decent but dry. The outer layer (which I assume was maida) was tasteless and super dry.
It desperately needed a sauce. They served us a microscopic cup of Schezwan sauce when asked. Seriously?
2. Burrata Pizza (₹830 for 6 slice):
The Most Bland Pizza Ever. The Burrata cheese tasted exactly like makhan (homemade butter) Indian moms skim off while making ghee.
Never imagine a pizza could taste this bad while charging ₹830. Respect to Dominos and Eva's Pizza—you deliver actual, good pizza.
3. Mango Matcha Latte (₹475 for one small glass):
HORRIBLE. You ruined matcha. I was excited for my friend to try matcha for the first time, and this concoction was an absolute offense.
Believe me, people, matcha tastes better than this. You need to drastically improve this recipe.
4. Pomegranate POP (₹395 for one glass):
A Flat, Overpriced Joke. It was essentially just soda, over-squeezed lemon, and a faint hint of pomegranate. No sugar, no flavor, just disappointment.
5. Peri Peri Fries (₹275):
The ONLY redeemable item. Of course, we had to spend ₹275 for a small bowl of fries, but at least they were hot, seasoned, and actually tasted right.
Conclusion - The Instagram Trap
Overall, the food was not good and severely overpriced. The ambience is achaa (good), of course—it’s only there for the show/visuals.
It seems like your rent is too high, and you are charging customers for low-quality, low-quantity food to cover your costs.
Another day of regretting selecting a restaurant from an Instagram Reel. 👎 Save your money!, name_person=vishwa oza}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The place is a combination of lovely ambiance, great service and fancy food.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Server forgot my starter order, main course suggestion for 3 people was poor.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The Hummus, The Rose Cheesecake, Pizza, Paneer starter super yummy.}"]

Restaurant has good vibes

Bar has  everything with branded wine,whisky & beer 🍺, name_person=RAJENDRA D}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=7 years ago, review=Visited Suswagat last Friday for an farewell lunch of a colleague.

Well i was hoping to share a beer or two, But all of them hesitated to drink. So i had one "Screw Driver", One of my favorite drink to have. Had masala papad with that.

Still got room, So had "Jeera Rice" & "Dal Fry". One of those places were Dal's quantity is more(Unlike lots of other places - It's a mystery). Taste was awesome.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=9 months ago, review=We had booked the avenue for our sangeet & engagement function in December 2024. 200 PAX. While our overall experience was amazing, please read the CONS section!

PROS -
- Amazing location, the area was more than big enough for us. The have one small space and one large space divided, as per your need & party size you can choose one or both.
- Decor was on point. They have their own vendor for the same who has monopoly, but Shweta knows her stuff, and will help you achieve the best possible decor in your budget. Totally Trustworthy, just be clear and detailed in your brief and references
- Food - Bang on. Worth every penny, all of our guests mentioned great stuff & compliments about the food, starters and welcome drinks. On request, the starters where circulated for much longer than the usual time as well. The staff service was very well executed too. Kudos to Subhash sir.

CONS -
- The DJ and lights vendor (Sanjay), who they have appointed, and who has monopoly there, was the only thing that didn't work out for us. As our timing were a little extended due to back to back functions the same day, we were asked to pay for 2 shifts for the DJ. Which we agreed on, also extra amounts where paid for stage lightings as well for Dance performances, as they weren't a part of the DJ or Decor Setup.
- Inspite of paying everything in advance to the said vendor, things werent planned properly. We made a pro active effort of providing all music files for the DJ night and performances well in advance, the DJ was totally unprepared and didn't have any files with him, inspite of everything being shared with him a week prior. By God' s Grace, we had a backup plan with backup pendrives, and yet still the DJ managed to screw things up and didnt play the tracks as per the given order or on time.
- There were 6-7 Pendrives given to the DJ by different parties for the sangeet choreographed performances. We got none of them back
- The DJ was not informed that its a double shift, hence he didn't start the soft music sessions on time. We know this because he actually said to us "Your sangeet and function starts at 6, why do you need music from 4 PM"?. The double shift was booked from 4 PM - 10 PM.
- The vendor (Sanjay)  was very pro active with us, till the payment went to him. Post that, everything was a blunder.
- Of course in our post event feedback we mentioned all of this to the owner. A few days later the said vendor called us on our honeymoon, and had the audacity to say "Aap mera naam kharab kar rahe ho, maine aapko apna best DJ diya tha" :/

So overall, i would say this place is lovely, in terms of the food, venue and decor. But if your event is lights and sangeet based, please have proper meetings with the vendor and meet the DJ well in advance, because we still regret not meeting the DJ personally before our event. Do pay a visit!, name_person=Jatin Shah}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 6 years ago, review=So last night I went here with my couple of friends as I heard alot about this place so we went here in the evening and we ordered:-

We ordered wood fired pizza which was the best thing about our dinner. Cocktails were good but can be better. Other good dish was loaded nachos. Those charcoal flavoured Nachoa were very good.
Place had a comfortable seating arrangement and staff was polite and service was upto the mark.
Their newly launched a pastries were absolutely amazing and must try.
Overall a very good place and can be definitely considered for a place to go., name_person=nidhi pipalia}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Loco Loca is a cordial, lively place located on the ground floor of The Empresa Hotel. The ambiance of this place is characterized by its open air kitchen and it's enticing canopy. The Spanish and Italian folk music playing in the background incites feelings of cravings and euphoria. The place is embellished with an amazing set up in the dining area with spacious seating. On top of that, the dessert bar with an amazing line up of sweet treats and confectionery adds to the charm.

The bistro makes you feel in your element with their camaraderie. The atmosphere of this place and the crew connive to make the customer feel like a huésped as they embrace them to their ménage.

The service was pretty good. Our table was hosted by Mr. Rahul, Mr. Nikhil and Mr. Vishal. They helped us out in selecting the dishes and were very friendly. The restaurant being an part of The Empresa, has to manage the hotel guests along with the adventurous diners who visit the place. So it may take a while to get what you order but the food is totally worth the wait.

They serve a variety of dishes from the Mediterranean and North Indian Cuisine. The menu is pretty elaborate and covers a lot of palatable dishes with top class presentation. The chefs collude to serve appetizing and innovative dishes to appease the diners and bring a smile of satisfaction on their faces.

Our table was festooned with salads, burgers, appetizers, risotto and desserts.
We started off with 'Feta & Co. '. It's a salad constructed with the Greek Feta and a combination of fresh fruits and mixed greens. The salty and tangy taste of Feta combined with the flavours of fresh fruits and avocado makes it one of the finest salads in the menu.

The 'Supreme Crisp Burger' had the perfect cohesiveness between the amount of bun, meat and toppings. It was a merger of the chicken supreme patty, onion rings with the side of potato wedges. The bun was nicely toasted to hold up the patty. The quality of the meat used was top class which made the burger very juicy.
We also had 'Easy green Burger' which was served with a side of potato wedges and salads. It had a delectable taste.

Mediterranean food is more than just pizza and spaghetti, for a change, we ordered 'Grilled Portobello & Asparagus Risotto'. It was ambrosial! Amazing taste. The 'Potato Mille-Feuille' was very appetizing. The combination of fried potatoes and wild mushrooms with parmesan ragoût made it delicious!

We had a few beverages here: 'Passion Fruit Chilli Lemonade' and 'Blueberry & Basil lemonade'. They were very refreshing. The passion fruit chilli tasted really good. It had a spicy twist to it.

They serve some of the most bewitching and delicious desserts. We had 'Hazelnut Mousse' and 'Chocolate Chip Cupcake'. The Hazelnut mousse is one the best desserts I've had in a while. It tasted heavenly with a the base made of chocolate crumbs. The cup cake tasted alright. I liked the Mousse more.

Mediterranean food is one of those cultural elements that have felicitously helped to preserve the special nature of the Mediterranean.
When it comes to Mediterranean Cuine, Loco loca is definitely one of the best places in town., name_person=GLEN MONTEIRO}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=LOCO LOCA

THEN he gave us the menu, Yes AFTER calling for some bottle of drinks!
Ordered Butter Chicken alongwith Tandoori Roti and Butter Naan, Soft Drinks and Papad. Couldn't even eat the Roti, tasted like Dough was Mixed with HAIR ! Management was Very good at pretending not to understand, so had ordered Buttered Naan, since then.

Good sports themed restobar with multiple options of liquor n food and ideally located close to Kandivali station.

We occupied top floor dedicated for fine dining and live sports screening. The ambience and vibes were pleasantly good. Few of the walls are adorned with IPL and football team florescent logos. Small bar area located at the corner. The service and food quality are on the better side.

Analysis

Sundowner mocktail- Elegant mix of citrus juice, cucumber and little mint. Went really smooth with their starters.

Chicken cheese chaska- Chef’s special appetizer made as fried patty of minced chicken and chopper veges. Topped with lots of cheese. Tons of flavors in one dish, must try here.

Veg Dragon rolls- Crispy veg rolls encompassing noodles and exotic veges with spices. Rolls dipped in shezwan sauce and served in vodka glass. Delicious appetizer.

Chicken Dilkhush kabab- Stuffing of minced chicken and dry fruits mix inside of succulent pieces of smoked chicken. Noteworthy appetizer with authentic taste.

Chicken rara- Delightful chicken curry made of aromatic spicy flavoured tomato, onion, grounded chicken based gravy. We paired with onion kulcha and butter naan. Impressive choice in main course.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Royal Challenge in Goregaon East has always carried an iconic reputation — a restaurant known for its history, warmth, and connection to Mumbai’s old glamour. The moment you step inside, you’re greeted by a wall of nostalgia — photographs of Bollywood celebrities from the 80s and 90s, capturing the era when this was the go-to spot for stars and elite patrons. The ambiance still reflects that classic charm — comfortable, elegant, and filled with stories of the city’s golden years.

The food, at first, absolutely lived up to expectations. Every dish we ordered tasted fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. The seasoning was balanced, the portions generous, and the presentation impressive. It truly felt like a restaurant that takes pride in maintaining quality even after so many years in business. The service too was prompt, polite, and warm — the staff made us feel genuinely cared for, which added to the overall positive dining experience.

However, our experience took a disappointing turn the next morning. Out of five family members who dined together, three of us ended up with an upset stomach and loose motion. It’s unfortunate because, while the food tasted excellent, this after-effect raised questions about hygiene or food handling consistency.

It’s a restaurant that clearly has a glorious legacy, a top-notch ambiance, and courteous service, but maintaining strict kitchen hygiene is just as important as taste. I truly hope the management takes this feedback seriously, as Royal Challenge has the potential to remain a trusted classic — provided the focus on food safety matches the charm of its reputation.

Would still love to return someday — hopefully to the same great taste without the unpleasant aftermath., name_person=Prashant “Paddy” Demello}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,600–1,800, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️☆ — Good food, family-friendly, and comfortable ambience

Conveniently located at just a short walk from Link Road or Metro stations, the place is easy to spot, with warm lighting and lush greenery that instantly draw you in.

The establishment is modern and chic, with open seating curated with a green, refreshing ambiance. It also offers an air-conditioned section featuring ambient lighting and a minimalistic design. The stacked bar looks great tucked into a corner, overlooking a comfortable sofa setup ideal for larger groups. The overall feels are chill, gram-worthy, and genuinely perfect for a date or family meet-ups.

We visited for a midweek dinner and to our surprise, the place already had a decent crowd, so a reservation is recommended. The staff was courteous and professional, and they offered us a nice table.

The pop playlist was soft, and we quickly got chatting while browsing the beautifully designed cocktail menu. The food menu lists down the ingredients and features a mix of Indian, Asian, and continental dishes, while the servers were always at hand to describe each item, making it much easier to order. We sampled :

-Virgin Mojito : Standard but well made. Arrived promptly. Apt choice to pair with starters.

-Ghost Chilli Chicken : Delicious and succulent, the chicken was char grilled to perfection. Served with a mango based chutney. Not as spicy as the name suggests.

-Spinach, Chilli & Ricotta Stuffed Mushrooms : Button mushrooms stuffed with fresh ricotta and spinach served on a bed of chilli tomato puree. Filling and crafty, the green apple and cinnamon chutney brings out the flavours.

-Spicy Prawns Tempura : Classic tempura, good size and crunch. Dynamite sauce does the trick.

-Mercado Verduras : Thin base with exotic toppings like sundried tomatoes, brocolli and olives. Rocket leaves sprinkled on top adding freshness and texture but may not be everyone's cup of tea.

-Black Pepper Rice Bowl : Sticky rice served with black pepper prawns gravy with a kick. Savoury aftertaste lingers for a while. Portion good enough for two.

-Mutton Kheema Pav : Perfectly cooked mutton with sunny side up egg on top for adding a runny buttery balance. Recommended and loved it !

-Biscoff Cheesecake : Light, creamy and delectable. Not overly sweet like traditional Biscoff desserts which makes it more bingeworthy !

-Gooey Brownie with Ice Cream : on house melt in the mouth brownie. One of the best we've tried in Mumbai for sure ! You cannot miss this !

The owner of the place is passionate about food and hospitality and it shows. Guest feedback is well appreciated and this gracious approach instantly makes the place worth visiting again.

To conclude, whether you're stepping in for a casual catch-up or a special night out, Feast & Fable's inviting upbeat vibe, lipsmacking food and great service make it an exciting choice for anyone exploring the neighborhood. The ever-popular 145 franchise has now extended its charm to the bustling Kamala Mills, bringing its signature energy to the area. Tucked away along the quieter back road, this outlet offers the perfect blend of a trendy café and a lively bar — a space where laid-back daytime vibes seamlessly transition into an electric nightlife atmosphere.
Pros:
1. The ambience is a total winner — spacious, vibrant, and welcoming. From the warm colour tones to the comfy seating and a small dance floor, the place instantly sets a good vibe.
2. Fresh, flavorful food that lives up to expectations with every bite.
3. Generous portions, perfect for sharing between two people.
4. Service that’s quick, attentive, and genuinely adds to the dining experience.
Cons:
Honestly, none that stood out.

What we ordered;
🔸️ Hazel; RECOMMENDED
A chocolate base mocktail, which had vanilla icecream blended along with hazelnut and coffee. I had ordered it for the very first time, and it didn't disappoint me though. Only one problem, could have been served in some other glass.
Rating: 4/5

🔸️ Nuttela Freakshake;
What could have been different than the name itself? Nuttela Milkshake make thick with addition of ice crushes, added along with some kitkats, whip cream on the top and some gems as usual, making it a big freakshake as its name goes.
Rating: 3/5

🔸️ Mushroom on Toast; HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
This bruschetta was something you shouldn't miss out on. Mushroom with cheese and herbs been placed on a toasted loaf of bread. Try it out yourself if you havent ever tried bruchetta ever.
Rating: 4.5/5

🔸️ Gojuchang Glazed Chicken: RECOMMENDED
The Sweet and Sour Korean's famous chicken dish which most of you guys would love. One of the most loved chicken starter here, served along with a sweet sour ketchup and topped with seseme seeds.
Rating: 4/5

🔸️ Pasta in Pink Sauce; RECOMMENDED
Decent taste of any regular pink pasta sauce, which added exotic veges and perfect consistency. Might go for this italian dish as it is the most regular ordered dish.
Rating: 4/5

🔸️ Chocolate Truffle cake; RECOMMENDED
A chocolate mousse cake along with a side of an icecream scoop was nothing special though. But after the first bite the mousse melts in your mouth. Definitely worth remembering the taste. Best tasted with vanilla icecream combo.
Rating: 4/5

Final Verdict:
Every place has its highs and lows, but this one truly leaves more reasons to love than to complain about. Pricing is on par with most popular cafés, making it easy on the pocket without compromising on the experience. The food quality and quantity hit the mark for any true foodie, and it’s clear the team works hard to deliver on every front. Agent Jack’s Bar is located on the 6th floor of Fun Republic Mall Andheri West.

The restaurant is spacious with nicely lit ceiling and minimal elements added to the ambiance. They have a small bar at the center, an elevated space for DJ and a space is also kept for live music. The seatings available provides option for all size of groups.

Their menu covers Indian, Chinese and Italian. Options available are great as the menu is compact and hence it doesn’t confuses you. Prices are at par with similar type of brands and the quantity served is decent.

We went here for a weekday dinner and there was live music which was excellent. The kitchen service was on time and table service by Staff Dipu was good as he was attentive.

What We Had-
APPETISERS~
Loaded Nachos -
Nachos topped with beans, salsa, cheese sauce and sour cream tasted decent as everything about the dish was perfect except the nachos as they lacked the freshness. So minor improvement needed here.

Madras Fusion Chicken -
Juicy chicken tossed in creamy coconut garlic based sauce tasted delicious. Loved the flavours in this as even this had coconut milk it wasn’t sweet and the chicken was tender.

Chicken Shole -
One of the best classic chicken tikka experiences as this dish tasted outstanding. Spice rub was really food, the grilling was perfect and the chutney onion served along was great.

MAINS~
Paneer Tikka Pizza -
Nicely done base topped with sauce, cheese and paneer tikka tasted good. It was a classic pizza done right.

Chicken Korean Rice -
Looked delicious and tasted exactly the same. Basic yet full marks for this as the rice done in Korean sauce along with egg and chicken tasted great.

DESSERT~
Chocolate Brownie -
Fresh chocolate brownie topped with chocolate sauce and ice cream was a perfect end.

BEVERAGES~
Love Dream.
Malta Basil.
Both the drinks tasted good and went well with the food.

So our meal at Agent Jack’s Bar Fun Republic was a good dining experience as the vibe of the restaurant due to live music and the food was great. For drinks, we tried the Mock Penzi and Strawberry & Orange Mojito. Both were beautifully presented with a slightly sweet note — refreshing and perfect to kickstart the meal.

Coming to the starters, the Yazu Signature Chicken was an absolute treat — a perfect balance of sweet and spicy, topped with cashews and onions for that added crunch. Next, we tried the Pan-fried Chicken Shanghai Dimsums, which were flavourful and well-cooked. The Manchow Soup was comforting, rich in taste, and just perfect for the winter season.

The highlight of the evening was definitely the Crispy Prawns Cheng Fung — a must-try dish here! For mains, we opted for the Burnt Garlic Fried Rice, which had subtle yet delicious flavours and paired well with the rest of the spread.

We wrapped up our meal with the Pick Me Up Tiramisu Cake, which was decadent and delightful — a perfect ending to a perfect meal.

We have been regular visitors to HOD Resto Bar and have always had good experiences here — great food, nice ambience, and courteous service. We’ve even recommended this place to many of our colleagues.

However, our recent visit was disappointing. We were a group of 5 colleagues and ordered Chicken Lollipop. Since one plate has 6 pieces, we specifically requested the person taking our order to give us 10 pieces instead, so everyone could have 2 each. He agreed and served 10 pieces accordingly.

At the time of billing, we noticed that we were charged for 2 full plates of Chicken Lollipop (₹700 total) — even though we were served 10 pieces instead of 12. When we raised this with the staff, the person attending us spoke quite rudely and said (in Hindi), “Sir, we’ll charge for 2 plates — if you ate 2 lollipops less, that’s your problem, because you had asked for 10 pieces.”

This response was very unprofessional and disappointing. The same person later mentioned that they gave us a 10% discount, but that’s something they always offer anyway. It felt like an attempt to cover up the poor handling of the situation.

We chose not to argue further and paid the bill (attached here for reference), but this experience really changed our impression of the place. We hope the management takes this feedback seriously and trains their staff to handle such situations more politely and transparently.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=If you're looking for an unlimited affordable buffet in the Western Suburbs, Peshawari Grill in Goregaon East is a top Restaurant. Located on the 2nd floor of The Hub Mall, Western Express Highway, this Restaurant delivers a solid spread of veg & non-veg unlimited food in a comfortable, spacious setting.

From the moment we arrived, the ambience hit the right note — generous seating, warm lighting, and a relaxed vibe that works for both family dinners and friendly meet-ups. The staff are attentive and the buffet layout is well organised. They allow you to enjoy your dinner without disturbing much but be available when you call out any of them.

On to the food — you’ll find a wide variety of dishes: live counters with pani puri, soups, a full spread of starters (veg & non-veg kebabs, tandoori items), main courses ranging from North Indian to Chinese & Mughlai, breads, rice, and a nice dessert section.

Key favourites: the paneer tikka, chicken rarhya, lasooni fish, and for desserts the dudhi halw and kheer are worth a try.

With the special offer of ₹499 on Mondays & Tuesdays, you’re looking at an exceptional deal for the area.

The location is convenient for the Western Suburbs (Goregaon East), making it a solid choice for buffet restaurant in that region.

If I were to offer some tips:

Go early (lunch/dinner) to avoid peak crowd and ensure you get the full buffet spread without items running out.

Try out your best veg and non veg dishes - one at a time so that you don't get confused.
Start with the live counters (pani puri, kebabs) and work your way to mains & desserts — being strategic helps when you want to make the most of a buffet.

Bring your foodie group or family — the place has big seating which is great for group bookings.

In short: if you’re in Mumbai’s Western Suburbs and on the lookout for an unlimited food buffet restaurant that is within your budget, this is very much worth a visit. With a price of ₹2000+ for two, it offers good value for the quality provided. One visit is sure to make you come back for more!

Food:
Having explored various Chinese dishes before, we decided to rely on the server’s recommendations, and they did not disappoint! The food was served piping hot, bursting with flavors. Do note that some items may be discontinued or unavailable at times, depending on the menu updates.

Soups: The Veg Eight Treasure Soup was a great way to kickstart the meal, setting the perfect tone.

Starters: The Crispy Corn Chilly Pepper had a unique crunch and was full of flavor.

Main Course: The Veg Lemon Grass Fried Rice carried a subtle yet delightful lemongrass aroma. The Veg Nasi Goreng had a well-balanced taste, and the Stir-Fried Chicken with Chilly Garlic & Hot Basil was delicious, though the texture was slightly inconsistent.

Curries & Noodles: The Chicken Thai Red Curry had a rich taste, but the boiled chicken didn’t do it justice—battered pieces would be a better alternative. The Lotus Stem & Asparagus in Red Curry Infusion is a must-try if you enjoy bold flavors. The Wok Tossed Noodles were fairly standard Hakka noodles. The Stir-Fried Crabmeat in Thai Yellow Curry was quite spicy but became well-balanced when mixed with a coconut base. The Crispy Chicken Katsu Baos were decent but could be elevated with the addition of flavorful sauces.

Desserts: The Caramel Sponge Cake with Toffee Sauce was soft and delicious, while the Chocolate Rolls with Ice Cream had a rich Nutella filling. The newly introduced Mango Pudding is definitely worth trying. The Chocolate Dome, while an impressive concept, felt a bit too much to finish after a full meal.

✅ Must-Try: Eight Treasure Soup (Veg/Chicken), Lemon Coriander Thick Soup, Crispy Corn Chilly Pepper, Stir-Fried Chicken with Yu Xiang Sauce, Veg Lemon Grass Fried Rice, Chicken Thai Red Curry, Dynamite Tofu, Caramel Sponge Cake, and Mango Pudding.
☑️ Can Try: General Tao's Favourite Chicken, Veg Mee Goreng Noodles, Pan-Fried Noodles, Tom Yam Chicken Soup, Hot Chocolate Rolls, Thai Basil Chilli Chicken, Crispy Chicken Katsu Bao, Chocolate Dome, and Thai Exotica Glass.
❌ Let-down: Eggwhite Fried Rice and the Chinese New Year Special Potato Dish.

Service:
The staff is warm, courteous, and well-informed about the menu. Their recommendations were spot on, and they serve with a smile, making the overall experience enjoyable.

Ambience:
The interiors feature Chinese script carvings, adding an authentic touch, while the background music enhances the experience. The space is decent but not extraordinary.

A solid choice for Chinese food lovers! Definitely worth a visit., name_person=Nitin Sharma}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Things to Try Veg Khousey a coconut based soup with noodles nuts garlic .}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Highly professional staff, quality food, good rate and excellent taste.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good tasty asian food, overpriced, due to location and brand.}"]

In drinks we had Gin Botanic which was basically cucumber G&T which was super refreshing and had lovely taste. Also if you are boozing over here do not forget to try their famous chakhna platter which is a solid 10 and goes really well with the drinks and brings extreme nostalgia. The washrooms were leaking during rains, which made them unhygienic and unpleasant to use. Even the ice we were served had a plastic thread inside and was dirty.

The service and overall setup left a lot to be desired. Despite hardly any crowd (only two tables occupied when we visited around 1:30 pm in mid-August), the waiting time was unusually long. Alcohol options listed on the menu were out of stock, and cocktails weren’t available before 4 pm as no bartenders were present.

The ambiance was no better, with the DJ playing old, depressing songs on loop, completely killing the mood. Food overall was below average, with the only dish worth mentioning being the manchurian — probably the safest option.

We tried quite a few starters and drinks and the bill was around 8k for 3 people which is quite expensive.

I recently dined at Goma, nestled within the Radisson Hotel Mumbai Goregaon, and it was an unforgettable experience.  The restaurant's interiors exude elegance, setting the perfect ambiance for a delightful meal.

Our culinary journey began with the prawns  soup—a harmonious blend of flavors that awakened the palate.  The chicken gyoza and Edamame were perfectly steamed, offering a savory bite that paired wonderfully with the accompanying sauces.

For the main course, the vegetarian sushi boat was a visual and gastronomic delight.  The assortment was generous, and each piece showcased the freshness and quality one expects from top-tier sushi.  The fish in butter garlic sauce melted in the mouth, rich and flavorful, while the lamb chops were tender and seasoned to perfection. The service top Notch. The staff were tip toed and attentive. Telepathic - they wud reach you before u wud call them.

The tables were set artistically and the cutlery used looked chic and top grade.

The bar looked fully stocked and we chose to have blackberry crush breezer which went well with the seafood.

Classic bombil fry - full marks to the presentation. The portions were huge, were perfectly marinated and fried. The chutney was sooo flavourful and the onion kachumber made the dish more or less perfect.

The thalis are available only on mon- thurs for lunch and we decided to grab onto that oppurtunity. The way the thalis were set on the tables gives u a maharaja wali feeling.

The surmai thali -
Surmai fry - huge portion, fried to perfection. Tasted yummy.

Surmai curry - flavourful.

Prawns sukha - this was so yummy, i polished it off in seconds.

Soul kadhi - perfect blend of tanginess kokum and sweetened cocont milk - i want more.

Sabudana kheer - light and refreshing. A substitute for normal kheer was delicious and best way to end the meal.

Chapati, rice, papad, pickle - perfect.

The prawn thali
The prawns fry - deep fried filled with flavours
The prawn curry - yumminess
Jowar bhakri - wow

(Other stuff was similar to the surmai thali)

The mouth fresher tingled the tasted buds.

The washroom hygenie was excellent. Spic and span clean.

Missed a little music in the air which wud elevate the entire experience to the next level.

At Meen Curry be prepapred to capture all the fishy moments., name_person=imran badami}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Seafood at Meen Curry is truly delightful. The ambiance is regal, yet welcoming, perfect for a relaxed catch-up or even a celebration.

The food? Beyond delicious. Every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. Must-try items include the Paneer Tikka Multani, Murgh Darbari Kebab, Aachari Lamb Chop, Bhatti Da Murgh, Tandoori Jhinga, and the ultra-fragrant Ghosh-ki-Dum Biryani. For desserts, the Rasmalai Tres Leches and Jalebi with Rabadi were a hit—rich, creative, and perfectly balanced. Their mocktails were refreshing and paired well with the spices.

The service was lightning fast, and the staff were courteous, attentive, and extremely well-mannered, which made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend this place for both its cuisine and its remarkable service., name_person=anju mallah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a month ago, review=From Loyal Customer to Deeply Disappointed

I’ve been visiting MULK for almost a decade now. It used to be one of my absolute favorites for consistently great food and a warm dining experience. Sadly, that’s no longer the case.

While the food is still lovely, the service has gone completely downhill. The staff today seemed disinterested, unresponsive, and worst of all, the manager (who they said is named Raju) was shockingly arrogant, easily one of the most unpleasant interactions I’ve ever had at a restaurant.

The thing that truly stunned me was when I mentioned that I’ve been a customer for 10 years, and instead of appreciating that, the manager laughed and “corrected” me, saying the restaurant has only been open for 8 years. Is that really the right thing to say to a long-time patron? The sheer arrogance and dismissiveness in that moment said it all.

To make matters worse, he wasn’t even wearing a name tag, and the staff initially refused to share his name. Only after I insisted did someone reluctantly say “Raju.”

It’s genuinely heartbreaking to see a place I’ve supported for years lose a loyal customer, not because of poor service, but because of a poor attitude that reeks of unbothered arrogance.

Lovely food, PATHETIC service.
Hope the management wakes up before more long-time patrons walk away disappointed., name_person=Anmol Sachar}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Well cooked food, Super tasty, Good Ambience...good staff..superb place}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Mulk offers variety of delicious food options in both Veg and Non Veg category.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Amazing food great service Best north Indian restaurant I have ever ever been to}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited a month ago, review=Extremely Disappointing Experience at Club Illusion

Our experience here was far below expectations. The manager’s behavior was shockingly rude and unprofessional. Right from the entrance, his attitude and way of speaking felt disrespectful. And at the end, things got even worse.

They added an unreasonably high service charge on both liquor and food (almost 40% extra). When we asked for clarification, instead of helping, the manager literally started shouting and arguing. His tone changed instantly and it felt like he was trying to provoke a fight rather than resolve the issue.

Service was painfully slow and the staff seemed careless and completely untrained — no attention, no hospitality nothing, even basic requests were ignored multiple times.

Considering the prices they charge, the service and attitude are absolutely not worth it. There are many better clubs in the city where guests are treated with respect.

Overall, a terrible and stressful experience. Definitely not recommended.
Don't go Don't go.

Reply to club illusion's revert :-
The major issue was the manager’s behavior. The way he spoke to us was very rude and unprofessional. Even when we raised concerns about the bill, he did not cooperate and his attitude made the experience very unpleasant. I hope you address this seriously so future customers don’t face the same behavior.
Please take this feedback seriously and ensure better customer service. my concern is very clear.
A club that charges a premium price must provide premium hospitality, not arrogance. Please address this seriously because such behaviour completely ruins the experience for paying customers.
And most importantly train your staff and specially your unprofessional manager how to behave Profesional.
They are literally untrained for sure.

Thank you., name_person=Bharti Kanojiya}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=“Club Illusions is the perfect place for a high-energy night out! The music is amazing, the vibe is electric, and the lighting and ambience set the mood just right. The cocktails are fantastic, and the food options pair perfectly with the party atmosphere.

The staff is super professional and friendly, making sure everything runs smoothly even when the club is packed. If you’re looking for great music, good drinks, and a lively crowd, Club Illusions is definitely the place to be!”, name_person=Jay Purohit}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Visited the newly opened Club Illusions on a Thursday night. It is located in Andheri West and is definitely a must visit place for all the party goers in town. As soon as you enter this party house you know the night is going to be lit. The dance floor was crowded and everyone was having a good time. The cocktails acted as a fuel which charged everyone. Beautiful ambience and music with amazing food and cocktails. Food Menu consists bar bites as well as comfort food along with a comprehensive drinks menu with a range of regular liquor options to a plethora of elegant cocktails.

Our cocktails were superb, we ordered oriental sunset and kumquat mojito. Both were amazing and were beautifully presented.

Speaking about the food we had -
▪️Cheese Garlic Bread
▪️Peri Peri Fries
▪️Pink Sauce Pasta
▪️Veg Hakka Noodles with Manchurian Gravy

In dessert we tried the Mango Delight which was absolutely delicious.

The customer service is top notch. Staff is very courteous and helpful. Comfortable seating arrangement with both sofa and high chairs options. Overall food, drinks, music and ambience is excellent. Highly recommended., name_person=Meghana Jain}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=The ambience is awesome, the manager and staff is so helpful and forthcoming... However, there is limited seating, so I would recommend if you plan to party hard and dance some night, just book a table for yourself else, you will find yourself standing on the bar counter without a bar stool. Also, I would like to highlight that the manager was so courteous that he offered us one of the reserved sofa seating area to be comfortable during our entire stay at the club!
The DJ and live band were fantabulous!!!, name_person=R Pandey}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=Club illusions!
Recently visited this newly opened club in Andheri West. If you’re a night animal you should really hit up at this place with your gang. The club is pretty good and has its own different vibe. It has a decent accommodation and the staff is pretty cooperative. Talking about the food I really loved the appetizers.
The music is really good and the club has a really good bar. The drinks are just too good! The cocktails were really the one that made our nights, proper proportion of everything and was just excellent!
Overall it was an amazing night, we had the time of our lives. Would totally recommend it others!
Note : Bringing small kids is not advisable!
Would love to visit again!❤️, name_person=Shallom Lobo}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a month ago, review=Overall, the experience was a bit disappointing.

Guys, please be careful and double-check your bill
they might add hidden charges and try to take more money from you., name_person=Geetesh Wadekar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Club Illusion is the best club in Andheri. The staff gives us their best recommendations about cocktails, starters and mains. The service was quite fast and staff are friendly.

Coming to the food,
In Cocktails we tried Long Iceland Iced Tea - Bartender Special And Oriental Sunset. Both this drinks are just awesome. I specially love this bartender special LIIT.

In Mocktails we ordered Asian Fever and Granday. Granday is the cream based mocktail and i like this most.

In starter we tried their Chicken Madeira Kebab. And the taste was superb.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=What a lovely place to hang out!

Visited this well lit, well maintained, spacious place to catch up with my friend over lunch on a Sunday. We were the first ones as we went a bit early.
The food is delicious and they have happy hours on a daily basis with various offers such as 1+1, 2+1, 3+2 on drinks.

We ordered a veg Chinese platter, current affair and an orange blossoms among the mocktails.

The platter consists of 3 varieties: paneer starter, veg crispy and spring roll. All were extremely tasty and fresh. We were absolutely full with just this much so we had to end the meal just at that.
This platter is easily sufficient for 4 ppl..

Three things that stopped me from giving 5*:
1) No dessert
2) no BOGO offers on mocktails and cocktails
3) water bottle: which is supposed to be sold at MRP of 15-20₹ was sold at ₹75! A normal aquafina water bottle not even the fancy himalaya n other brand..

It definitely left a bad impression on our minds.

The staff is good, vibe, ambience, food everything was awesome., name_person=Shilpa Sekhar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Lunch experience*

Tequila Chicken
Prawns
Lobster

Drinks were good! The alcohol content was apt and no extra dilution was done., name_person=nikhil shinde}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Looking for a place to chill with your friends and enjoy some really good drinks and food?

Bora Bora is a must try!

This place is basically located below Tap on Link Road near Citi Mall. The ambience is beautiful and has got some dark but romantic and pleasant vibes! 😻

Went to this place today after office with a friend for a drink and some food.

For drinks, we ordered:

1. Bora Bora Bull: This was basically a watermelon based mocktail. It was so refreshing and not too sweet making it more amazingg!

2. Tom Collins: It was Gin & Tonic based drink with lemon squeezed! Loved it!!

For starters, we tried:

1. Nachos Del Combo: As they say, you can never go wrong with Nachos! 😻 Nachos were so so good! And topped with kidney beans, olives, bell peppers, sour cream and cheese sauce and were served with salsa dip. Also, the portion served was more than enough! They tasted bliss!

2. Peri Peri cottage cheese stripes: Long stripes of paneer was served. Taste wise it tasted so so good! Also, the paneer was nicely marinated and fried and they were so soft and were tossed with peri peri masala and bell peppers and onions. They were so good! This one ain't a miss! 😻

For mains, we tried:

1. Pizza Ala Roma: Pizza was good. It had toppings of bell peppers and onions and a good amount of cheese 😻 Good option to try here!

2. Veg Lotus Leaf Rice: This was way too too disappointing! 🤦🏻‍♀️

To sum it up, this place is really amazing if you wanna chill with your friends drinking and eating! 😻, name_person=Avni Barai}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Seafood_Restaurant, Ice_Tea_Flavour], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=Subeerb Food Must Try the Grilled Chicken with Blck Bean Sauce
The Fish Finger is also very Good .
Beautiful ambiance, name_person=Mohsin Khan (MY KIND OF PRODUCTIONS)}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Weekday drinking after ages.
Choose Bora Bora over the neighbouring loud Bollywood theme night.
PLUS : They had a Happy Hours (Buy 1 Get1 Free) offer going on to let the patrons make most of the night.

Simple things like Ganesh realising the smoke from our ciggarettes is clouding the room and opening the window for the smoke to escape was a sight to behold with the pitter patter of raindrops on the street.
Credit to their ambience or the alchohol or Both, hic hic, hichic, but the cieling seemed to be like a dimly lit night sky.

Our visit was a blend of enjoyable moments and a few drawbacks.

Ambience & Entertainment
The ambience was inviting, with a casual yet energetic vibe. The highlight of the evening was the karaoke, which kept the crowd entertained and added a fun element to the experience. It’s definitely a great spot if you enjoy live, interactive entertainment while dining.

Food & Drinks
We started with a Long Island Iced Tea (LIIT), which was well-mixed and quite strong—definitely an effective drink. For food, we had:

Five Spice Chicken – A flavorful dish with a well-balanced spice mix, offering a nice kick.

French Fries with Cheese – A simple yet satisfying snack, with crispy fries generously topped with melted cheese.

Apple Chicken – A unique dish that combined a hint of sweetness with savory chicken.

Jalapeño Popper – A classic, spicy, and cheesy bite that added a good touch of heat to the meal.
The food was decent overall.

Service & Experience
The biggest downside of our visit was the slow service. There was a noticeable delay between placing our order and getting our food, which slightly dampened the experience. Though staff was polite and cooperative.

Overall Verdict
Richie’s Bar and Restaurant is a great spot if you’re looking for a fun, casual dining experience with karaoke and drinks. The food is enjoyable, the drinks are strong, and the atmosphere is lively. Also, it was really busy, and the staff was a little overwhelmed, we had to ask several times for something  till we got it., name_person=Georgiana Anghel}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Barbeque_Chicken_Tikka, Pani_Puri, Angoori_Jamun_12_Nos, Pastry, Pastries, Crispy_Corn, Cakes, Paan_Ice-Cream, Kheema, Chicken_Tikka_Masala], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=7 months ago, review=If you're a fan of barbecues, then Barbeque Nation on Veera Desai Road is nothing short of a culinary paradise. Imagine this place as the Mecca for all things grilled—it's a haven for anyone who enjoys a feast, whether you're a meat lover or a vegetarian.

Our experience began with a warm welcome and swift seating, thanks to the prior reservation we made. The attentive staff guided us to our table and, with a smile, asked what we’d like to try from their extensive buffet spread. It was clear they were committed to delivering a personalized experience.

While we waited for the grill on our table to heat up, we were treated to an assortment of starters: golden Cajun potatoes, tangy pani puri, flavorful veg kebabs, crispy corn, and smoky tandoori chicken drums. Each bite was bursting with flavor, setting the tone for the meal ahead.

For those who love their drinks, there’s an unlimited non-alcoholic drinks option for ₹249. I couldn't get enough of the refreshing fresh lime soda and the nostalgic kalakhatta—both were the perfect thirst-quenchers amidst all the grilling.

Speaking of grilling, the skewers kept coming—fresh and piping hot. There were succulent offerings like mushroom, paneer, soya, fish, prawns, and a variety of chicken, each infused with unique flavors that catered to every preference.

I also indulged in their pasta and noodles, which were surprisingly delicious and tasted authentically Italian and Asian. But what truly stole the show for me was their mutton masala. It was perfectly cooked, tender, and packed with rich, deep flavors that paired beautifully with butter naan. The moment the mutton ran out, a fresh portion was brought in—now that's what I call service!

Next was the Mango Festival, which was being promoted the Tango Mango Fest. The idea sounded irresistible, but sadly, it didn’t live up to the hype. I sampled their mango ice cream, fresh mango slices, mango pastry, and a mango custard. While enjoyable, they didn’t deliver the bold, vibrant mango flavor I was hoping for. I limited myself to just one serving and moved on.

And then, more desserts! While the malai kulfi and paan kulfi—two of my all-time favorites—were slightly underwhelming, it was the Apna Desi Angoori Gulab Jamun that saved the day. Paired with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, it was the kind of dessert that made me sigh in pure bliss.

The service at Barbeque Nation was impeccable. The pacing was perfect—nothing was rushed, yet there was always food on the table. The staff's attention to detail was spot on, and a special shoutout goes to Deepika(excellent service), who took exceptional care of us throughout the meal.

One memorable moment was when a couple was celebrating their anniversary. The staff made it extra special by bringing them a complimentary cake, surrounding them with cheers and wishes that truly elevated their experience.

The ambiance was vibrant and fun, with great music creating a lively atmosphere. The washrooms were clean, and the entire space was well-maintained, which added to the overall positive experience. The billing process was smooth and efficient, which is always a plus.

Overall, Barbeque Nation offers an unforgettable experience where food truly reigns supreme. The restaurant is spacious with a mini and a full sized bar. The ambiance is super bright with tribal decor touch. Loved the colours used everywhere and every corner looks really beautiful. The seatings are arranged nicely and options for all size of groups are available. They also have DJ section and a dedicated space for live events.

The menu contains global dishes with sone traditional Indian food being available too. Loved the menu as you get everything from sushi to chicken tikka is available in their menu. Prices are at par with similar type of brands and the quantity served is nice. Also they do run dining offers so check online before visiting.

We went here for late lunch and kitchen service was decent but table service was haywire as the staff was super confused as they were booked for a private party at 6PM so I think they were under immense pressure as they kept on switching dishes on different tables. However staff Sandeep tried his best to make the table service smooth.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Butter Paneer Potli -
Butter paneer stuffed in a potli, fried to perfection but not oily, and served with a makhani dip. What I liked most was that it wasn’t sweet, the flavors of spices and onions really stood out, making the dish taste perfect.

Herb Crusted Truffle Parmesan Chicken Tikka -
One of the classy version of chicken tikka which tasted amazing. Perfectly grilled juicy chicken done in green spices topped with cheese with light truffle oil and with walnuts on the top tasted perfect. Everything in this tasted superb and you should definitely try this.

Golden Prawn Tempura Roll -
Again one of the best sushi experiences. Their portion is 5 pieces so you will definitely crave more. Crunchy tempura, fresh prawns, spicy sauce and everything in this sushi was perfect.

MAINS~
Wild Mushroom & Truffle Cacio E Pepe -
Man. This was one of the best pasta I have ever had. Earthy flavours due to mushrooms and truffle oil. Perfectly done spaghetti with crunchy veggies and the watery cheese sauce was outstanding. Try it to believe it.

Prawn Ghee Pepper Roast with Tadka Lemon Coriander Rice -
Fresh prawns in ghee roast gravy tasted good. The rice went nicely however I am not a fan of whole coriander hence full marks for gravy.

DESSERT~
Slow Baked Chocolate Bar -
This wasn’t that great as the chocolate used was not that tasty.

MOCKTAILS~
Black & Yellow.
Tropical Delight.
Both the drinks had perfect taste.

So our meal at Hunky Dory Malad was really good. Leaving the service, the food, ambience and music played was perfect. However, from the start, the experience left much to be desired. Located at the top of a building, the restaurant had a vibrant appeal, but the ambiance didn’t quite meet our expectations. Despite having a prior reservation through Zomato, the staff seemed unaware and struggled to find us a spot, even claiming the place was fully booked. After some back and forth, they finally seated us at a corner table for four, which was not an ideal start.

The dim lighting was the next major issue – a dark red light directly above our heads cast the entire area in a shadow, making it hard to even see our food. This setup created a rather uncomfortable dining experience, as it felt too dark and disorienting. We began our meal with Loaded Nachos, served with refried beans, salsa sauce, cheese sauce, and sour cream. While the nachos themselves were decent, the salsa and sour cream were surprisingly bland, lacking the zest expected from these toppings. Unfortunately, this combination didn’t appeal to our tastes.

Next, we tried the Cheesy French Fries, and here too, we faced disappointment. Though the cheese sauce was flavorful, the fries were soggy and lacked the salt and crispiness that would have enhanced the dish. It was quite underwhelming, and we found ourselves forcing the dish down. For the main course, we chose the Veg Classic Fried Rice Bowl, which was thankfully a highlight. The fried rice was delicious, with perfectly cooked long-grain rice mixed with fresh vegetables. The accompanying Manchurian gravy with two Manchurian balls was flavorful and well-seasoned, making this dish the only true saving grace of the evening.

Lastly, we looked forward to dessert but were disheartened to learn that the only option was a hot chocolate brownie. This limited choice was disappointing and left us feeling as if options were unnecessarily restricted. To top it all off, the music was unbearably loud, making conversation nearly impossible. Overall, our experience at Bombar was underwhelming, with improvements needed in both food quality and atmosphere. Nawab Saheb - The Westin Powai brings you a royal experience.
This place has a comfortable aura and interiors of this casual dining restaurant are appealing.
The cuisine is focused on traditional Indian featuring the regions of Awadh, Rajasthan and North West Frontier India. These flavours are influenced by local culture bringing out the authenticity to provide a world class gastronomic experience. The food is absolutely amazing – everything we tasted melted in other mouths especially GALAWAT KE KEBAB and LUCKNAWI GOSHT DUM BIRYANI. Absolutely the best meal we had
At Nawab Saheb you can enjoy culturally rich traditional dining experience which stays in your memory., name_person=Gargi Bagul}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Renaissance Hotel Powai is nothing short of royal and beautiful. Simply amazing hospitality and such pretty restaurants. This Infact, was my reason to visit Nawab Saheb for their ongoing Tawa & Tandoor Festival (20th- 28th September) as there are very few restaurants who actually go out of their way to curate special menus like these. Brainchild of Chef Yunus Khan, I think everything on the menu was fantastic. Service was slow as the restaurant was quite packed, being a Friday night. I opted for the vegetarian fare priced at 2800. Frankly, I thought it was value for money only because of the main course. Just their dal makhani and paneer will leave you licking your fingers till the end. Here's what the spread consisted of and how I felt about it :
Vegetarian :
1. Til Malai ka Phool (5/5)- Melt in the mouth brocolli with cream cheese. Found the cauliflower okayish.
2. Chef Yunus Khan ka Paneer Tikka (10/5)- Star dish! Has to be the best I've had in a long time. Highly recommended.
3. Subz ki Ashraphiya (3/5)- Found it average.
4. Bhune Bhutte ke Seekh (5/5)- AMAZING combination of seekh Kebab and babycorn. YUM.
5. Kabuki Kebab (3/5)- Found it too dry. Taste wise as well, bland due to Chickpeas.
6. Chukunder ke Kebab (4/5)- Beetroot galauti, it was nice.
7. Kumbh ke Galawat (5/5)- Wow. Has to be the one thing I'd come back for! Surprisingly it was served on a thepla kind of bread.
8. Aloo Atishi (4/5)- Bharwan aloo, classic.

Mains :
1. Paneer Kaliyan (10/5)- Now that's what I'm talking about. It's dishes like these that make you remember these hotels. No one does mains like them. I ALWAYS skip mains but yesterday I was too tempted after a bite and ended up having 3 pieces of bread after such heavy array of starters. MY FAVOURITE FROM YESTERDAY because it was cashew gravy, so creamy, soft paneer chunks and rightly spiced. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
2. Daal Nawab (10/5)- Probably as good as the one I've had in Delhi at ITC. Properly slow cooked for 48 hours, perfectly creamy and texture was just right. Not overdone. Yum.
3. Subz Biryani - couldn't dare to try it. Was too full.

Desserts : Assorted variety
Motichoor Laddoo, Kaju Katli, Kalakand, Gulab Jamun, Akhroti Halwa, Phirni - all were great but my favourites were the Phirni and Gulab Jamun.

Great staff and great hospitality by team. Special thanks to Manager Avanish, steward Shrikant and Chef Rahul Karve., name_person=Mahek Khanna}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Nawab Saheb as the name suggests it’s a luxurious fine dine restaurant located in the basement of Renaissance Powai. This place was in my wish list since a very long time. I was amazed by the interiors and ambience of the place. The place can accommodate around 100 people at a time.

This place has maintained not just the standards but also taste of the food. The staff was very welcoming and warm with hospitality. Nawab Saheb is a gastronomical journey for those exploring the ageless Royal Mughlai and North Indian Cuisine.

The menu boasts of different menus such as Mix & Match, Seafood, Non-Vegetarian, Vegetarian and Jain options. Also, they have A-La-Carte menu. All these are eloquently curated by their Chef.

Appetizers:

Nawabi Aloo Ki Nazakat

Chef Yunus Khan Ka Paneer

Dhuan Achari Lobster

Jheenga-e- Nisha

Akbari Murg Tikka

Shahi Gilawat Kebab

Mains:

Awadhi Paneer Korma

Makhamali Jheenga

Mahi Dum Qaliyan

Lagan Hara Murg

Potli Nihari

Dal Nawab Saheb

Gosht Awadhi Biryani

Desserts:

They have a dessert buffet in which you will get many Indian desserts. So, if you’re fan of Indian desserts it’s a perfect end to your meal.

Overall, a brilliant experience with the expertise in culinary world.

Food: 5/5

Ambience: 5/5

Décor: 5/5

Value for Money: 5/5

P.S: The review is strictly depending on my personal experience., name_person=shripad marathe}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Nawab Sahab - Westin Powai
Amazing place , richness all over , menu curated by master Chef Yunus Khan a fusion of awadh , frontier India and Rajasthan
This place is known for it's Kebabs and mouth watering aromatic curries

Here is what we had :
==================

Veg and non veg platter - makai motiya seekh minced corn charred with Indian spices normally served on skewers. Since it was a platter it was a single piece
YONUS KHAN KA PANEER TIKKA - signature dish. Middle had a filling of dry fruits and nuts. Indian spices tandoor well with spices balanced
Subz gauloti - melt in mouth minced veggies with herbs and spices served over a bread. So Lucknow ( must try )
MALAI KA PHOOL - richness all over . Cheese and cream marinated broccoli charred.
Perfect

Non veg platter - Mahira babuli kebab famous dish of amritsar on bones. Melt in mouth tangy spicy marinating. Must try
GALAWAT KE KEBAB - do try this , served on a small paratha. Minced lamb with spices .balanced was prefect. Normally served on a griddle. Since it was a platter just had one piece which was enough to know the culinary talent of the master chef.

Samunder ki apsara - wow this was something new . Small lobster tandoor to perfection. Special spices used by the chef. I will remember this . Never had it as a starter

Coming to mains :
VEG - do try the Aminamadi  Saag , a spinach preparation with garlic and cumin. Freshly made full of flavours. Chef has kept it simple . Let the dish do the talking

Paneer Lazeez e khaas again a signature by chef. Chunks of cottage cheese with rich tomato gravy . Subtle in spices and aromatic at the same time.
However the 48 hour Long process Dal e yunus is worth a wait , rich urad lentil. Goes well with biryani or breads.

Non veg - ghost nihari tho banta hai boss . Bone marrow stock , lamb slowly cooked gives that aromatic taste and flavour.
Do try the murg handi lazeez - braised chicken with base of onion gravy along with methi ( fenugreek ) and cream. Chicken was cooked well tender and juicy

Must say that food , kebab or the gravy are not heavy or oily. Just perfect.
Missed out the prawns kasundi , lovely hit of kasundi cooked well. Velvety tomato and anar gravy. Do try.

Small portion of Subz Chilman biryani , long grain basmati rice with saffron a bit of Ittar ghee and veggies

Breads - Taftaan / Khameeri / Naan
However the dessert had a pleasant surprise
Had a capsicum halwa FOR the first time.
Something different which one needs to try out

Overall experience = awesome
Felt like a Nawab Dining at this place paired with a sparkling wine

Big thanks to Saurabh Dixit and team Westin for hosting

Ps. Only drawback , could not meet the master chef as had a day Off
Next time for sure
Till we meet again , cheers, name_person=Prithvish Ashar}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good options to choose for set menu like sea food / meat / veg.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Delicious food, amazing sevice by the staff and soothing ambience}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=This is amazing .sea foods very tasty and yummy ...Good service..}"]

Place is beautiful situated in Westin hotel overlooking the stunning Powai lake and serving Hiranandani locality skyline! Restaurant has a decent feel to it but can do with more comfortable seating & reducing noise levels as they kept their collapsing main door open and all the noises from outside the restaurant was high and killing the nice n quiet ambience needed for a view overlooking powai lake! Something is terribly wrong with how they function in this restaurant!

Food: 3 star
Peach tea Mocktail - was average as it lacked flavor and the required sweetness!
Spiced chicken Dumpling: average tasting as it lacked a punch
Steamed pork Bao- below average as the stuffing was in jelly texture with confusing taste & covering was thick - bad taste
Salmon salad - great tasting , fresh, aromatic however the salmon itself could have had more flavour!
Kataifi wrapped tempura prawns - a stellar dish with everything on point.. only highlight of the whole lunch
Wok fried Sichuan chilli noodles! - the waiter never told us that this was a vermicelli type! So upon receiving it we were disappointed as it would have not been the noodle type we would have preferred ! However taste was fine but nothing great! ( this one dish took 20 mins to be served and we had to ask to get it sooner!

Quite obviously we asked for a different table! As we were walking to a 4 seated ( we were 2) the supervisor lady tried to tell is that it was a table for 4 and they cannot get us that seat, and we were shocked at this but by then another senior guy cut her and offered us that seat with no questions! Her attitude was shocking as the service was firstly flawed by dropping the drinks and now she had audacity to object!
Noodles is served but no sauces like soy, vinegar was ever provided!
Not just this but she even asked us in between our lunch if we liked everything and experience, we were simply surprised at her inability to comprehend the whole fiasco!
A single simple main course took 20 + mins to be served and was served when we asked!
Another smarty waiter at the time of paying up the bill asked us if everything was good and we said it wasn’t, specially how bad the pork in bao texture was to which instead of telling us that he would feed it back to the chef, he was giving us lesson on how the pork is cooked and why it was jelly like 🤦‍♂️
Only one waiter (jeet) was probably the only knowledgeable and courteous one in that restaurant and that senior guy who offered us an alternative table!

What we tried:
•	Surgical Strike 2 – A unique, fiery starter packed with flavors.
•	Paneer Hot Chilli Basil – The paneer was soft and perfectly spiced; a complete winner!
•	Oriental Bowl – Comfort food at its best, loaded with flavors.
•	Cheesy Garlic Naan – Buttery, cheesy, and an absolute delight.
•	Chocolate Walnut Brownie with Ice Cream – A sizzling, chocolatey end to our meal.
•	Mocktails: Cinderella & Candy Kiss – Refreshing and picture-perfect.

What makes this place stand out:
•	100% Pure Veg Menu with Jain food options – a big plus for vegetarians.
•	2+1 on mocktails and cocktails (Mon–Thu) – a crazy good deal!
•	Trendy ambiance with spacious seating and great lighting.
•	Attentive and courteous staff who make the dining experience smooth., name_person=Rohit}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

🍽️ Now coming to the food... we ordered so much just in starters that we were full already!
Each dish was packed with flavor, beautifully presented, and honestly, tasted heavenly.
Here’s what we tried:

🔥 Honey Chilly Lotus Stem – crispy, spicy, and a little sweet – perfect balance

🌿 Hara Bhara Tikki – soft, flavorful, and made just right

🧆 Veg Seekh Kebabs – juicy with a nice smoky touch

🧀 Cheese Cigar – crunchy on the outside, cheesy explosion inside

dish, tangy and tasty

Chicken Majestic : On the first look it just looks like chicken 65 however with the first bite itself you could be able to taste the difference. The chicken is cooked with manglorian spices which provide a completely different burst of flavours from the first bite. Super delicious.

Unfortunately, our experience did not fully meet expectations.

Ambience & Seating

The initial seating arrangement was inconvenient, as the restaurant couldn't immediately provide adjacent tables for our group of eight. We were seated at two opposite-facing tables. However, after some time, the manager arranged an adjacent setup once another family left, which was appreciated.

Service

The service left room for improvement. Our starter was served later than expected, and one of the signature dishes, fish ghassi, was unavailable. Instead, we opted for fish Malvani, which took 15-20 minutes to arrive.

Food Quality

Vegetarian Dishes: Surprisingly, the vegetarian options stole the show. The Manchow soup, spring rolls, and hara bhara kabab were flavorful and arrived promptly. The mix veg gravy and paneer 65 in the main course were well-cooked and delicious.

Non-Vegetarian Dishes: The fish Malvani was decent but lacked the wow factor expected from a restaurant known for its non-veg specialties.

Overall Experience

While the vegetarian dishes impressed, the delays, unavailability of popular items, and initial seating issues took away from the overall experience.

Rating: 3.5/5

While the atmosphere is that of a bustling, straightforward casual dining spot, the real star here is the exceptional, budget-friendly food.
​The cuisine spans a fantastic range, offering everything from robust North Indian dishes to reliable Chinese options, but the seafood and Malwani preparations truly shine. Their Bombil Fry and specific non-vegetarian curries are highly recommended, cooked with authentic local flavors that keep patrons returning for decades. Even simple items like their Dal Khichadi receive high praise for comforting taste.
​Service is prompt and efficient, managing the large crowds that gather, especially during peak dinner hours and weekends.
