["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Everything about our experience at The Caravan Menu was absolutely perfect. The chef truly outdid himself — the food was exceptional with an impressive variety in both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

We opted for the Non-Veg buffet, and the spread was outstanding. Not only were the Punjabi and Mughlai dishes delicious, but the Chinese selections were equally remarkable.
Starters were the highlight for me — Amritsari Fish Fry, Fish Tikka, and Garlic Prawns were absolutely mouth-watering. Even the vegetarian starters exceeded expectations; Crispy Corn and Cajun Potatoes with Crispy Lotus Stem were flavorful and addictive.

The Chaat and Pizza counters were delightful as well — especially the Dahi Bhalla, Dahi Puri, and freshly prepared Pizza.

Moving to the Main Course, the Kashmiri Pulao, Hong Kong Noodles, and Crab Curry stood out and were cooked to perfection.

The Dessert section was just as impressive. The hot, freshly prepared jalebi paired with mini gulab jamuns and vanilla ice cream was the perfect way to end the meal. There were so many dishes overall that I honestly can’t even remember half of them — the buffet is that lavish.

A few tips:
If you prefer a quieter dining experience, opt for lunch as the place is usually less crowded. Nights, weekends, and festival days tend to be packed.

A special mention to the staff and the chef — extremely polite, warm, and hospitable. We arrived late yet they waited for us patiently and ensured we had a great experience.

Every penny spent was absolutely worth it. I’m definitely visiting again — and honestly, this place is far better than Barbeque Nation., name_person=Ziya Sayed}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=a month ago, review=Let us talk about the food by dividing in 3 categories of taste.

.

.

For example, I have a kid, so my choice of restaurant is the one with a kid-friendly ambiance and greater food choices. So, I would be looking for such reviews. My experience in a nut shell:

B) Non veg cream of mushroom 🍄 soup 🍲 - A good taste and blended well with all the ingredients in it
C) Non veg Alfredo Pasta 🍝 - Creamy and a good quantity
D) Blue Lagoon Mocktail - Okayish taste and definitely not worth the amount charged
E) Lychee Lemongrass - Again okayish taste with with a lot of lemongrass in it

2. Ambience - Excellent and well lit with nice soft music 🎶 playing in the background

Tucked right outside Thane station, Regency isn’t just a bar — it’s nostalgia bottled up with Old Monk and chakna. I’ve been coming here since my college days back in 2010, and even after all these years (and all these fancy new places popping up), Regency still holds its own.

The vibe is unapologetically unpretentious. No Instagrammable neon signs or overpriced fusion tapas here. Just solid, top-notch bar food that hits the spot every single time. The chicken lollypop,crispy, the chicken fried rice, the kebab starters— everything’s consistently great.

The staff? Absolute sweethearts. They know their regulars, they’ll sort your table out, and you’ll never have to ask twice for your smokes or chakhna. Also, smoking in the AC section is a rare luxury in today’s world and Regency still lets you be.

This place has seen it all — bad days at work, good days at work, solo drink evenings, hangout with friends, college reunions, and impromptu sessions with strangers who became friends. It might not make it to a glossy magazine’s “Top 10 Bars in Mumbai” list, but for those who know Bombay’s soul, this is the real deal.

Have had nachos at multiple places what was served in Jugheads is definitely not one., name_person=Yashraj Deshmukh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Paneer_Shashlik_Sizzler_Served_with_Noodles], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=10 months ago, review=Good for outing with friends. Though they have a valentines menu.. The ambience isn't much suited for dates. Food is decent and they have a lot of variety in cuisines., name_person=prajwal nerkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=2 years ago, review=This is one of my go to place for chinese and sizzlers. I have been a regular at this place since ages. But some times they are not able to handle the high crowd on weekends and tend to forget about the customers after the order has been placed. I experienced this multiple times. Nonetheless I liked the pepper blasted chilli chicken and the paneer shashleek sizzler. The garlic bread was ok.
Customer service is not up to the mark., name_person=Hridaya Mane}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS=[No_special_event, E:DINING_SPECIAL_EVENTS_NO_SPECIAL_EVENT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Unfortunately rating 0 is not an option.

We had an extremely disappointing experience at Jugheads.

15 minutes after placing our order, we were informed that the chef was unable to prepare Risotto (one of the dishes we ordered). We looked for another small eat and placed the order. I fail to understand why it took 15 minutes to communicate this.

30-35 mins after our initial order, we started following up for the sizzler. Some excuses and stories were being told. Finally, the so called manager (who is extremely arrogant and the least customer friendly person I've ever seen) tells us casually- didn't you cancel the sizzler because you wanted a small eat".

If Jugheads is going to take 50 minutes to prepare a sizzler, they've lost the plot completely.

On asking for management's email/phone/feedback book, they failed to provide. On insisting, they took 10 minutes to provide. The manager had it easily available on his phone and just chose to delay us and antagonize us further.

Oh and yes, the manager didn't bother apologize for his callous and his pathetic customer service., name_person=Nitesh Karnik}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Veg_Sizzler, Cheese_Garlic_Bread, Chips], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=Edited 2 years ago, review=Nice place, good food and cricket matches - fun time with family and friends. Saturday night, 8:30-9:00, you are sure to end up in a queue for 15-20 mins and assume the delay in receiving food due to a heavy rush.... But to our surprise, the waiters and staff ensured that our kids got food on time. We ordered a mix of veg and non-veg, both had good taste, less oily, medium spicy (or as we recommended) and overall, a good experience., name_person=Amruta Karkare}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Great place for a chilled beer and some nice chicken wings with barbecue sauce}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Otherwise, food was tasty, service was good and staff was nice.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The atmosphere here is lively but the music is a bit loud to the normal ear.}"]
address: 6X5C+59R JUGHEAD's, Service Rd, Laxmi Nagar, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400601, India

I loved their crispy, fresh jalebi—it’s a must-try. The starters were delicious and set the tone for an excellent meal, and the curries were packed with authentic flavors. The service was fantastic and the ambiance is warm and inviting, making it a great spot to enjoy North Indian food with friends or family. Highly recommended!, name_person=Vijay Thakkar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=We visited Northern Tadka for Lunch. Ordered a mixed veg sabji, dal bukhara, rice, naans, rumali rotis and tandoori rotis. The food was good. But, the onions on the side were unwashed and this had to be reported to the staff. Cleanliness is a bit of a concern here. Not as expected. The ambience is very conjusted and did not appeal to my expectations. The ambience did not let me enjoy my meal that much!
Overall, I expected more from this place., name_person=Rajdeep Kaur}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=8 months ago, review=Northern Tadka is a resto-bar known for offering Northern cuisine. We visited on a weekend and had to wait 15-minute wait before entering the restaurant.

The restaurant ambienece is good. we had ordered the following dishes,
1) Gulati Murgh Kebab
2) Nimbu Chicken
3) Murgh Punjabi Masala
4) Tandori Roti

Among these, only Gulati murgh kebab had good tase, Nimbu chicken which is mentioned as a must try in their menu is below average, the sauce is good but the chicken is just boiled chicken without any flavour. The murgh punjabi masala which is mentioned as spicy, so we had ordered it, the dish was just blend not at all spicy.

The portion size was more than sufficient for two people.

The waiter guy was inattentive we twiced asked him to take order for our maincourse as we believe it will take time for the dish preparation he refused to take the order saying let the starter come first.

A 5% service charge was added to our bill, which is the case with every restaurant nowadays.

Overall, the food was average not a must visit place for me., name_person=Ammar Jawadwala}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=Ambience is good, food is decent nothing out of the world, it is bit on the pricey side, especially the mocktails. We went there to celebrate our anniversary. We tried two mocktails, kebabs, 1  main course non veg gravy and a bread basket. The food was just so so. And personally did not feel like the food or services were worth the price. And they paid no heed to the fact whether customers are celebrating a special occasion or not. Overall not bad but not something to brag about either., name_person=nabamita roy}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Jalebiyaan_with_Rabri_1_Plate_6_Pieces, Rumali_Roti], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Been to many punjabi theme restaurants, the atmosphere at Northern tadka is really authentic, however the food does not meets the expectations as per north Indian standards.

However some of the items which we found really amazing were
There special nimbu pani with a surprise spice touch, jalebi rabri too yummy, name_person=Secretdoor Clicks}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1}, time_line=6 months ago, review=One of the worst. Very cheap packaging and less quantity of food. Absolutely not value for money. We felt cheated, name_person=Debasish Mandal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Northern Tadka interior showcase excellent vibes of the Northern part of India, Good Ambience.
The restaurant is located in Viviana Mall , Thane West on the ground floor, Wait time was approx 20 Min on Saturday night..
Food served was hot , We had ordered Veg and Non Veg Starters and both were equally good in taste and served hot.
Main Course  Day Special gravy of dish was good while chicken was not juicy and was dry.. Price is $$$.
Liquor is also served here..
Starter and Main Course Food was served in correct pace...
This place is mostly occupied at the evening time. The walls have a crafted design of flower and musical instruments placed on the wall. Pleasant experience..
Yes. Will visit next time and recommend to visit Northern Tadka... Thank You.., name_person=Suresh Mankani}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,600–1,800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=2}, time_line=a month ago, review=I visited northern tadka and the service experience was pathetic. Atmosphere is something i like bt staff being extremely stringent on where to sit despite it’s weekdays.

North Indian food is really tasty but the problem is they don’t have schezwan sauce with lollipop.i hv never seen any restaurant not having schezwan and selling Chinese food like lollipop, name_person=Avinash Singh}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Flavorful chunks of beef in a red/orange Indian curry sauce, served with rice.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Nice place with good ambience, tasty 😋 food and good service......}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The Biryani and Kebabs were absolutely delicious, full of flavor and spices.}"]

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=This has been my go-to spot for Indo-Chinese for a while. They recently revamped the space & updated the menu both of which did not disappoint.
We tried the triple mushroom, vegetable basil dumpling, vegetable croquet, kimchi fried rice & Hakka noodles (cooked in garlic). The flavors were on point. The only critiques are for the croquet since it was a little hard & the gravy had a lot of corn flour.
We also tried 2 mocktails- spicy mango was good, tropical one was a little too sweet.
Overall a great experience, definitely going back!
They had a buffet too but it’s mostly preferred for non-veg., name_person=Soumya Garg}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Nice restaurant with more traditional style dishes. He not only look after the table but was also giving nice recommendations as well as helped us to order in proper quantity.

We had ordered different types of sushi, dimaum, korean stone pot and thai curry along with multiple mocktails.

Overall it was a nice dinner with family to celebrate diwali., name_person=Nilesh Bane}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Dimsums, Fire_Roasted_Mandarin_Chicken], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=6 months ago, review=Just visited China Bistro at Thane and totally loved it! Even the classic Chicken Fried Rice was so good – simple but done really well.

The ambience is pretty cool, modern and chill, though it does get crowded on weekends, so be prepared to wait a bit if you’re going during peak hours. Totally worth it though. Great spot if you’re craving some solid Chinese food!, name_person=Malabika Mahajan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Most amazing Chinese and korean food i had after long time. This is Pathetic., name_person=Sanved Chavan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 weeks ago, review=Prafull and Rahul were very helpful and hospitable. reviews: ["{\"name_person\":\"Ninad Joshi\",\"time_line\":\"3 months ago\",\"review\":\"This restaurant is located on the first floor of the Hiranandani The Walk premises, and it immediately stands out for its thoughtfully designed interiors. My Sunday visit was an unplanned delight, a casual occasion that turned into a memorable experience.

Coming to the food, I’d say it's average overall. The Shrooms and Cheese Clouds (Dimsum) were the highlight – absolutely fantastic, 5/5!
The Falafel Pita Pocket and Pizza were decent, both a 3/5 for me.

*Not Recommended*
** Total Disappointment on each Plate**

I recently visited Cafe Holiday restaurant, lured by its hype and high ratings. Unfortunately, my experience was not good.

**Ambiance and Service:**
While the decor is undeniably chic and the ambiance trendy, these superficial positives quickly fade when faced with the abysmal service. The waitstaff seemed uninterested and inattentive, often ignoring our table for long stretches.

**Food:**
The real disappointment, however, lies in the food. Despite the exorbitant prices, the portions were shockingly small, leaving us feeling more hungry than satisfied. Pastas was served only with red and white sauce without any thing, Chicken or Vegetables had to be added as an adons with pasta for additional charge of about Rs100

The starters, which we hoped would set the tone for the meal, were bland and uninspired.
The other courses fared no better: the chicken was overcooked and tough, the pasta lacked any real flavor, and the seafood was far from taste.

**Each dish felt like a compromise on quality and taste, starkly contrasting with the hefty price tags.**

**Value for Money:**
Simply this restaurant fails miserably in this department. The overpriced menu does not justify the mediocre food and subpar service. It seems more focused on maintaining a façade of exclusivity rather than delivering a genuine culinary experience.

**Conclusion:**
Cafe Holiday is a classic case of style over substance. For anyone looking for a truly satisfying dining experience, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere. This restaurant is overrated and overpriced, with food that does not live up to its reputation. Save your money and dine at a place that values its customers and takes pride in its cuisine.

["{guided_block={}, time_line=a week ago, review=Had a wonderful dining experience at KOA – Thane! 🌟 The moment you step in, the ambience feels chic, vibrant and perfect for both group plans and relaxed evenings. The staff is welcoming and the service is smooth throughout. 😊✨

🍹 Refreshing Cocktails – bright flavours, refreshing and well-balanced

🍝 Mac n Cheese Pasta – super comforting, cheesy and satisfying
🍛 Subz Dum Biryani – fragrant, flavourful and cooked beautifully
🍰 Pistachio Tres Leches – mildly sweet, nutty and the highlight of the meal

Everything tasted fresh, well-presented, and worth the price.
If you’re in Thane and looking for a place with great food + great vibe, KOA should definitely be on your list! 💚✨, name_person=Anshita Saxena}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=KOA Café & Bar, located at Korum Mall, Eastern Express Highway, Samata Nagar, Thane West, is truly one of the most aesthetic and vibrant spots in Thane.

The ambience is beautifully designed around a bohemian / boho-chic theme, featuring warm wooden elements, greenery, soft tawny lighting, and creative décor. The vibe is relaxed and cozy — more like a “room to share” than a formal fine-dine space.

They have a circular bar, cabana-style seating, window-side spots, and even an al-fresco section that gives outdoor-style dining feels. It’s a perfect hangout place for friends, casual dates, or relaxed get-togethers. The early evening vibe with low ambient music adds to the charm.

🍽️ Cuisine & Drinks

KOA serves a broad and global mix of Italian, Asian, Continental, Indian, and fusion cuisines, making it great for groups with different tastes. Veg or non-veg — there’s something for everyone.

🥤 What We Tried – Drinks
•	Lemon Basil Oasis Mocktail – refreshing and perfectly balanced
•	Hazelnut Blended KitKat Milk Frappe – rich, creamy, and indulgent

🍽️ What We Tried – Food
•	Sriracha Chicken Dumplings – spicy, juicy, flavour-packed
•	Rock Shrimp Tempura Sushi – crunchy, fresh, and delicious
•	Jamaican Jerk Chicken Pizza – smoky, spicy, and full of flavour
•	Kasundi Mustard Fish – tender fish with a strong mustard punch

🍰 Desserts
•	Pull Me Up Tiramisu – creamy, dramatic, and super satisfying
•	Smash It Dessert – fun, interactive, and tasty

⭐ Overall Experience

10/10 — The food, drinks, and ambiance were all outstanding.
The staff, service, and the manager were extremely polite and attentive.
A perfect spot in Thane for amazing food, great vibes, and beautiful aesthetics.

Highly recommended! If you’re in Thane and craving a good meal, this one’s a must-visit!, name_person=anagha sonawane}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Prawn_Hargao_AK, Chicken_Spring_Roll, Wok_Tossed_Vegetable_Hakka_Noodles, Longevity_Noodles_Wich_Onions_and_Beans_Sprouts, Salads_for_Free, Japanese_Noodles, Fish_Stir_Fry], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Mainland China at Viviana Mall in Thane-West is a delightful fusion of luxurious Thai-Chinese ambiance and comfortable seating. The staff's guidance in suggesting dishes adds to the experience, especially if you opt for the unlimited buffet.

The starters, served tableside, showcase authentic Chinese dim sums that tantalize the taste buds with its yumminess. The Lung Fung soup, though slightly watery, surprises with its flavorful egg white fry. The diced chicken with assorted pepper might lack the pronounced assorted pepper flavour but compensates with its overall deliciousness and yumminess.

A Disappointing Experience – Overrated & Overhyped

If you’re planning a special evening at Liv Eatery & Bar, a rooftop restaurant located in Wagle Estate, Thane, you might want to reconsider. Our recent visit turned out to be the worst dining experience we’ve had in a long time, leaving us frustrated, disappointed, and still hungry.

Location & Ambience: 2/5

Let’s start with the location – while the building itself is new and modern, the area around it is dusty, unhygienic, and gives off a creepy vibe, especially after sunset. Upon arrival, guests are required to check in at the reception to get an entry pass before heading up to the 14th floor via a lift.

As we stepped out onto the rooftop, the Valentine’s Day decoration with red heart-shaped props and crimson focus lights was meant to create a romantic atmosphere. Unfortunately, it felt cheap and borderline eerie, more like a setup from a low-budget horror flick than a cozy date spot.

Seating arrangements were a major letdown.
The tables for couples were tiny, cramped, and paired with uncomfortable chairs. Even the waitstaff admitted that the seating was impractical. They added an extra small table to accommodate our order, but it hardly helped. We spent the evening struggling for space rather than enjoying our time.

Service: 1/5

Right from the moment we sat down, we noticed a pattern – the waitstaff was indifferent, inattentive, and seemed disinterested in serving guests. We had to wave multiple times just to get a menu card, setting the tone for what would be a frustrating dining experience.

Food Quality & Taste: 1/5

We ordered Chicken Cheese Kebabs with Jalapeños. The dish arrived with an “okayish” presentation with 6 pieces, but the taste was only spicy. The chicken inside was flavorless, and we had to request salt separately to make chicken somewhat palatable.

Our second dish was supposed to be a safe bet – Chicken Crispy, a personal favorite of my wife. What arrived was an utter disaster. The chicken was so rubbery and chewy that it felt like chewing gum. After just 2-3 bites, my wife gave up. I pushed myself to eat half the plate, but it left me with jaw pain and frustration. We left the rest of the dish untouched.

Interestingly, the couple seated next to us had also left their food untouched, and at the time, we wondered why. After our ordeal with the Chicken Crispy, we completely understood their decision. Wasting food is never ideal, but when it’s this inedible, it’s the only choice.

Smoky Atmosphere: 2/5

Adding to our misery, the restaurant is a smoker’s paradise. Smoke from nearby tables and bar counters constantly filled the air, making it unpleasant and suffocating for non-smokers like us.
Forget about enjoying your meal – you’ll spend half the time waving away smoke.

Final Straw: We Left Hungry

Frustrated and dissatisfied, we left the place with half-empty stomachs and headed to another restaurant to salvage what was left of our evening. Thankfully, we finally had good food elsewhere, but the damage to our mood was already done.

Overrated & Not Recommended

Liv Eatery & Bar is heavily overrated, and the reality falls far short of the hype. If you value good food, attentive service, and a pleasant atmosphere, this is not the place for you.
Spend your hard-earned money somewhere else where both your taste buds and your mood are respected.

•	Service: 1/5

•	Food Taste: 2/5
•	Location: 2/5
•	Atmosphere: 2/5
•	Music: 4/5

The food was absolutely delicious we started with hot Chicken Manchow Soup, juicy Chicken Tikka, and sizzling prawns, all cooked to perfection. The main course with chicken gravies, naan, and the highlight Bamboo Mutton Biryani was full of authentic flavors and a must-try! Ended the meal on a sweet note with classic Vanilla Ice Cream.

Visited Chulha Village in Ghodbundar, Thane West, and it truly lives up to its name — mitti se juda, swaad se bhara. The ambience gives proper village-style vibes, warm and earthy, making the whole dining experience feel comforting and authentic.

We started with refreshing mocktails — the Virgin Mojito and Passion Punch were well-balanced and perfect to kick things off. For food, the Chicken Lollypop was crispy and flavorful, while the Murg Aalishan Kebab stood out with its rich marination and smoky taste.

The main course was the real highlight. The Chicken Handi and Kala Masala (Broiler) were packed with bold, traditional spices and tasted absolutely delicious when paired with Jowari Roti and Cheese Garlic Naan. You can genuinely taste the desi masalas and slow-cooked flavors in every bite.

Ended the meal on a sweet note with Gulab Jamun, which was soft, warm, and perfectly soaked — a classic done right.

Overall, great food, generous portions, authentic flavors, and a lovely desi ambience. A must-visit spot for anyone craving traditional Indian food around Thane. Located conveniently near the Manpada petrol pump on Ghodbunder Road, and with Titan Hospital as a nearby landmark, the restaurant is very easy to find. The moment I entered, I was welcomed by a warm and inviting ambiance that instantly made me feel comfortable. The interiors are tastefully designed, combining modern décor with cozy seating, making it perfect for both family outings and casual hangouts with friends.

The highlight of my visit was, of course, the delicious food. The Kitchen Culture truly lives up to its name by offering a wide variety of dishes that blend traditional flavors with a modern touch. The taste was consistent, whether it was the vegetarian delicacies or the non-vegetarian specialties. I particularly enjoyed the appetizers, which set the tone for an excellent meal.

Authentic Indonesian fried rice served with a fried egg, grilled skewers and crunchy prawn crackers. Full of bold flavours and great texture.

🦐 Butter Chilli Garlic Prawns
Perfectly cooked prawns tossed in rich buttery garlic and spicy chilli sauce. A must-try for seafood lovers!

🍣 Assorted Sushi Platter
Fresh vegetarian sushi with creamy fillings, neatly rolled and served with wasabi, soy and pickled ginger. Great for sushi beginners.

🍰 Berry Velvet Cake
Soft, rich, and mildly sweet cake with a berry twist. Light yet indulgent, with a beautiful look and balanced flavour.

🍲 Nasi Goreng Broccoli Zucchini Cracker
A lighter version of the classic nasi goreng – loaded with healthy veggies and topped with crispy prawn crackers. Flavourful and satisfying.

📍 Located on the 2nd floor of R Mall – easy to find

🤝 Friendly staff and quick service

📸 Perfect for foodies & Instagram lovers

The food was tasty and affordable., name_person=Jyo}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Tandoori_Platter, Veg_Sizzlers], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=9 months ago, review=We recently visited The Mint Leaf, and the experience was nothing short of delightful. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with elegant decor and a relaxed atmosphere that set the perfect tone for an enjoyable dining experience.

Drinks & Mocktails

We started with Mango Breeze and Brownie Milkshake. The Mango Breeze was refreshing, with a perfect blend of tropical flavors, while the Brownie Milkshake was rich, creamy, and indulgent—ideal for chocolate lovers.

Starters

The Veg Platter was a great choice, offering a variety of appetizers that were well-seasoned and perfectly cooked. The Pesto Paneer stood out with its creamy, flavorful pesto coating, enhancing the softness of the paneer beautifully.

Main Course

For the main course, we tried the Mexican Sizzler and Vegetable Green Thai Curry. The Mexican Sizzler was packed with bold flavors and had a deliciously smoky touch. The Green Thai Curry was aromatic and comforting, with a rich coconut base and fresh vegetables that complemented each other wonderfully.

Dessert

To end the meal on a sweet note, we had the Jalebi Martini Rabdi. The fusion of crispy jalebis with creamy rabdi was a delightful twist on a classic, making for a memorable dessert experience.

Overall Experience

The Mint Leaf impressed us with its well-balanced flavors, excellent presentation, and a cozy ambiance. The service was prompt and courteous, adding to the overall experience. Definitely a great spot for anyone looking to enjoy delicious food in a comfortable setting!

Would highly recommend trying it out!, name_person=Manish}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000}, time_line=3 years ago, review=I had planned a corporate team dinner here at late night. Have shared the experience below:

Pros:
-The ambience was good.
- The food was great with the value and quantity as well as the quality.
- They have corporate discounts and you need to carry an ID to avail the same.

To order: Cheese corn balls, oriental panner
To avoid: Any bakery dishes like pizza, garlic bread, fries of any sorts the cheese fries had grated cheese not liquid lol.

Cons:
- The staff was not cooperative, seemed to be somewhat frustrated and were trying to shoo us away.
- They started turning off the lights and wrapping up the furniture.
- The bill was placed at the table even before the ordered dessert were served.
- The dessert showed up quite late and it was very embarrassing situation looking at the behavior of staff.
- When you're spending 20-25k for such dinners this type of hospitality is not what you're expecting.
- Staff requires some training and brush up on hospitality and behavior.

Conclusion: Took the liberty to take off some stars with not so pleasant hospitality from staff. Would recommend to reconsidering your plans considering the above points. A firm NO if you're planning a client dinner.

Drop a like if you found it helpful, cheers! :), name_person=Pranav Shembekar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 2 months ago, review=Food here is just yum, right from the soup to starters and the main course everything seemed just right, the family restaurant has good ambience, we tried the chicken tikka and chicken crispy with the sauce, the chicken tikka were the best i have had thus far so it's a must try if you visit this place. We revisited this place and food is awesome still., name_person=Shirin Poonawala}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Very nice place Food was tasty Well service by the staff Feeling Good}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered few veg and non veg starters, soups and a veg biryani.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=It was small restaurant but evry dish....worth it for spent money.....Go for it😊✌}"]

reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_RESERVATION=Reservations not required, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Burger], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

They offer 12 unique craft beers unlimited at just ₹1049 we personally loved the Guava Cider and Konkan Rice Lager the most 🍻

Service by ANU was top-notch too, all the friendly staff truly know their stuff. Ambiance was lovely, making it a great spot for a chill brunch.

I dont really like vegetarian cuisine but this place made me change my mind today! Healthy and Delicious food🤌

If you haven't tried this place yet, RUN don't walk! You'll thank me later 😉 Would definitely come back for more of this deliciousness! 👌

The Hummus and Pita Platter would be my fav recommendation to all. Paneer Satay too!

Kudo to the Owner for such a brilliant business idea and the Chef who makes the idea come to life beautifully!!!!

Rating: 5/5 stars ⭐️, name_person=Tulsi Naidu}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Garlic_Bread, Potato_Garlic_Shot], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a year ago, review=Visited this place for first time to try out the brewed beer. We tried veg momos, surmai fry, devilled chicken, tava chicken, veg sushi, crab rice, and paya soup — each dish was packed with flavour and perfectly spiced, just like a home-cooked meal.
Drinks like plain lemon, coconut tropical storm, and beer mojito were refreshing and well balanced.

Highly recommended for casual dinners or special occasions!, name_person=Rupali Karnik}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Good experience. 3. Amazing Beverages
Their cocktails are impressive – refreshing and balanced. The Hot Toddy and Whiskey Sour were absolute highlights. Great variety of mocktails too!

4. Friendly Service
The staff is super courteous and attentive. They made sure we were comfortable throughout – quick service with a smile!

5. Perfect Vibes
Good music, relaxed environment, and happy faces all around. A great place to unwind with friends, family, or a date night.

Great food, beautiful setup, and memorable service – highly recommended! Will definitely visit again.😊

🍕 Funghi Pizza (605₹) – Thin crust, crispy, and topped with fresh mushrooms; a personal favorite.

🎀 Sufiyana Chicken Biryani (545₹) – Flavorful biryani with tender chicken and aromatic spices, well-balanced.

The lounge is located inside Palm Beach Galleria Mall, Sector 19D, Vashi, Navi Mumbai – on the rooftop, just like other popular spots in the building.

The total bill came to ₹6688 (including taxes). Here’s what we ordered:

2 Butter Rotis – ₹109 each
1 Butter Chicken – ₹669
5 Butter Naans – ₹99 each
1 Cheesy Fries – ₹384
3 Fresh Lime Sodas – ₹210 each
1 Hakka Noodles – ₹428
1 Murg Tikka Masala – ₹637
1 Non-Veg Platter – ₹1499
3 Virgin Mojitos – ₹440 each
1 Water Bottle – ₹90

The ambience was nice, and although they had live music, it hadn’t started by the time we were there, so we missed out on that part of the experience. Still, the setting was good for a small group celebration.

The food quality was very nice, and everyone at the table enjoyed what was served. Service was decent, and the overall vibe of the place felt modern and chill.

However, the one major disappointment was the pricing of the water bottle — ₹90 for a Bisleri bottle with MRP of ₹20 felt extremely unnecessary and overpriced. For larger groups, these small add-ons can become an unpleasant surprise on the final bill. That part definitely felt like a setback.

The place is otherwise well-suited for small group dinners, celebrations, and casual evenings. The seating is spacious, and the rooftop layout adds to the experience.

Overall, I’d say it was a good time with friends — food and setting were on point, but small things like inflated water prices take away from the experience.

The management should aeriously think about renovating the place, name_person=Ajay Bhat}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=I've heard about Chulha a lot and been recommended about the same a lot in the last couple of years so I finally decided to give it a visit on my Dad's birthday this year.

The place is quite fancy given the view you get from the 14th Floor. We chose a place near the window and found it extravagant to sit there and enjoy our food.
(Sadly the seats are really uncomfortable. Maybe its a psychological hack that they just don't want the people to enjoy the view endlessly.)

We ordered Chicken Manchow Soup. The soup was quite tasty and not overloaded with garlic which some restaurants do. But sadly the fried noodles were sour. Which I understand was due to the noodles which had turned stale and then they were fried to avoid wastage.

We asked for recommendations from our server and he recommended Banjara Kebab and Dilkhush kebab. But we had already tried those umpteen times in other restaurants so we rather went for Murgh Maharaja Kebab. It was Chicken Tikka Kebab which was in turn wrapped with Chicken Seekh Kebab. We found the description quite fancy and ordered that. Were served 6 pieces of it. Honestly taste was great but wasn't really value for money. And was on the drier side so had to compensate with the green Chutney and lemon.

Then we ordered Java Style Chicken Lollipop which was really tasty. Though there was no hint of Thai flavor in it. It simply felt it was tossed in Schezwan Sauce.

Highly Recommend., name_person=Mangesh Jadhav _ MJ}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=a year ago, review=So, on August 24th, I found myself at this spot—not because I wanted to, but because there was literally nowhere else around, and my stomach was staging a protest. From the outside, the place looked like it might be hiding gold in its walls, so I thought, "Why not?" But as soon as I stepped inside, I noticed something odd: there were more waiters than customers. It felt like I’d walked into a waiter convention, with me as the only guest.

Now, onto the food—or whatever it was. I started with the masala papad. To my surprise, the only "masala" on it was an overwhelming abundance of tomatoes and onions. I considered adding some spice myself, but the salt and pepper shakers were clearly on strike. Not a grain of salt or pepper was willing to escape their cozy little homes.

Next up was the chicken manchow soup. For a whopping ₹320, I expected something decent. Instead, I got a bland, lukewarm concoction that made me question my life choices. Then came the butter chicken, which, as everyone knows, should be sweet and creamy. But no, this butter chicken had other plans. The chicken pieces were rubbery enough to bounce off the walls, and the sauce was missing any trace of sweetness. The tandoori roti? Let’s just say I wasn’t sure if I was supposed to eat it or repurpose it as a frying pan.

In conclusion, for the price, this place is a hard pass. Even if you're stranded with no other options and your hunger has reached critical levels, I still wouldn’t recommend it—especially if you care about your wallet. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS=[Happy_hour, E:DINING_SPECIAL_OFFERS_HAPPY_HOUR]}, time_line=a month ago, review=I recently visited Union Restaurant in Vashi and it was a wonderful experience! The food was the highlight beautifully presented, flavorful, and cooked just right. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, and the portion sizes were great too. Whether you’re in the mood for something comforting or want to try something new, their menu has plenty of options.

The menu features a mix of American, Indian, European, and Asian cuisines, catering to a wide range of tastes., name_person=Arun Chandran}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=4 months ago, review=The food variety and quality in the buffet looks good only in the menu card. All the dishes tasted almost the same. I had to actually search for the chicken in the soup. The 'fiery chicken salad' had no 'fire' to it! The murg kebab was bland and a little more than half cooked but the Mangalorean fish tawa fry was good. The Live Counter was no better with the Murg Musallam. The main course had Goan Prawns Curry (give it a miss), chicken Manchurian sauce (ok-ok), and Lamb shepherd pie(ok), basmati rice (was not cooked properly - I couldn't eat much), Dal palak was ok. Surprisingly, even though I am not a real fan of veggies, I liked the Korean chilli potato, Baby corn and Mushroom tandoori only.
Coming to Desserts, the Roasted Almonds & Chocolate Mousse was good. The ice cream was almost melting but I managed to get 2 scoops of mango which also was a disaster.
All-in-all, I will give it a miss next time (not worth paying almost rs.800/-).
On the plus side, the staff was courteous and friendly and the ambience was good., name_person=Shreyas Ganesh Manjaguni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Celebrated my birthday with another friend here and the food was soo good had ordered the garlic bread, chicken lollipop, onion rings, loaded nachos and lasagnia. The interior and the ambience is really nice. Glad I found another amazing restaurant in vashi :), name_person=Anushka Kulkarni}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=The look and feel of 'The Union Bar and Eating House' gives you the royal hostage. The quirky decor of the vinatge feel, galliant sofa and chair seatings, dim lightings are all that you would sight at this place in Vashi. Weekends are fun here as they run a famous band for the humongous crowd creating a sense of euphoria altogether amongst their customers. Vashi residers must definitely go on for party and fun at this place. Ambiance are top class and so as the food.
Below are my experience with the eating here; take a grabby look as below:
Mocktails-
Sundowner- Orange, lime, peach and cranbeery mixere; so soothing for the tongue and thirst.
Pom Passion- A pomegranate, passion fruit and oirange mixer refreshing drink.
Cocktails -
Electric Blue (LIIT) - Its a long yard glass mix of vodka, gin, tequila, bacardi white rum, sprite & of course blue curacao. Amazing LIIT to go for.
Coco Berry-A fusion of coconut, cranberry and vodka.
Presentable drink that gave a beachy drink to go for.
Koliwada Prawn Pudi-Crispy tiny prawn fritter served in cones just like a bhel. Good presentation and yummy bites.
Jodhpuri Stuffed Chilli Poppers- Served with mayo, these jodhpuri styled chilli fried poppers tasted amazingly well.
Jalapeno Murgh Tikka- These small little chicken fries were so amazing that gave a taste of spicy and sweet flavour. Any chaat lover would love this one.
Chicken Desi Tacos- Its somewhat desi and mexican fusion of kolhapuri chicken, methi thepla and pico de galo salsa and cheese.
French Vanilla Gateau with Rasoberrv Coulis- So moist and fluffy pastry cake this was. I absolutely loved this one. The essence of vanilla alonwith rasberry coulis on it was out of the world.
Hazelnut Mousse Cake- Yummy pastry cake with flavours of hazelnut and chocolate. Its soft layers will drool you again and again with its every bite.
I had a great experience with all that food and ambiance. I can say it offers fusion food of Indian, American and European. I visited this restaurant two nights ago while cruising the area, tempted to try it despite some negative online reviews. The place had a shady vibe with dim lighting, and the AC section was nearly empty. Since liquor tastes the same everywhere, I was hoping for some tasty food to make up for the average ambiance.The menu was hard to read due to poor lighting, so I used my phone torch and was disappointed to find my favorite Tandoori Chicken Lollipops missing. The lone waiter, who seemed disinterested (and more focused on regular customers), assured me they could prepare it even though it wasn’t on the menu. I specifically requested it to be tender and juicy, just like how I’ve had it elsewhere.
After a long wait, what arrived was a shocking disappointment—BURNT, dry, chewy, and barely edible. Out of eight pieces, only two were somewhat decent, while the rest were tiny, rubbery, and overcooked (see attached images). The waiter casually smiled and said, "That’s how it’s made here."
At that point, I should have walked out and complained, but after a tiring day, I just wanted a chilled beer and decent starters—neither of which I got. The only saving grace was the spices, but that’s hardly enough to redeem this disaster.
Horrible food, terrible service, and an overall underwhelming experience. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹800–1,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=5 months ago, review=My recent and 3rd visit at this restaurant was amazing with surprize Birthday cake and celebrated by the staff with music.

Nice restaurant with awsome service and buffet system. They offer unlimited BBQ in which you have several options like veg and non-veg and they keep on serving you till your hearts and stomach everything is full. Other different counters including main courses and are chaat, pasta, pizza, international cuisine, dessert, ice cream and a great bar area. They allow your kids to prepare their own icecream.

The restaurant is quite big and offers great food and is worth a visit. Generally crowded in weekends, but you can avail early bird offer to avoid crowd.

The service and staff is attentive and I save it my favorite list. Absolutely recommended place for an amazing get together or any celebration., name_person=Ajay Mohanty}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Other, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Dietary_restrictions, E:OTHER_DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Not sure, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=a month ago, review=We visited AB’s – Absolute Barbecues to celebrate my friend’s son’s birthday, and overall it was a pleasant experience. 🎉
The atmosphere was lively and comfortable, perfect for a family gathering.
The staff was courteous and made sure our table was well attended.
Birthday arrangements were nicely done with good decorations and coordination.
The live grill and buffet spread had a lot of options to try.
Starters were tasty and freshly served, especially the barbecue items.
However, the main course was just average – could have been more flavorful.
The desserts and ice creams were quite good and added a nice finish. 🍨
Service was quick and polite, which made the experience better.
Overall, a good place for celebrations, but food quality during lunch can be improved.
Would still recommend it for its ambience and service. 👍, name_person=तिखट मिठ By Nikhil Powar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=3 months ago, review=I recently visited Absolute Barbecues in Vashi, and it was an amazing experience! The ambiance was stylish and cozy, with a great outdoor dining area. The buffet spread was impressive, with a wide variety of grilled meats, Indian cuisine, and desserts.

The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff. The food was delicious, and the prices were reasonable. I loved their creative dishes and the Lava Stone grilling experience.

Some minor improvements could be made in terms of quantity and consistency of food, as mentioned by some reviewers. However, overall, it's a great spot for a meal with friends and family., name_person=Chandan Hansda}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,600–1,800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=5 months ago, review=The taste and variety were decent, but there's significant room for improvement. Only about half of the barbecue starters stood out; the rest tasted quite similar, despite being presented with different names by the staff. The vegetarian main course was enjoyable — especially the dal makhni, rice, veg diwani handi, and dal tadka. However, the non-vegetarian options were underwhelming. The lively ambience, massive variety, attentive service, and enjoyable experience make it absolutely worth visiting.

The grill starters were tender, flavorful, and served piping hot.

The chaat counter, pasta, pizza, international cuisine, and live counters add to the fun and variety.

Best part were the Desserts and ice creams - truly delicious.

While the starters were the star of the show, the main course was just fine and has room for improvement.

The restaurant is spacious, though weekends can get crowded—opting for their early bird offer helps avoid rush.

One of the most heartwarming aspects was watching the staff celebrate birthdays. The dance, cheers, and decorations made the celebrations feel special and brought smiles all around.

With unlimited grills, a huge buffet, unique wish-grill options, and enthusiastic service, AB’s offers excellent value for money, name_person=Nishad Shahasane}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=a month ago, review="Regrettably giving the lowest rating. The body language seemed unwelcoming, which set a disappointing tone for the evening. To make matters worse, guests had to ask multiple times for essentials, cutlery was short during peak hours, and the live charcoal stations were often idle. Adding to the discomfort, the restaurant was hot, and although the air coolers were operational, they were ineffective in providing adequate cooling, forcing guests to crowd around them just to feel some relief. The delay in serving drinks was also noticeable. Given the high bill of ₹1425 per person, the experience didn't match up to expectations. But Here are the facts.

1. Parking - as it is attached to Inorbit mall, parking is not an issue. Mall parking charges flat Rs 50/-.

2. Entrance - The restaurant is located just outside the mall but attached to it.

3. Menu and recommendations - Do not order dishes recommended by their servers as they themselves do not know the taste of the dish or quantity.

4. Pricing - Very heavily priced.

5. Quantity - Never ask them about quantity. All the dishes on the menu are only and only for 1 person. Not at all impressive. They say their quantity is enough for 2 but their serving bowl is smaller than an index finder.

6. Our order -
A. Mutton Biriyani - 475
B. Kadai Paneer - 380
C. Aatewaale Naan - 102/piece
D. Tandoori soya chaap + Malai Paneer Tikka - 398. They have mentioned this in the Kebab platter. Platter was a joke. I guess they don't know what a platter is. 3 small pieces of soya chaap and 3 pieces of Paneer.
E. Aloo Paratha - 380 for 2 small and thick Parathas.

Taste - on the scale of 10. The taste of the food was 5. Not at all worth it.
Aloo Paratha did not have any masala. It was like plain boiled mashed potato with raw onion and a bit of salt and pepper and a pinch of red chilly powder.
Biriyani was Ok. Kebab was good but again not at all enough to even make your palette know the taste.
Kadai paneer full of onions.

Billing - Nice and easy with 5% discount if you are paying via Paytm. They charge 5% service charge ask them to remove it as no restaurant is now charging service charge.

Facilities - if you want to was your hand as them finger bowl.
If you want to use the washroom you will have to walk 200mtrs inside the mall. Their is no washroom inside or near the restaurant.

Music - as it is an Urban Indian restaurant the music should be Fusion Indian. But the music they play is Piano.

They do serve alcohol, and many options on drinks.

Conclusion - if you have too much money then you may come here to waste it. But if you are hungry and coming here for quantity and taste of food. You are simply wasting your money., name_person=Kush Monga}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Had a wonderful experience at

Shall surely visit this place again!, name_person=ADITI PRABHU}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 4 months ago, review=Today we visited urban tadka and it was an amazing experience.

We tried 4 dishes namely 1. Prawns Malvani Tawa 2. Boneless Crab Lapeta Gravy 3. Chicken Pot Rice and 4. Caramel Custard. Prawns were good nothing extraordinary, Crab was lip smacking delicious and we thoroughly enjoyed eating it so did the Pot rice which was tasty. Caramel Custard was indeed toothsome but size could have been bigger it was tiny.
Ambience was nice with some good vibes and waiting queue outside restaurant tells us that.
Few Issues:
Service was very slow and disappointing, not sure whether they were short staffed we have to constantly ask them to take orders and other things.
Food is very expensive and doesn't justify the quantity, quantity should have been more. Because of 20% swiggy discount it became slightly expensive from very expensive.

Definitely recommended!, name_person=Shubhangi Gadge}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Felt Completely Cheated – Watch Out for Moonshine Beer Pricing scam

Went to this cafe with friends for a casual evening and saw Moonshine Beer placed on every table. It had an MRP of ₹150, so I thought, “Great, that’s a decent price,” and ordered one.

The beer was good, but when the bill arrived, I was shocked—they charged ₹450 per bottle, and after taxes, it totaled ₹545! When we questioned it, the staff simply said, “Since it’s served in a restaurant, we can charge more.”

I understand restaurants mark up prices, but charging over three times the MRP, plus service charges and VAt (total 20%), feels outright misleading. It left a bad taste—not from the beer, but from feeling duped.

If you’re planning to visit, double-check prices before ordering. The restaurant is located on the 5th floor of Palm Beach Galleria Mall, Sector 19D, Vashi, Navi Mumbai. It’s a well-known rooftop spot that combines good food with live music and a vibrant ambience.

I had pre-booked via the District app, which offered a 30% discount on the total bill — a great deal. I ordered jalapeño cheese balls, Hakka noodles, and a veg platter. The original bill was around ₹1600–₹2000, but with the offer, I paid only about ₹1200.

The place is spacious and well-laid-out, with enough seating even during peak hours. There was live music playing, which really enhanced the atmosphere and made the evening feel special.

However, the service was a setback. The staff took a long time to deliver the food, and even though I had clearly mentioned that the noodles should be served after the starters and platter, they brought the noodles almost immediately. To try and keep them warm, they covered it with another bowl, but it still ended up getting cold by the time we got to it. That definitely affected the experience and was disappointing, especially on a date night.

As for parking, there’s no direct street parking, but the mall has a shared parking area, which may get crowded during weekends or evenings.

Overall, the vibe and ambience of Tipsy Bro are great — it’s a nice place to visit with friends, for birthday parties, or in larger groups (7–10 people easily). The menu is limited., name_person=vaibhav k}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Atrangi House Sky Lounge in Sanpada, Navi Mumbai is one of those places that makes your dining experience truly special.
The moment you enter, the beautiful ambiance catches your eye and sets the mood for a great evening.
It has a rooftop setting that feels vibrant, colorful, and lively.
The lighting and décor are thoughtfully done, which gives the lounge a very classy yet relaxing vibe.
The music adds to the energy, and their DJ was simply amazing, making the atmosphere even more happening.

We started with cocktails, and the drinks were refreshing and well balanced.
The Tropical LIIT was strong yet smooth with a fruity touch that uplifted the mood.
The Grapefruit Cobbler was equally delightful with its tangy and refreshing flavor, perfect for a lounge setting.

In starters, we tried the Fried Chicken Lollipop, which was crispy outside and juicy inside.
The Vol Au Vent (Chicken) was a unique and tasty dish, creamy and flavorful, and something different from regular starters.

For mains, we went for the Chicken Lababdar with Butter Roti.
The curry was rich, aromatic, and full of flavors, perfectly complemented by soft butter rotis.
It was a wholesome and satisfying main course.

Finally, dessert was a highlight with the Sizzling Brownie.
It came hot, rich in chocolate, and topped with ice cream, making it the perfect sweet ending.

The service was attentive and polite, and the staff made sure everything reached us on time.
The presentation of the food was also very nice, which added to the experience.
Prices felt reasonable for the quality, portion, and ambiance offered.

Overall, Atrangi House Sky Lounge is a perfect mix of good food, amazing drinks, and a lively vibe.
It’s a place you can visit with friends, family, or even for a special occasion.
The combination of rooftop ambiance, great DJ, and delicious food makes it truly atrangi in every way.

Tried the brunch buffet with a gang of 8 people. Ambience and atmosphere of the place was superb but the food and service was not upto the hype. Starters are served at the table while main course, soups and desserts are buffet styled. Refills of starters took time. Water is not served unless we ask. Sushi and live pasta was awesome. reviews:
["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Peri_Peri_Chicken_Pizza, French_Fries], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=I recently had the pleasure of visiting Tales of Tavern, and it was an enjoyable experience from start to finish. The pub offers a buffet that is impressive in its variety and quality. Both vegetarians and non-vegetarians will find plenty of options to satisfy their cravings. The assorted choices ensure there's something for everyone, making it a great spot for group outings.

The welcome drink set the tone for the meal with its refreshing and well-balanced flavors. It was a nice touch that made me feel valued as a guest. One of the highlights of the buffet was the inclusion of pizza. It's not often you find such a staple comfort food included in a buffet spread, and it did not disappoint. The pizzas were well-cooked with a perfect blend of toppings, appealing to both adults and kids alike.

The ambiance of Tales of Tavern is another strong point. The decor is thoughtfully designed, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that is perfect for both casual lunches and lively dinner parties. Although I visited for lunch, I could easily see how this place would transform into a fantastic dinner and party venue. The lighting, music, and overall vibe make it an ideal spot for evening gatherings.

In conclusion, Tales of Tavern is a well-rounded pub that excels in offering a diverse and delicious buffet. The great ambiance and welcoming atmosphere make it a top choice for lunch, dinner, or a night out with friends. I look forward to my next visit, especially to experience the dinner and party scene., name_person=Siddhesh Bhojane}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=Staff service was superb and delightful but food was not up to the mark and not worth the price ambitious was good, name_person=HRitik BHoir}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=a year ago, review=Tales of Tavern surprised me with its delicious lunch buffet!  For a very reasonable 799, they offered a wide variety of dishes that catered to all tastes. Vegetarian options like Dal Makhani were rich and flavorful, while the Salt and Pepper Chicken and Buffalo Wings brought a satisfying kick. Even my non-vegetarian friends raved about the Chicken Masala. Sides like BBQ Potato Wedges rounded out the spread perfectly.

The buffet offered something for everyone, making it a great choice for groups with varied preferences. The quality of the food was impressive, especially considering the price.  If you're looking for a delicious and affordable lunch experience, Tales of Tavern is a must-try!, name_person=Sumeet Thakur}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Located in the heart of Belapur near the NMMC headquarters besides Croma making it not so difficult place to find out.
The ambiance of the restaurant is inviting and spacious, with comfortable seating arrangements suitable for both small and large groups. The decor is modern yet cozy, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere.
The service provided by the staff is commendable. They are attentive, friendly, and prompt in attending to the needs of the customers.
The buffet started with a refreshing mocktail but was much needed to beat the summer heat.
Coming to the food...
We started with an aromatic chicken clear soup which had it's flavours infused in every bit of a drop.
The starters offered in the lunch buffet are diverse and flavorful. The Paneer Hariyali Kebab is a standout, with tender paneer marinated in aromatic green herbs. The Potato Yellow Chilly and Black Pepper Chilly provide a spicy kick, while the Chicken Alishan Kebab and Chicken Harissa Wings are perfect for meat lovers with their juicy and succulent flavors. 🍗
The main course selection offers a variety of options catering to different tastes. The Herb Rice is fragrant and perfectly cooked, complementing the Spicy Black Bean Sauce which adds a rich and bold flavor. The Veg Kolhapuri bursts with traditional Indian spices, while the Chicken Kadai and Grilled Chicken with Rojan Sauce are both tender and flavorful. The Dal Tadka is a comforting addition, providing a perfect balance of lentils and spices.
It also had a seperate Pizza and Salad Bar 🍕
The inclusion of Veg Pizza and Tandoori Chicken Pizza adds a Western touch to the buffet, with both options being delicious and freshly prepared. The Salad Bar offers a refreshing assortment of options, including Nachos with Salsa, Russian Salad, Chicken Sauces Salad, Beetroot Hummus & Pita, and a vibrant Mix Fruit Platter, providing a healthy and light complement to the meal.
The dessert selection is the perfect conclusion to the meal. The Biscoff Cheesecake is a heavenly delight, with its creamy texture and indulgent flavor. The assorted pastries are beautifully presented and offer a variety of sweet treats to satisfy any sweet tooth. 🍰
In conclusion, the lunch buffet at Tales of Tavern in CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, is a delightful culinary experience that caters to a variety of tastes. With its diverse selection of starters, main courses, pizza, salads, and desserts, coupled with excellent service and inviting ambiance, this restaurant truly stands out as a top dining destination in the area. Whether you're craving traditional Indian flavors or international delights, there's something for everyone for just Rs 799/-
Tip: They serve beer on MRP during the buffet 🍺, name_person=Pranit Pawar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We had organized our get-together meet for all the doctors in our team at TOT, and it was a wonderful experience! The restaurant is spacious with seatings available for all size of groups and they have a nice sized bar. The ambiance is modern with nice use of bright colours and the chandeliers look amazing. They have kept space to dance as well.

Appetizers-
Pani puri with syringe - quite innovative way to display the dish.

Paneer Tikka Multani - Pretty good, nothing to complain here.

Chana Jor Poppers - This was a crowd pleaser, quite enjoyed by all.

Panko Crusted Jodhpuri Chilli - can miss this, could have been made better. The outer covering was well seasoned, however the filling lacked the flavour!

Mains -
Diwani Subz Handi - this was brilliant, wasn’t overpowering with a lot of masalas and yet pretty tasty.

Paneer Makhni - this was too sweet for our liking, however kids enjoyed it.

Dal Makhni - this was their signature dish and was brilliant!

Tandoori Rotis & Jeera Rice to give a company to the mains

Gulab Jamun - this was brilliant out of everything ordered last evening, hot, sweet and amazing

Rasmalai - was okayish, the milk base could have been more thick is what I feel, it lacked the body and flavour.

I recently dined at Hotel Grand Central in Chembur and had a mixed experience. The first thing that stands out about this restaurant is its inviting ambience. The decor is tasteful, creating a cozy and comfortable atmosphere that makes you feel at ease as soon as you step in.

However, while the ambience is impressive, the food was just okay. The dishes were decent but didn't quite live up to my expectations in terms of flavor. That said, the variety on the menu is good, so there’s plenty to choose from.

On the positive side, the service at Hotel Grand Central is top-notch. The staff is attentive, courteous, and quick to respond to any requests. The cleanliness of the restaurant is also commendable, which adds to the overall pleasant dining experience.

In summary, Hotel Grand Central is a great place if you're looking for a nice setting and excellent service. If the food quality improves a bit, it could easily become a top choice in Chembur.

paid valet parking is available, and there is a dress code that must be followed., name_person=Harsha}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Visited this place for a Diwali lunch with my office colleagues and we tried quite a few starters and drinks. The kebabs were tender, and the seekh was perfectly juicy — a must-try for meat lovers.

For the main course, we went with the Chicken Dum Bukt Biryani, which turned out quite good as well.

The only downside is that the drinks are on the expensive side, but otherwise, definitely worth a visit!, name_person=Sabin Sasidharan}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=2 months ago, review=Episode One in Powai presents itself as more than just a restaurant — it’s a lively resto-pub experience with strong design, music, and food ambition. Situated in the Delphi building at Hiranandani Gardens, the place has a large, stylish interior with well-thought-out décor: disco balls, retro touches, wooden furniture, greenery, and seating zones that allow both vibrant activity and more relaxed conversations.
Food choices are broad and mostly satisfying. Starters like sliders (Truffle Lamb, Cheetos Crusted Chicken), dim sums, lotus stem, and ravioli garners praise. Some mains — e.g., tofu chili bean blue rice, margarita pizza, Pan-Thai noodles, etc. — are generally considered good. Desserts too have highlights: caramel tart and Sandesh puff are often recommended.

Drinks also catch attention: creative cocktails, mocktails, some on-tap cocktails, refreshing lemonade-based drinks, and clever presentations. This adds to the mood in a big way.

Ambience and vibes are among the strongest points. On weekend nights, the place fills up, the music and energy pick up, which many find enjoyable. There is also seating away from the main crowd for those wanting quieter time. Service is generally good, though during busy hours guests report delays, slower attention, or small hiccups. Portions, especially for starters, are sometimes viewed as smaller relative to pricing, particular with high expectations.

Pricing is on the premium side. For two people without heavy drinking, costs are somewhat high—but many feel you’re paying for ambience, décor, the all-round experience, not just food. It seems worth it if you want a fun, visually pleasing, social evening out.

---

**Conclusion:** If your priorities are a hip ambience, varied menu, good drinks, and a place to hang out with friends, Episode One delivers well. If you’re looking for a quiet dinner or maximum value per rupee, you might find it somewhat pricey, but it’s still one of Powai’s better picks in its category., name_person=Tejaswi Sankhe}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,400–1,600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=6 days ago, review=Day Drinking here on Saturdays and Sundays and It's so quite and peaceful. It felt humiliating, still we ignored it looking at people waiting for the table. Our main menu arrived before we finished eating dimsum and it was served on the other table where we got shifted. We went for lunch and the whole experience was flawless. The ambience is stunning — chic interiors, lively vibe, and definitely Instagram-worthy. The staff is super attentive (special shoutout to Captain Mahesh 👏) and ensured everything came on time and exactly as ordered.

What we ordered:
•	Asian BBQ Chicken → Perfect balance of sweet & smoky, juicy and absolutely delicious.
•	Chef’s Special Oriental Chicken Wings → Crispy, saucy, and packed with flavor. Definitely a must-try.

•	Mario’s Discovery → The showstopper dessert! Looked like a little enchanted forest with chocolate “soil” and edible mushroom caps — not just eye candy but lip-smacking too.

Every dish had its own personality, and the cocktails/mocktails were unique and creative — not just in taste but also in presentation.

Overall, Butterfly High isn’t just a restaurant, it’s an experience. Whether you’re here for a casual lunch or a night out, this place nails food, drinks, and vibes equally.

We visited Butterfly High in early January and booked our table through Zomato. The restaurant offers multiple seating options: couches, chairs, and bar seating, so finding a comfortable spot wasn’t an issue.

Ambiance: The place is spacious, with high ceilings and an aesthetic vibe that feels both casual and trendy. Despite it being a weekend in January, the crowd was mild, which added to the relaxed atmosphere.

Food & Drinks: The menu offered a decent variety, though better recommendations from the servers would have been helpful. We tried two gin-based drinks: Orange, Basil, and Rosemary and Starfruit Surprise (both customizable with your choice of gin) ~ would recommend them. We also had a Manhattan, bottled beers, and Tequila shots.

For food, we ordered Spicy Chicken Skewers, Fish n Chips with Tartar Sauce, Habibi Platter, and Butter Chicken with Naan.

Unfortunately, the food was average at best, with no standout flavors or presentation. The drink presentation was also disappointing.
