The ambience is elegant and perfect for a relaxed evening. The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented.

Special thanks to Sachin and Tushar for their excellent service — they were attentive, polite, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great dining experience with good food and top-notch hospitality., name_person=Raj Baldota}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=The prettiest rooftop place in Sobo😍
Allamanda terrace looks very serene and has gorgeous views. It is very dreamy and has a beautiful view of Marine drive. It is located at hotel marine plaza. I really loved their huge ambience, which also has pool near dining

In terms of the food we had ,
- Bhatti ka paneer
- Murgh chandni tikka
- Lamb and jalapeño seekh gilafi
- Chooza khas makhni
- Gosht Lahori

Everything we had was very tasty , hearty and indulgent . I liked the flavours and aroma . It’s very evident that everything is freshly made with great quality of ingredients . We also had their unique desserts malpua bites with rabdi and dates pudding kataifi . Drinks were also great in taste !
This place is really good for dinner dates with friends or family .
With new year around the corner Allamanda terrace is perfect for all your dinner needs !!!, name_person=Anisha M}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=Edited 3 years ago, review=We wanted to visit Allamand Terrace since a very long time & finally we made it. Located on 6th floor of Hotel  Marine Plaza, this place is perfect for your romantic date with your loved ones. You will get to see the complete top view of Marine drive & queen's necklace.
Talking about the service, it was the best. Ms. Mamta displayed an example of great hospitality & made sure we have a memorable experience. She was bang on with her recommendations of Jain dishes as per our taste buds. She is truly amazing. Chef Rajendra also cooked delicious food according to our preference.

They also have a big projector right above the pool so you can enjoy live screening of matches along with your loved ones with soft music playing in the background.

Coming to the food, they serve only North Indian food with cocktails & mocktails. Price wise it expensive but its worth it.

We started with mocktails & opted for our favourite Virgin Pina Colada & Exotic punch. Both were refreshing, thick & creamy. Totally loved it.

In appetizers we had

Bhatti ka paneer (Jain)-
Soft cottage cheese marinated with thick delicious marination made from different spices, hung curd & grilled to perfection. The portion size was quite enough for two people & totally worth the money. It was perfectly cooked & paneer was also tender & full of flavours. Add little lemon on top & have it with mint chutney.

Za'atar dahi ke kebab-
These tangy kabas made from Hung curd, minced chillies, grated ginger and spices were soft from inside and super crispy from outside. Have it with mint chutney and onions. These were made in Jain by chef on request. 4 kababs are served but these are really big and worth the money with a view. Loved it..!!

In Main course we ordered two sabji one jain & one veg.

Bocconcini Khurchan (Jain)-
This was made in Jain.
One of the best sabji we had. It was made with bell pepper & small round
pieces of mozzarella tossed in rich thick tomato gravy. It was a bit sweet and not spicy spicy at all. It goes well with Cheese Naan. Highly Recommended..!!

Punjabi Chole Wadiyan- Delicious chole along with wadi cooked in Punjabi style. It was spicy and the taste of Kasuri Methi in it was a cherry on the cake. Loved it with Chur Chur laccha paratha and also goes best with Jeera Rice.

Desserts

Dates Pudding Katafi-
Dry Dates were soaked & cooked with ghee with lots of dry fruits & mawa. Later it was rolled in vermicelli and baked till perfection. 3pcs were served along with Shrikhand. The presentation of the dish was very captivating to the eyes. It was not much on sweeter side.

We also tried Baked Gulab Jamun Shrikhand Tart & Rasmalai Tiramisu.
Loved the tart more. The tart was perfectly baked & mini gulab jamun totally elevated the taste of this. Dessert. A must try.

Please note the restaurant is open everyday from 7.30pm to 11pm. Though on social handle it says it is closed. Prior reservation is recommended., name_person=HisandHerCravings}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=South Mumbai has a new fine dine rooftop restaurant, to chill and unwind. Cool Breeze, Dine under the Stars, Nice Music, Beautiful Ambience, Pool-side and  Breathtaking Views of the Mumbai Skyline and Queen's Necklace, believe you me it can't get better than this. The Allamanda Terrace opens doors to all, pre booking is recommended. And since it is on the terrace, currently it's open only for dinner. Located on the 6th floor of Marine Plaza Hotel, the Allamanda Terrace serves a 3 course unlimited set menu of Indian food with decent options for vegetarians as well as non-vegetarians. You have a live counter as well so one can catch the chefs live in action. The price for the set menu is set at INR 1500 + taxes.

Talking about what we tried here - we started with a couple of mocktails, special for the day was Melon Cooler which is a watermelon based drink blended with coconut milk. The other one was Papaya Cooler - fresh fruit with sweet - sour mix. The drinks were quite refreshing. Moving to starters, we tried Pesto Paneer Tikka, Sarson Broccoli, Bharwan Kumbh and Soya Subz Nawabi Seekh. All appetizers grilled to perfection. My personal favorite amongst these was Soya Subz Nawabi Seekh and Bharwan Kumbh. Seekh Kebab was not very dry and the smokey taste of mushrooms was the key here.

Moving to the mains, we called for Dal Makhani, Khade Masale Ka Paneer and Kasuri Methi Miloni Tarkari. Creamy Dal Makhani and Paneer Subzi were top notch and the dark house was veggies flavoured with dried fenugreek in Spinach base and some cream. We had this with Ajwaini Laccha Paratha and Garlic Naan. Scrumptious meal! We ended our meal with a bit of hot Gulab Jamun and cool Rasmalai.

Must say, the staff was courteous and helpful and they ensured we had a good evening. All in all, a must visit purely from an experience point of view.  The Allamanda Terrace is a perfect recommendation for all those looking for options to celebrate special occasions with either family or friends., name_person=Jatin Shah}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=10-30 min}, time_line=Edited a week ago, review=Overall nice dining experience over the rooftop!, name_person=Pravat Biswas}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=The Allamanda Terrace is one the most beautiful rooftop place in Mumbai. Address of The Allamanda Terrace - Hotel Marine Plaza

The stunning Interiors, neo-classic-lobby, combination of marbled wall, vibrant blue carpeting, sets the tone of a beautiful, picture-perfect venue for lavish parties.

We recently visited Moea Moea, a charming restaurant nestled in the heart of Fort, Mumbai. As we stepped inside, we were immediately struck by the warm and inviting ambiance. The décor, infused with traditional Asian elements, such as vibrant pictures and colorful umbrellas, added a unique touch to the dining space.
Jain food is also available. There were many options to choose from the menu.

The service at Moea Moea deserves special mention. The staff were attentive, courteous, and knowledgeable about the menu. They guided us well in selecting dishes, making sure we had a memorable dining experience.
Our culinary journey began with a refreshing mocktail made from pineapple and watermelon, which perfectly complemented the warm evening. The cold coffee, too, was a hit, especially with our little one, Krishiv!

For appetizers, we tried the Sichuan Marbles, which were crispy, flavorful, and generously stuffed with corn and cheese. Sauteed in a spicy gravy, they left us craving for more!

The main course was equally impressive. The Feta and Cottage Cheese Kofta Curry, served with soft, fluffy Kulcha, was cooked in a rich, creamy cashewnut gravy. What we appreciated most was that the dish was delicately flavored, avoiding the usual sweetness that often accompanies such curries.

No meal is complete without desserts! We indulged in the Walnut Brownie, topped with a scoop of creamy vanilla ice cream and drizzled with chocolate sauce. While it was good, it didn't quite match the exceptional standards set by the preceding dishes.

Overall, our experience at Moea Moea was delightful. The restaurant's unique ambiance, combined with its innovative and expertly crafted dishes, makes it a must-visit destination for food enthusiasts. I wouldn’t recommend it based on my visit., name_person=Emily}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=I had the absolute pleasure of celebrating my birthday at Souk at the Taj Mahal Palace, and it was an unforgettable experience! From the moment we arrived, the ambiance completely set the tone for the evening. The restaurant’s open-air terrace offers stunning panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the Gateway of India, making it the perfect spot for a celebration. The warm lighting, cozy yet elegant seating, and soft breeze made the whole atmosphere feel magical, especially as the  awesome views of the arabian sea in the morning light!
The staff were incredibly attentive, and the service was impeccable, ensuring that our dining experience was smooth and memorable. I loved how they made my birthday feel extra special, with small thoughtful touches like a personalized greeting and a dessert to mark the occasion.
Now, let’s talk about the food. Souk is a treasure trove of flavors, and their vegetarian options were an absolute highlight! The menu is inspired by Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisine, and there was no shortage of choices for plant-based diners like me. The Fattoush salad was fresh and tangy, and the Tabbouleh was so flavorful with a perfect balance of herbs and citrus. But the real standout for me was the vegetable kebabs, which were cooked to perfection with a smoky char and bursting with flavor.
Every dish was carefully crafted, and I appreciated how the flavors were rich yet light, leaving me satisfied but not overwhelmed. I also loved the assortment of dips and breads served as appetizers. The hummus was creamy, and the baba ganoush had the perfect smoky undertones.
For dessert, I couldn’t have asked for anything better than the Baklava, crispy, flaky, and the perfect sweet ending to a memorable birthday dinner.
If you’re looking for a dining experience that combines stunning views, impeccable service, and fantastic food, I wholeheartedly recommend Souk. Whether you’re celebrating something special or simply enjoying a night out, this place is bound to leave you with incredible memories!, name_person=Padmini Dixit}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Very quiet, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR, 5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Wonderful experience. Mr. Vinod served us really well, name_person=Dr. Shivani Borele}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3}, time_line=a month ago, review=3.5 stars. The prawn was tasty. Overall, not really worth the price, I’ve had better Mediterranean food. As for the view, at night you can’t see much. Maybe it’s nicer while the sun is still up. The service could have been better as well., name_person=Tina}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Hummus_and_Muhammara, Chocolate_Cake, Kebab], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a year ago, review=Souk @ The Taj Mahal Tower Hotel, top notch service, top notch ambience and top notch courtesy. That is Tata Service for you, anyone and everyone who meets you, greets you with a smile and is ready to help you and guide you.

The restaurant, located on the top floor of the Taj Mahal Tower Hotel provides you the best view of the Apollo Bunder a.k.a. Gateway of India, the Arabian Sea and also the city. You just feel like being there forever.

You are well received at the gate and service is fantastic. The smiles are galore and they guide you into the menu if it is your first time.

The Middle Eastern / Mediterranean / Turkish food is excellent along with the list of liquor.

Being a weekday, the restaurant was empty and we just walked in without reservation.

Pritesh, who was assigned to look after us, did a marvellous job. Not only with food but he knew each and every place from where we could get good photos of us. He helped clicked a lot for us too.

Looking forward to visiting the place again and enjoying a good time, the view and the food.

Just for people to know, day time visits give you a good view of the surroundings., name_person=Melvyn Taraporewalla}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Excellent food...super service...soothing ambience...unmatched hospitality}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Best place to sample variety of Mediterranean starters and dishes.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The sweets ordered included baklava and rose petal ice cream.}"]

We were at first seated against a pillar obstructing the view, so we asked to move to a table nearer the window. Buffet included in high tea had great taste albeit lacking fresh vegetables/fruits. I had wanted to have a regular afternoon tea but the staff pressurised us to choose the Maharaja option which cost INR 4500, saying it would offer luxurious delicacies. It was not nice being pushed to order more expensive option, but what bothered me more was the lack of value. When the Maharaja tray arrived, it was full of normal snacks you can find easily on the streets like jalebi and samosas. An iconic Mumbai café with a lively vibe and historic charm. Great place to relax after Colaba Causeway shopping—food is decent, drinks are good, and the atmosphere is the real highlight.

Leopold Cafe is worth visiting for its history and energetic ambience. The food is average for the price, but the experience, crowd, and location make it a must-visit spot in South Mumbai.

Very vibrant and famous place with lots of character. Can be crowded and slightly overpriced, but still worth a visit at least once for the iconic Mumbai café experience.

📍 About the Place
Leopold Cafe is one of Mumbai’s oldest and most famous cafés, founded in 1871 and located on Colaba Causeway — right across from the Colaba Police Station. It’s a cultural landmark as well as a popular hangout for tourists, locals, and fans of the novel Shantaram.

The café also carries historical significance because it was one of the spots attacked during the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, and some bullet marks remain preserved as a memorial.

🍽️ Ambience & Atmosphere
Vibe:
Lively, bustling, and full of character — a bit of an old-school vibe with a mix of retro and bohemian decor.

Great people-watching spot after a shopping stroll along Colaba Causeway.

Often packed, especially in evenings and weekends — queues are common

🍔 Food & Drinks — What People Say
Positives:
Wide, varied menu with continental, Indian, Chinese & bar food options.

Popular items include beer towers, shepherd’s pie, walnut pie, chocolate desserts, chicken wings, burgers and more.

Some reviewers have enjoyed refreshing drinks like Coke floats and milkshakes.

Cost:
Expect mid-range pricing — around ₹2500 for two people including drinks (approx.) with alcohol.

🧑‍🍳 Service & Crowd
What reviewers note:
✔ Friendly, helpful staff when it’s not crowded.
⚠ Can be slow or inattentive during peak hours.
⚠ Busy weekends and evenings often have lines and waiting times.

📌 Pro Tips Before You Go
This cafe is worth visiting for the experience and atmosphere, even if the food opinions vary.

Best to visit earlier in the day or on weekdays to avoid long waits.

["{guided_block={}, time_line=a week ago, review=The outer-first-impression of Wasabi by Morimoto blends understated elegance and exclusivity: housed inside the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel (opposite Gateway of India), a short glass-and-steel lift or red-staircase transports you from the hotel lobby up to this refined Japanese dining space.  ￼
Guests seated near windows often enjoy partial views of the waterfront or Gateway, enhancing the ambiance.  ￼
The décor is minimalist yet chic — subtle nods to Japanese aesthetics, with cherry-blossom motifs and a warm, muted interior rather than flashy opulence., name_person=Raghvendra Pathak}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Shrimp_Sushi_Roll, More_Sushi], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 2 years ago, review=I can assure you that this place serves authentic and the BEST Sushis in Mumbai for sure.  Just loved each of them. Plus the view surely looks amazing.

Wonderful service Too., name_person=Prashant}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=5 years ago, review=First, yes it is expensive. Second, service is very good, attentive and knowledgeable. We liked most of the dishes except the salmon sushi which was just ok. The Yurine mousse was divine. A great experience., name_person=Saurabh Lal}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=8 years ago, review=My first real introduction to Japanese food. I am so glad we came here instead of going to my favourite Italian restaurant...
We had sushi and a sort of white asparagus (you can tell I am a total newbie) with a really delicious gravy.
A salad that the chef had made for the president of the US (I added mushrooms and it tasted Divine)... Am sure the president didn't get mushrooms with his salad.
They surprised us with a totally decadent rich dark chocolate cake with hints of raspberry in it. It was my birthday and this was a brilliant lunch.
We sat by the window and we should have had a view of the sea... But the building was undergoing construction so that was obscured.
The music was horrible and they did shut it off for a few minutes when we requested... But put it back on...
That was the only thing that spoilt a lovely afternoon out... But the food was so good, I couldn't give them a 4 star rating. It has to be a full 5!
Am I coming back here? Yes. Most definitely!, name_person=Khurshed Batliwala}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=Edited 2 years ago, review=One of the best Japanese restaurants in town although a little overpriced. Its a must try but only a once try kind of a restaurant. Except the rock shrimp tempura which wasn't that great in terms of taste none of the dishes justify their price when it comes to the portion or the lack of it. The spicy angel shrimp sushi which is their take on prawn tempura sushi with a different sauce which came recommended by the server is a must try but the portion is a little underwhelming. The king crab robatayaki was good but neither the the taste nor the portion justify the price. The dessert which again came recommended by the server was the highlight of the night. I would recommend going to the restaurant even if its just to try the dessert., name_person=Shubham Deshpande}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Fantastic japanese cuisine with service to back it up. The chefs are well trained and masters at what they do as is evident by the presentation and detail. Fresh wasabi is quite rare at a Japanese restaurant but it’s served here fresh at your table side, ground on shark skin as is traditional. I would stay away from saucy dishes and just focus on the fish and rice and never be dissapointed here., name_person=Dan Moodley}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+}, time_line=3 years ago, review=After reading many good reviews and recommendations, we came to Wasabi with very high expectations, but the whole dinning experience was very disappointing, I suggest if you are Asian or foodie who has been to other countries and tried Japanese food, don't waste your money here.
We ordered 2 non-veg omasake, 2 soft beverages, 1 appetizer and 1 sushi, combination of omasake was a tragedy— heavy appetizers, everything was dipped in strong sauce, mayonnaise and Jalapeños on top, after thick starters they served light flavor nigiri sushi— your palate are already tired at this time, the mushroom rice and dessert are ok, but can't smooth our bad feeling, it’s the fusion Japanese cuisine that caters to foreigner taste, the whole dinner cost around INR 25,000, you will definitely have better options in Mumbai, especially Mumbai has bunch of fresh seafood can choose. Maybe because Wasabi is located in Taj Palace thus it’s so overpriced, but even more disappointed to have food of this quality under this shiny brand. And one more thing to note, you can’t even see gate way of India in the night, there’s only dark outside, they don't maintain the sights like others around the world., name_person=YC Chuang}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Waiter came to table with an actual wasabi root, grated it on sharkskin at our table and landed some freshly grated wasabi paste on our plate (and it was potent af)

This is peak Japanese food possible in India. Delighted to find sensible prices of wines on the Wasabi by Morimoto menu at Wasabi by Morimoto. I believe they have recently been rationalised, in keeping with the popularity of wine at the hotel and this restaurant, in particular. Enjoying the Henri Bou…, name_person=Shailendra Mishra}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Great place and seating arrangement is good staff and service also very good}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Interior of restaurant makes you feel welcome and try new tasty Japanese dishes.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Prices were a bit high but worth it for the quality of the food and experience.}"]
address: Wasabi by Morimoto, The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai, Apollo Bandar, Colaba, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400001, India

The starters were amazing, the chicken tikka, mutton seekh (juicy and cooked to perfection) tandoori prawns and dilkhush kabab. The main course of butter chicken was super yum too and the cheese garlic nans were a pleasant surprise, soft flaky and stuffed with cheese. Dessert did not disappoint with a gulab jamun and rabri combo that I'd never heard of but worked superbly anyway. Polite, attentive forthcoming with suggestions and recommendations when asked and more focused on the diners experience than pushing sales... Which only made us order more. They also he'd on to bringing food to our table until we were done with the previous course or dish to ensure that we had hot food when we were ready. Overall had a great experience., name_person=Swaraj Ail}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=7 months ago, review=Established in 1921, this cafe will take you back many many years. Place does not have AC but that did not bother us!, name_person=Shantanu Dey (Sandy)}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹400–600, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Highlight of this cafe ✨ : Myself and 2 friends of mine were here on 20th July 2025 at around 6ish evening. We asked for chai but unfortunately we were told that the milk had gone out of stock for that time. But the staff was so selfless that they made sure that we were served chai. (They maybe gave us their share of milk remaining for their evening snacks from the kitchen).

This selfless act by those gentlemen is by far the most polite staff I have ever seen in Mumbai🙌🏻❤️.

The Food : The food has always been finger licking good. I have been here almost every time I visit CST. Only three words would describe my review for food : Fresh, Tasty, healthily prepared ( No over oil in the food, hygiene etc.)

Staff : Love you guys ❤️ We were here after a hectic day, and these selfless loving staff made our day. 🙌🏻💯

#1 Cafe in Mumbai's Best Cafe on my list💯, name_person=ShotPerhead}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Indoor_dining_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_INDOOR_DINING_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=5 months ago, review=Café Universal in Fort is a rare gem that effortlessly blends the nostalgia of old Bombay with the comfort of well-executed classics. From the moment you step in, you're greeted by its vintage interiors—wooden paneling, arched mirrors, and a no-frills bar counter that recalls a more relaxed, sepia-toned era of the city.

On the plate, the experience is just as rewarding. The Bombay duck arrives crisp, golden, and perfectly seasoned, while the mutton keema pao is deeply flavourful and satisfying—robust in spice, yet balanced. Paired with freshly poured draft beers, it’s the kind of unfussy, hearty meal that speaks to the soul more than any fine-dining fare ever could.

While the space isn’t air-conditioned, the high ceilings and ceiling fans do their part to keep things comfortable, especially in the evenings. If you're expecting modern polish, this may not be your spot—but if you're in search of character, warmth, and good food served without pretence, Café Universal delivers beautifully.

A perfect stop for a slow afternoon or a relaxed evening with friends—where the past still lingers in the best possible way., name_person=priyak midder}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Breakfast, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_DISH_RECOMMENDATION=[Burgers, Bread_Pudding, Caramel_Custard], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=8 months ago, review=Cafe Universal is a 10-minute walk from the CST station.
It's more than simply a cafe; it's an experience.
The inside was such a wonderful, modest setting. Cafe Universal exudes old-world elegance with its vintage decor, wooden furniture, and dim lighting. The ambiance is nostalgic, bringing visitors back to a time when Irani cafés were the center of Mumbai's social life. The menu contains a wide range of selections. I tried the caramel custard and enjoyed it.
It's a great spot to hang out with friends and talk over delicious food. They are truly generous with quantity., name_person=Abhi Shinde}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The ambience, the staff, the service and the simple yet elegant food.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=We ordered Chicken Munchow Soup, Chicken KungPao and Chicken Shashlik Sizzler.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Place is hygienic and seating arrangement is well maintained. ...}"]

Visited The Mumbai Masala a couple of times while exploring the area with friends. The food always feels fresh and flavorful, especially the pav bhaji and masala dosa. The vibe is very “Mumbai-style” - simple, lively, and homely.

The staff are polite and serve pretty fast even when it’s busy. Prices are reasonable (around ₹200–₹400 per person), and the quantity is good too. Parking can be a bit tricky in this area though.

If you’re nearby and want a clean vegetarian place with tasty food and a relaxed atmosphere, this one’s definitely worth a visit!, name_person=Bijoy Jacob}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹200–400, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Small restaurant for decent vegetarian food. The rates are reasonable. I have tried food here couple of times. The main course and sandwich were very average in taste, however, the mix pakoda was good. Service was good and fast. The staff are polite and friendly. Parking is difficult to find in this area., name_person=Asmant Nimbalkar}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 years ago, review=Mumbai Masala is a new cozy Vegetarian restaurant in Narayanguda.
When you enter the place you witness fancy lightning column, sleek orange interiors which creates the fun, joy and playfulness atmosphere. Orange is a great colour choice because it stimulates the appetite and also encourages social interaction. Being foodaholic, I like everything from street food, fast food joints to cafe's and regular restaurants. This place is serving varity of cuisines with finest quality taste which makes this place interesting. If you wanna have thalis, proper north Indian and south indian food or any quick bites head here if you find yourself around. Each section on the menu has the timings written for when the dishes are available. Starting off with mocktails tried blue lagoon and Virgin mojito which were okay. Also, tried sweet Lassi and Oreo Milkshake according to me milkshake needs little improvisation.
Moving on to the appetizers section tried Crunchy manchurian dry which was spicy, crisp faultlessly tossed tasted great. Crispy Corn makes a ideal starter for veg's and it was palatable.
Chinese Bhel: This is my all time favourite chat which is made with fried noodles perked up with crunchy vegetables which was so appetizing.
Italian Paniyaram: This balls were made with green's and others veggies coated with breadcrumbs and deep fried topped with cheese.
Rumali Masala Papad topped with Indian chopped masala, lime, coriander and finely chopped fresh veggies. Nachos were served with cheese and bean's were flawless.
Vol-au-vents: It's a puff pastry stuffed with corn delivered maximum flavour when paired with cheese.
Vada Pav Dabeli Combo name itself says it's a combination snack the pav has both dabeli and vada pav flavour
Mumbai Masala Pizza: The pizza was quite good with a desi twist and loaded with lots of veggies, paneer and cheese.
Masala Garlic bread: Desi garlic bread tasted good and was having the perfect amount of the cheese and veggies added to it.
Pav Bhaji: It was served piping hot with flavourful bhaji
Moving to the much anticipated main course Mumbai Masala didn't disappoint one little bit. Veg Chatpat and Paneer Toofani were the curries of the day which were very well enjoyed with the hot, fluffy and soft breads. Paneer Toofani was having to kinds of curries half of the curry tasted like butter paneer masala and the other half tasted like palak paneer which was served in cabbage leaf. Coming to breads tried Lachha paratha, Kashmiri paratha, Lal mirch ka Paratha, kothmir butter naan, Chilli garlic naan, Masala kulcha, Kothmir butter roti and butter naan. Tried combination fried rice which was served with wet manchurian with an awesome presentation. Lastly, from the main course tried veg dum biryani which was soulful.
As, for desserts they don't have elaborate menu. Tried moong dal ka halwa set to perfection with drizzle of dry fruits. Sundae icecream was also good.
The service staff was pleasingly hospitable making sure there was never ever a moment where the diner's are waiting with empty plates.
Overall Taste:4/5
Service:5/5
Presentation:5/5, name_person=sankeertha varanasi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=Awesome restaurant and working stall they know there responsibility they are making the environment like home over all good n hygiene restaurant visit onces, name_person=vipin nair}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1–200, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Paid_street_parking, E:PARKING_OPTION_PAID_STREET_PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[3-4_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_THREE_TO_FOUR], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Somewhat difficult to find parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Menu_is_all_vegetarian, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_COMPLETELY_VEGETARIAN]}, time_line=4 months ago, review=This is definately one of the most underrated restaurant in South Bombay. This seafood and non-veg lover's paradise is a must-visit for any food enthusiast.

The LOVE:

- Delicious Food: The dishes are packed with flavor, and the portions are generous.
- Friendly Staff: The team is attentive and welcoming, making sure you feel at home.
- Cozy Ambiance: The AC section is a blessing, especially during peak hours.
- Alcohol Served: With a 10% VAT, you can pair your meal with a drink of your choice.

Must-Try Dishes:

- Mutton Bhuna: Tender, spicy, and utterly addictive. The quantity is impressive, and the quality shines through.
- Prawns Chilly Roast: Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. A must-try for seafood lovers.

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_SEATING_TYPE=[Bar_area, E:DINING_SEATING_TYPE_BAR_AREA], GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹600–800, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Clearly_labeled_vegetarian_dishes, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_CLEARLY_LABELED_ITEMS]}, time_line=a month ago, review=A True Gem with Historic Charm.
Geoffrey's is a must visit for the beautiful vintage decor and it’s posh ambience.
Food is good. We tried the Burhani Chicken Pizza and the Paneer Pizza.
Service was very quick as well, considering we visited during a weekday.
Good place on the Marine Drive stretch for relaxed conversations., name_person=Prajas Wagh}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Loud, but you can still talk, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a week ago, review=Dropped into Geoffrey’s after several years last night for a night cap. It was about half an hour to closing time but I was still surprised by how dead the place was. The decor looks and feels pretty much as it did when the place opened: woody and kitschy. There was a private party on in a small section and they were blasting 80s Bollywood songs. Not that I minded but I did wonder why the whole pub was subjected to the music taste of a small group. Anyway, we ordered a couple of Negronis and settled down. This is where the disappointment really kicked in. All the “bartender” did was fill a glass with ice cubes and pour in the gin, campari and vermouth. No lemon or orange peels, but for some strange reason there were mint leaves in the drink. When we asked the bartender why the cocktail wasn’t made on ice, stirred, drained… as cocktails are usually made. We were simply told that we don’t do that. This is how a Negroni is made. At a ₹1000 plus a drink - cocktails aren’t blended? Bizarre. As expected, the result was the gin, vermouth and campari floating limply under the mountain of ice cubes. Horrible experience. Sadly, nostalgia just ain’t worth it anymore. Not going back., name_person=Vinay Choudary}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=8 months ago, review=Geoffrey's,  is a must visit place in Marine drive,  Mumbai ( Bombay ) for all the tourists, whether you are an Indian or a froreigner. It's a statement of style and richness. Jeffrey's is a colonial-style pub, stands as a timeless landmark on Marine Drive. With 25 years of history, it embodies elegance and charm. The ambiance is stunning, with warm lighting, rich wood furnishings, captivating wall art and floral carpets. The display of wines and desserts is breathtaking.
Key Features
1. Extensive cocktail menu. Innovative gin-based creations crafted to delight the palate.
2. Flawless hospitality: Friendly staff ensure every need is met with a smile.
3. Culinary offerings: Classic pizzas to exquisite desserts, each dish crafted with precision.
4.Rooftop pool: Tranquil atmosphere with mesmerizing views of the Arabian Sea.
Experience
Geoffrey's combines elegance with comfort, making it a quintessential destination for refined dining in Mumbai. Its vintage charm and exceptional service create a cherished experience, drawing guests back repeatedly.
Geoffrey's culinary offerings are a masterful blend of flavors and textures, with dishes crafted to delight the palate. The service is impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring a seamless dining experience. Every guest is treated to a warm, personalized welcome, making each visit truly unforgettable.
Nextvtime when you visit Mumbai make sure rhat you visit this place and enjoy., name_person=Dr Vinay Kumar T}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Great Wines and classy interiors! Luckily it is open to outsiders too and not just the people living in Marine Plaza. Their draft beer was crisp and fresh and totally worth the price. The Prawns with avocado and basil were the best of all. They serve  great bites with the beer and a separate menu for wines! One must consult their waiter for the best wine to have depending on your preferred taste., name_person=Abhijit Ekbote}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=3 years ago, review=As it was an anniversary night, we chose Geoffrey's as the decor and ambience was perfect for our evening. It has a vibrant yet a rustic feeling to it's charm. The interiors, the stunning wall filled with pictures, old film & art memorabilia, and many others...

When it comes to the drinks and the mocktails on offer, the bartender simply hit it off with amazing creations one after the other!

A few cons:

However, when it comes to the food, as a Indian who loves eating spicy food, the 'Jerk Spiced Chicken' was really bland, to my surprise, so much that I had to had the Tabasco Hot Sauce to it to get a spicy flavor!

The chicken Burger too was barely seasoned with salt & pepper, and lacked a flavorful taste, which you'd usually expect with a crispy fried chicken patty!

Overall:
It was a amazing experience, the decor, the food and the view from the top deck...

Just the food at Geoffrey's was way below any basic expectation., name_person=Amogh Joglekar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Still hold its old world charm. Ambience and the reclusiveness of the place offers the perfect recipe for an after office ghetto or a late evening night cap. Food menu could get majorly better and the portion sizes too. Pathetic list of things to choose from and energetic menu that almost had stayed on a pause mode.

The music is amazin and the bar's we'll stocked, name_person=George Koshy}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=2 years ago, review=Geoffrey’s is a very pretty cosy lounge restaurant inside Hotel Marine Plaza.  Their interiors are so amazing, old British like decor and furniture.

Totally loved the vibe.

They made nice cocktails. Price was bit on higher side, one cocktail was around 900 bucks with taxes, but they serve you nuts, wafers and kept refilling.

This place must be visited if you are looking to take your offshore friends or colleagues on drinks or with friends., name_person=Kashi F}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=6 years ago, review=Geoffrey’s is one of the best pubs in Bombay and the oldest too.

Everything from drinks and food to ambience and service is fantastic. My favourites here are galouti kebabs and the nachos that they serve with drinks. They also make a great martini.

Price wise, considering the experience, it is reasonable however be prepared to spend your dime if visiting here.

I recommend Geoffrey’s for a fun timeless evening with friends., name_person=Esha Bakhshi}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Friendly staff 1st class service good beer and good food worth a visit}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Location is excellent really enjoyed atmosphere and interior here.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=They serve great bites with the beer and a separate menu for wines!}"]

The location itself is unbeatable – right opposite Marine Drive, with a perfect view of the sea that makes dining even more special.

I tried their **half-and-half veg pizza**, and it turned out to be an excellent choice. The base was thin, crisp, and baked just right – not chewy or soggy. On one half, I went for the **classic veg toppings** (tomatoes, capsicum, onions, and olives), which had a fresh and vibrant flavor. The other half was **loaded with gourmet toppings**, with a rich cheesy layer, mushrooms, and bell peppers that gave a nice savory balance.

What stood out was the **quality of the cheese** – creamy, stretchy, and not too oily – and the **balance of spices and herbs**, which kept it flavorful without overpowering the freshness of the vegetables. Portion size is good enough to share if you’re not a heavy eater.

The **ambience** is calm and elegant with the sea breeze adding charm. Service was decent and staff courteous, though the place can get busy, especially in the evenings. Pricing is slightly on the higher side, but the taste, quality, and overall experience justify it.

✅ **Highlights**:

* Great sea-facing view
* Perfectly baked thin crust
* Fresh veggies & quality cheese
* Half-and-half option gives a variety in one pizza

⚠️ **Minor Cons**:

* Slightly pricey
* Gets crowded during peak hours, name_person=Mayur Aundhakar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=Up to 10 min}, time_line=3 weeks ago, review=Came for midnight dinner. Absolutely shocking experience at Dome, Intercontinental. The service is downright rude, arrogant, and completely high-handed. We called three times to check if we needed a reservation and were confidently told to “just walk in.” The moment we arrived, every decent spot was taken, and we were shown only corner high chairs like they were doing us a favour.

Then came the worst part — they dumped us in a freezing storeroom-like area, bone-chillingly cold, and still had the audacity to tell us we could only order drinks, not food, because “that’s their policy.” After a long wait, they finally offered us a table for three, and our misery really began.

The menu is already painfully limited, but somehow half the items weren’t available. The pizza we eventually ordered was wooden, tasteless, and had zero salt. When we asked for salt on top, even that was treated like a crime. The staff’s default response to anything is a flat “no,” delivered with unmatched snobbishness.

To top it off, the DJ was blasting ridiculous headache-inducing music that killed any chance of having a pleasant evening.

Honestly, avoid this place like the plague. Overpriced, overrated, and absolutely not worth the frustration. My recent visit to Restaurant Shiv Sagar was, without hyperbole, one of the most profoundly disappointing culinary experiences I have ever endured. This establishment fails catastrophically on every metric that defines a worthwhile restaurant, from the moment you sit down until the moment you thankfully leave. I feel compelled to provide a candid account to ensure fellow diners can make an informed choice and avoid the regret we felt.

The most critical failure lies, undoubtedly, with the food. To simply call it subpar would be a significant understatement; it was, quite frankly, one of the worst meals I have ever consumed. Each dish we ordered was a masterclass in mediocrity, lacking any discernible freshness, flavour, or culinary care. The spices were either absent or jarringly unbalanced, and the overall impression was of food that had been prepared with a sheer lack of interest, tasting bland, pre-made, and carelessly reheated. It was an absolute letdown that formed the core of our negative experience.

This culinary disaster was perfectly complemented by an equally dismal physical environment. The ambiance is best described as poor, with a cramped, cluttered, and uninspiring layout. A significant and frustrating practical issue was the size of the tables. They are inexplicably tiny, making it a genuine struggle to accommodate two plates of food alongside basic essentials like water glasses, condiments, and cutlery. This created a constant, uncomfortable juggling act throughout the meal, completely destroying any possibility of a relaxed dining atmosphere.

To complete this trifecta of failure, the service was exceptionally poor. The staff were inattentive, disinterested, and painfully slow. We waited an eternity to place our order, another eternity for the food to arrive, and a final eternity to receive the bill and settle the payment. Simple requests, like a refill of water, were met with indifference and long delays. The complete absence of basic hospitality was the final straw. In conclusion, Restaurant Shiv Sagar offers no compelling reason for a visit. ["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=3 months ago, review=I recently visited this restaurant and found the overall experience to be decent. The food was okay in terms of taste, but it could have been much better if it had been served hot and fresh. Serving lukewarm dishes does affect the dining experience.

On the positive side, the environment and ambiance of the restaurant were quite good—clean, comfortable, and pleasant for dining with friends or family. The staff was polite, and considering the location, the prices are affordable and value for money.

If the restaurant could focus on improving the quality of service, especially ensuring that the food is served hot, it would definitely enhance the overall dining experience., name_person=Mahesh Maurya}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Brunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,800–2,000, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=One if the Mumbai's legendery restros standing strong over 70 years! The ambience gave pure 1950s Bombay charm a perfect mix of old school elegance and British era Opera House vibes. Also noticed Mumbai drowned in rain even in 50s xd.

I ordered Patata Bravas and Queso which were already a full meal for one, but my foodie heart couldn't resist going for the Quattro Formaggi (four cheeses) Pasta. My friend ordered the Swiss Chicken steak stuffed with bacon and served with rice which was generous in portion and he loved it.

All in all the portions were generous and experience was spot on, a must visit for anyone who appreciates vintage charm and hearty continental flavours. Bon appetit !, name_person=Prathamesh Bandekar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=a month ago, review=We had a lovely time at this iconic eatery. We were wined and dined by the gaylord staff, and would welcome the chance to experience it again. I enjoyed the paneer masala whilst my associates went nutty on a wide range of naans and breads. Deserts were good too. Consider me a gaylord lover from now on!, name_person=Jonathan Comber}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=4, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=2 months ago, review=We recently went to Gaylord to celebrate a birthday and were so happy with the way the staff treated us, especially Mr. Suresh. Their tandoor starters are unmissable especially the malai tikka. For the main course do not miss the cannoli. The guy that plays the piano is also a very sweet and kind gentleman and from the minute you enter till the moment you leave, the staff takes utmost care of you., name_person=Keerat Kohli}", "{guided_block={}, time_line=4 months ago, review=I recently dined at Gaylord with my friends, and unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. The service was impolite and unprofessional from the beginning. We had to wait almost 10 minutes just to receive a menu, and only after we asked for it ourselves. To make matters worse, when another guest arrived, the staff immediately handed them a menu and attended to them with full attention, which made us feel ignored and undervalued.

The delay continued during billing as well. We requested the QR code for online payment, but the staff member disappeared without responding. After waiting again, we had to ask someone else, only for the same staff member to return later and casually remark, Oh, you didn’t get the QR? Such dismissive behavior is not acceptable in any professional dining environment.

The food itself was another letdown it was poorly prepared and not worth the price. To add to the disappointment, dishes were even served in broken plates, which is shocking for a restaurant with Gaylord’s reputation.

As someone who also works in management, I strongly believe every customer deserves equal treatment, regardless of appearance or background. A brand as well-known as Gaylord should uphold professional standards and ensure that no guest leaves feeling disrespected or neglected. Sadly, our visit was a complete waste of time and money, and I hope the management takes this feedback seriously to improve both their service and staff training., name_person=P Kajal}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,000–1,200, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[9+_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_NINE_OR_MORE], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=1}, time_line=4 months ago, review=KIND ATTENTION TO PURE VEGETARIANS VISITING THIS RESTAURANT!!!
Please note that this is Majorly a non vegetarian restaurant.
We were group of 10 people visited this restaurant on 15th August 2025 Dinner. Ordered Punjabi meal course and 2 types of Pasta.
1. Pasta Order was fully forgotten by the staff even after waiting politely for 1.5 hours, we didn't receive the same.
2. The Paneer sabzi and masala chana was too bland and full vibes of non veg dishes came from it
3. Service was pathetic and order came very late.
4. MAIN. THEY DONT HAVE SEPARATE KITCHEN FOR VEG AND NON VEG MEALS (WE GOT TO KNOW ABOUT THIS AT THE END OF FINISHING OUR MEALS.

VEGETARIANS ARE SUGGESTED TO GO FOR ANY ALTERNATE RESTAURANT. I HAVE INFORMED THE MANAGER AS WELL AS WROTE MY FEEDBACK TO THEM.

THANKS, name_person=Tanay Tolia}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[5-8_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_FIVE_TO_EIGHT], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=4 months ago, review=There are many iconic restaurants in Mumbai, each with their own history and beautiful story and the one I really like dinning at is Gaylord Restaurant whenever I am in Mumbai.
Warm welcome most of the time 😁 Getting a table of your choice can be difficult if you haven't reserved your table in advance.
I can forgive noisy ladies just for the food so delicious and mouthwatering, my favorite is Keema Nalli Gosht.
The place is perfect for any occasion.
I love the vibe about the place.
A big thank you to the chefs and servers for their dedication in serving us hungry customers 😁

Plz do book a table in advance for a good table., name_person=Mallika Jamy}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Somewhat recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Lunch, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹1,200–1,400, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Lovely place n good food. The outside sitting arrangement is also very nice, name_person=Ankita Kalsi}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Good food ambience good service bakery stuff yummy pastry yum}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=It’s a dish that comes with a piece of chicken accompanied by rice and veggies.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The restaurant offers a wide variety of plates from Indian and continental menu.}"]

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=4}, time_line=Edited 11 months ago, review=Decided to come here because of the 4.9, it must be good right?
I would say the mocktails were good, the sea bass(from robatayaki) was good, but everything else was average. We asked the waiter what they’re known for, and they said sushi and robatayaki. The sushi was okay, but expected better for that price point. I’ve had sushi all over the world and this was just average. We ordered the coconut crab salad, it was terrible and not what we expected. We barely touched it and the waiter did not even care to ask about it.
Truly astonishing for a high end restaurant at a high end hotel to provide that level of service.
This place is definitely overhyped, the 4.9 rating is underwhelming. The expensive price is not worth the taste at all. For that same price elsewhere, I would have gotten a great experience, and trust me when I say that because I’ve been to a lot of high end restaurants.
Maybe the Indian food would have been better, but don’t recommend sushi if that’s not what you’re best at.
I would say the food did come out fast though, so that’s a plus I guess.
UPDATE: the next morning my partner vomited 4 times, and got food poisoning. Trident hotel has done nothing about it too., name_person=MinLing Zhao}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Had an amazing time at Fenix while celebrating a friend’s birthday! Long waiting time, had to ask for water and even a finger bowl. Tarkari Biryani, Paneer Makhani and Fulka were also disappointing. Overall not worth the hype or price. Taj Mahal Palace is far better in food, service and value., name_person=Dr Neelam Prakash Bandivadekar}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Moderate noise, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=2, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=1, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[2_people, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_TWO], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=3, GUIDED_DINING_WAIT_TIME=No wait}, time_line=a month ago, review=Visiting Mumbai from CA after a long time and looking forward to eating at Ziya Oberoi. Sadly it's still undergoing renovation and hotel invited us to eat at Fenix, which was serving some Ziya dishes.

This was our experience on Oct 21.

From the Ziya page, we ordered the Nawab Chicken starter, which turned out to be quite bland but inoffensive.

Mains were Tadka Dahi Baigan and Ghee Roast Lamb. I suppose if you like your dish drowning and overpowered by dahi, then you'll like the baigan. I must say it was disappointing for us so we ate around the sauce. The lamb was rich and flavorful so 1 out of 3 could be called success!

The reason for the low score on service was entirely due to this. I always have a blended whisky on ice with Indian food.  It complements the flavors and doesn't bloat you like beer does. No need to waste a single malt if you're going to dump ice into it. So imagine my surprise when  the bill arrived and I was charged for a Glenlivet 12 instead of Chivas 12, which is what I asked for. This was INR 300 more expensive per shot and I had 2 doubles. When I asked if they had made a mistake, I was told that they accidentally served me the Glenlivet and the bill would remain unchanged. I'm only thankful they didnt "accidentally" serve and charge me for Johnny W Blue!!

At the end of the day, it's only INR 1200 ($14) more but the least I would expected is for Fenix to just charge me for what I ordered rather than what they served! Total bill for 2 was nearly INR 16 000 and we came away thinking maybe fine Indian dining in India is not worth it. Best to eat where the locals do.

My advice, if you want top and Indian cuisine, then go to London!, name_person=Harminder Sehmi}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Valet, E:PARKING_OPTION_VALET], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Vegetarian_menu_or_section, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_SEPARATE_MENU_SECTION]}, time_line=a year ago, review=We had an EPIC dinner evening with our family of 5. The food/ drinks and service is impeccable! Our server was Mercy and she was excellent.
We tried several vegetarian options including sushi, pizza, North Indian food, and Asian food. The meal was well made with local flavors. The pineapple Japanese cocktail was excellent.
I recommend this place for a peaceful meal away from the crowds and busy life in Mumbai., name_person=Kunal Sampat}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+}, time_line=3 years ago, review=Highly recommended. Delicious and wide range of choices! Tried their breakfast, lunch, and dinner. They are all good. Impressed how well they do with all kinds of cuisine they offer. Their service of course is unparalleled., name_person=Travelbug}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=Best location, tasty and quality food and great service.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=The restaurant also offers a good selection of wines, beers, and drinks.}", "{person_name=null, guided_block={}, time_line=null, review=There was loads of salads to choose from and the fresh cheese counter was yum!}"]

["{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=5 months ago, review=I had the pleasure of dining at Ziya Restaurant at The Oberoi, and it was truly an outstanding experience. From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was exceptional. A special thanks to Sanket, the manager, who went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect and that we had a memorable evening.

The traditional Indian cuisine was absolutely delicious rich in flavor, beautifully presented, and a true celebration of authentic tastes. To top it all off, they surprised us with a special complimentary dessert, which was a lovely gesture and made the experience even more special.

I highly recommend everyone to visit and enjoy not only the incredible food but also the warm and professional service that makes Ziya truly stand out. Whether you’re a fan of Indian food or simply looking for a refined dining experience, this place is a must to try, name_person=SAEED HARIB}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_OPTIONS=[Free_of_charge_parking_lot, E:PARKING_OPTION_FREE_PARKING_LOT], GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Parking, E:PARKING], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_MODE=Dine in, GUIDED_DINING_PARKING_SPACE_AVAILABILITY=Plenty of parking, GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5}, time_line=9 months ago, review=Had a 5 star experience at Ziya!

Ambience: very calm, tranquil ambience. The window offers a beautiful view of the sea and the queens necklace. The atmosphere is very pleasant.

Food : superb food in all aspects whether it's modern - fusion food or good ol classic butter chicken! Would recommend the pumpkin barley soup, the smoked dal makhani, butter chicken, and palak samosa.

Service: best in class service. Ms. Maria was very helpful from the beginning in prompt response to the booking and helping us out with the set menu options.
Mr. Siddharth and Ms. Chari were top notch in their service. Paying attention to all our needs they went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we wanted.

Value for money: The portion size is relatively smaller compared to the pricing, but the main course is quite sufficient. The overall experience was definitely worth paying for.

Pro tips :
1. go at sharp 7.00 pm when the restaurant opens if you want the best table with the view as these are limited.
2. We had a party of 5, so opted for the set menu option which allows you to plan in advance exactly what the pricing is going to be like. They have 3 different types of set menus along with Al carte.
3. Definitely recommend booking a table in advance.

Thank you Ziya for such a wonderful dining experience., name_person=Rudri Randeria}", "{guided_block={GUIDED_DINING_RECOMMEND_TO_VEGETARIANS=Highly recommend, GUIDED_DINING_MEAL_TYPE=Dinner, GUIDED_DINING_PRICE_RANGE=₹2,000+, GUIDED_DINING_NOISE_LEVEL=Quiet, easy to talk, GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_TIPS_TOPICS=[Vegetarian_options, E:VEGETARIAN_OPTIONS, Kid-friendliness, E:KID_FRIENDLINESS, Wheelchair_accessibility, E:ACCESSIBILITY], GUIDED_DINING_SERVICE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_GROUP_SIZE=[Suitable_for_all_group_sizes, E:DINING_GROUP_SIZE_SUITABLE_FOR_ALL], GUIDED_DINING_ATMOSPHERE_ASPECT=5, GUIDED_DINING_VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO=[Large_vegetarian_selection, E:VEGETARIAN_OFFERINGS_INFO_LARGE_SELECTION]}, time_line=4 months ago, review=Beyond this earth food and drinks experience.
